Ho sa tsotellehe sele e bohareng ke eng, le leng la mapheo le tlameha ho ba Z, kahoo Z e ka tlosoa seleng e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e bonang mapheo ka bobeli. Ke mokhoa oa Setsebi ho Bare Sudoku.
when: Ha papali e na le lisele tse 'maloa tse nang le baemeli ba babeli feela 'me ho se tlhapi e fumanehang. Li-Y-Wing li atile lipapaling tsa Setsebi 'me li fumanoa ka ho latela lisele tsa baemeli ba babeli: e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e ka ba sele e bohareng kapa lepheo.
spot: Thathamisa lisele tse nang le baemeli ba babeli feela. Bakeng sa e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe, e nke e le sele e bohareng e nang le baemeli X le Y, 'me u batle har'a baahisani ba eona sele e nang le X le nomoro e 'ngoe Z, le sele e nang le Y le Z eona eo. Tseo tse peli ke mapheo. Ebe u fumana lisele tse bonang mapheo ka bobeli 'me li na le Z. Hlokomela hore mapheo ha a hloke ho bonana.

steps: Sele e bohareng {pivot} e na le baemeli {x} le {y}. E bona {wingA}, e nang le {x} le {z}, le {wingB}, e nang le {y} le {z}.
Haeba {pivot} ke {x}, {wingA} e lahleheloa ke {x} 'me e ba {z}. Haeba {pivot} ke {y}, {wingB} e ba {z}. Le leng la mapheo ke {z} maemong ohle.
Sele e bonang mapheo ka bobeli e ke ke ea eba {z}. Tlosa {z} ho {elim}.

mistakes: Ho khetha mapheo ao e seng ka bobeli a bonang sele e bohareng. Lepheo ka leng le tlameha ho arolelana mola, kholomo kapa lebokose le sele e bohareng.
Ho tlosa Z liseleng tse bonang lepheo le le leng feela. Sele eo u e tlosetsang e tlameha ho bona mapheo ka bobeli.
Ho tlosa Z seleng e bohareng. Ho Y-Wing sele e bohareng ha e na Z; haeba e na le eona, paterone ke XYZ-Wing e nang le melao e fapaneng.
faq: Y-Wing ho Sudoku ke eng?

Lisele tse tharo tse nang le baemeli ba babeli: sele e bohareng e nang le X le Y, lepheo le nang le X le Z le bonang sele e bohareng, le lepheo le nang le Y le Z le bonang sele e bohareng. Lepheo le leng kamehla ke Z, kahoo Z e tlosoa liseleng tse bonang mapheo ka bobeli.
Na Y-Wing e tšoana le XY-Wing?
E. Mabitso ana a mabeli a hlalosa paterone e le 'ngoe. Bare Sudoku e e bitsa Y-Wing.
Hobaneng lepheo le leng le tlameha ho ba Z?
Haeba sele e bohareng ke X, lepheo la pele le lahleheloa ke X 'me le ba Z. Haeba sele e bohareng ke Y, lepheo la bobeli le ba Z. Sele e bohareng ke e 'ngoe ea tse peli, kahoo lepheo le leng ke Z.
Y-Wing e tlosa liseleng tse kae?
Hangata e le 'ngoe kapa tse peli: feela lisele tse bonang mapheo ka bobeli 'me li ntse li na le Z. Seo se lekane ho hlahisa moemeli a le mong kapa sebaka se le seng.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish ho Sudoku: kamoo mokhoa o sebetsang kateng
swordfish.description: Swordfish: nomoro e koaletsoeng likholomong tse tharo melong e meraro e tlosoa karolong e setseng ea likholomo tseo. Tlhapi ea boholo ba boraro, ka mohlala.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish ke X-Wing e nang le mela e meraro le likholomo tse tharo. Haeba nomoro e na le lisele tse sa feteng tse tharo tsa baemeli ho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea mela e meraro, 'me lisele tseo kaofela li oela likholomong tse tharo tse tšoanang, mela e meraro e sebelisa nomoro eo likholomong tseo, 'me nomoro e ka tlosoa liseleng tsohle tse ling tsa likholomo tse tharo. Mela le likholomo li ka fapanyetsoa. Bare Sudoku e batla Swordfish ka mor'a Y-Wing, lipapaling tsa Setsebi.
when: Ha X-Wing le Y-Wing li sa fumane letho. Li-Swordfish ha li ate joalo ka li-X-Wing 'me li hloka nomoro eo baemeli ba eona ba hasaneng hanyane melong e meraro. Li hloka lintlha tse feletseng le tse nepahetseng bakeng sa nomoro eo.
spot: Khetha nomoro 'me u batle mela e nang le lisele tse peli kapa tse tharo tsa baemeli bakeng sa eona. Haeba mela e meraro e joalo e koahela likholomo tse tharo feela kaofela, hlahloba likholomo tseo bakeng sa baemeli ba bang ba nomoro. Hase mola o mong le o mong o hlokang moemeli kholomong e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe: Swordfish e ka ba le lisele tse tšeletseng, tse supileng, tse robeli kapa tse robong. Papaling, khantša nomoro ka konopo ea eona 'me u batle mela e meraro eo baemeli ba eona ba lumellanang likholomong tse tharo.

steps: Nomoro {d} e na le lisele tse sa feteng tse tharo tsa baemeli ho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea mela {rows}, 'me lisele tseo kaofela li oela likholomong {cols}: {cells}.

Mola o mong le o mong ho e meraro o tlameha ho beha {d} ea oona kholomong e 'ngoe ho tse tharo, 'me ha ho mela e 'meli e ka sebelisang kholomo e le 'ngoe. Kahoo likholomo tse tharo li fumana {d} ea tsona ho tsoa melong ena e meraro.
Moemeli e mong le e mong oa {d} likholomong {cols} ha a khonehe. Tlosa {d} ho {elim}.

mistakes: Ho batla lisele tsohle tse robong. Swordfish e nang le baemeli ba babeli melong e meng e ntse e nepahetse, ha feela mela e meraro e koahela likholomo tse tharo feela.
Ho kenyelletsa mola o nang le lisele tse 'ne tsa baemeli. Mola o mong le o mong oa motheo o tlameha ho ba le tse sa feteng tse tharo, kaofela ka har'a likholomo tse tharo.
Ho tlosa melong ea motheo. Ha mela e le motheo, litloso li likholomong tse tharo, kantle ho mela ea motheo.
faq: Swordfish ho Sudoku ke eng?

Nomoro eo baemeli ba eona melong e meraro ba koaletsoeng likholomong tse tharo. Mela e meraro e tlameha ho beha nomoro likholomong tseo tse tharo, e le 'ngoe ho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe, kahoo nomoro e tlosoa liseleng tse ling tsa likholomo tseo.
Swordfish e fapana joang le X-Wing?
Ka boholo feela: X-Wing e sebelisa mela e 'meli le likholomo tse peli, Swordfish e sebelisa tse tharo le tse tharo. Monahano o tšoana.
Na Swordfish e hloka lisele tse robong hantle?
Che. Mola o mong le o mong o ka ba le baemeli ba babeli kapa ba bararo; paterone e hloka feela hore mela e meraro hammoho e se sebelise likholomo tse fetang tse tharo.
Na ho na le tlhapi ea boholo ba bone?
E, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku ha e e sebelise, hobane lipapali tsa eona ha li e hloke le ka mohla.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing ho Sudoku: kamoo mokhoa o sebetsang kateng
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: sele e bohareng e nang le baemeli ba bararo le mapheo a mabeli a arolelanang e mong oa bona li tlosa nomoro eo liseleng tse bonang tse tharo.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing ke Y-Wing eo sele ea eona e bohareng e nang le baemeli ba bararo. Sele e bohareng e na le X, Y le Z; lepheo la pele le bona sele e bohareng 'me le na le X le Z, la bobeli le bona sele e bohareng 'me le na le Y le Z. E 'ngoe ea lisele tse tharo e tlameha ho ba Z, kahoo Z e ka tlosoa seleng e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e bonang tsohle tse tharo. Kaha sele e bohareng ka boeona e ka ba Z, sele eo u e tlosetsang e tlameha ho bona sele e bohareng hammoho le mapheo ka bobeli, e leng se e lekanyetsang lebokoseng, moleng kapa kholomong eo lisele li e arolelanang. Ke mokhoa o thata ka ho fetisisa oo Bare Sudoku e o sebelisang.
when: Feela ha tsohle tse ling li hloleha. Li-XYZ-Wing ke paterone e sa fumaneheng hangata ho feta tsohle ho Bare Sudoku 'me li hlaha feela lipapaling tsa Setsebi. Li batle ha sele ea baemeli ba bararo e le lebokoseng le le leng le sele ea baemeli ba babeli e arolelanang linomoro tse peli tsa eona.
spot: Qala ka lisele tse nang le baemeli ba bararo feela; e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e ka ba sele e bohareng. Har'a baahisani ba eona, batla lisele tse peli tse nang le baemeli ba babeli ka 'ngoe, bao ka bobeli ba nkiloeng ho ba bararo ba sele e bohareng, tse arolelanang nomoro e le 'ngoe feela, Z. Ebe u batla lisele tse bonang sele e bohareng le mapheo ka bobeli 'me li na le Z. Ha e le hantle lepheo le leng le lebokoseng la sele e bohareng 'me le leng le moleng oa eona kapa kholomong ea eona, 'me lisele tse tlosetsoang ke lisele tse setseng tsa lebokose leo tse moleng oo kapa kholomong eo.

steps: Sele e bohareng {pivot} e na le baemeli ba bararo: {x}, {y} le {z}. E bona {wingA} e nang le {x} le {z}, le {wingB} e nang le {y} le {z}.
Haeba {pivot} ke {z}, ho felile. Haeba ke {x}, {wingA} e tlameha ho ba {z}. Haeba ke {y}, {wingB} e tlameha ho ba {z}. Maemong ohle e 'ngoe ea lisele tse tharo ke {z}.
Sele e bonang tsohle tse tharo e ke ke ea eba {z}. Tlosa {z} ho {elim}.

mistakes: Ho tlosa liseleng tse bonang mapheo a mabeli feela. Ho fapana le Y-Wing, sele e bohareng e ka ba Z, kahoo sele e tlameha ho bona le sele e bohareng.
Ho sebelisa mapheo ao baemeli ba 'ona e seng kaofela ba ka har'a baemeli ba bararo ba sele e bohareng.
Ho e ferekanya le Y-Wing: phapang ke moemeli oa boraro seleng e bohareng, 'me o fetola hore na ke lisele life tse ka hloekisoang.
faq: XYZ-Wing ho Sudoku ke eng?

Sele e bohareng e nang le baemeli X, Y le Z le mapheo a mabeli, le leng le nang le X le Z le le leng le nang le Y le Z, ka bobeli a bona sele e bohareng. E 'ngoe ea lisele tse tharo ke Z, kahoo Z e tlosoa liseleng tse bonang tsohle tse tharo.
XYZ-Wing e fapana joang le Y-Wing?

Sele e bohareng e na le baemeli ba bararo sebakeng sa ba babeli, ho kenyeletsoa Z. Seo se etsa hore sele e bohareng e be sebaka se khonehang sa Z, kahoo ke lisele feela tse bonang sele e bohareng le mapheo ka bobeli tse ka lahleheloang ke Z.
XYZ-Wing e hlaha hangata hakae?
Ka seoelo. Ho Bare Sudoku ke lipapali tsa Setsebi feela tse ka e hlokang, 'me boholo ba tsona ha bo e hloke. Bare Sudoku e e hlahloba qetellong, ka mor'a X-Wing, Y-Wing le Swordfish.
Na ho na le WXYZ-Wing?
E, e nang le sele e bohareng ea baemeli ba bane, empa Bare Sudoku ha e e sebelise. Papali e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea Bare Sudoku e ka phethoa ka mekhoa e robong ea tataiso ena.

sn.learnText: Uri mutsva paSudoku, kana kuti wamira pachirahwe chakaoma? Magwara maviri anotsanangura mitemo nenzira dzose dzekugadzirisa dzinoshandiswa nezvinongedzo, imwe neimwe iine muenzaniso chaiwo.

howTo.title: Matambiro eSudoku: mitemo, bhodhi nenhanho dzekutanga
howTo.description: Dzidza kutamba Sudoku: mitemo, mashandiro anoita mitsara, makoramu nemabhokisi, sei chirahwe chine mhinduro imwe chete, manotsi nenhanho dzekutanga.
howTo.summary: Sudoku chirahwe chepfungwa chine gidhi re9×9. Zadza sero rimwe nerimwe risina chinhu nenhamba kubva pa1 kusvika pa9 kuitira kuti mutsara wega wega, koramu yega yega nebhokisi rega rega re3×3 zvive nenhamba imwe neimwe kamwe chete. Dzimwe nhamba dzinopiwa pakutanga; dzimwe unodziwana nepfungwa, sero rimwe rine chokwadi panguva, uye hauzombofaniri kufungidzira. Gwara iri rinotsanangura bhodhi, mitemo, musimboti wemhinduro imwe chete, manotsi uye zano riri nyore renhanho dzako dzekutanga. Unogona kudzidzira zvose izvi mu [Bare Sudoku](play), iyo yemahara uye ine zvinongedzo zvinotsanangura pfungwa iri kumashure.

sections.h: Mitemo yeSudoku ndeipi?
p: Pane mitemo mitatu chete, uye mutemo mumwe chete unoonekwa kubva kumativi matatu: mutsara wega wega unofanira kuva nenhamba 1 kusvika 9, koramu yega yega inofanira kuva nenhamba 1 kusvika 9, uye bhokisi rega rega re3×3 rinofanira kuva nenhamba 1 kusvika 9. Saka nhamba haimbogoni kuoneka kaviri mumutsara mumwe chete, mukoramu imwe chete kana mubhokisi rimwe chete.

Nhamba dzakapiwa, dzakanyorwa dzakakora, hadzichinji. Basa rako nderekuzadza masero asina chinhu. Hapana masvomhu uye hapana kurongeka: nhamba zviratidzo zvipfumbamwe zvakasiyana chete. Unogona kutamba nemavara kana nezvimiro uye hapana chaizoshanduka.

sections.h: Bhodhi rakarongwa sei?
p: Bhodhi rine masero 81 mumitsara 9 nemakoramu 9. Mitsetse mikobvu inoripatsanura kuita mabhokisi mapfumbamwe e3×3. Sero rimwe nerimwe riri mumutsara mumwe chete, mukoramu imwe chete nemubhokisi rimwe chete, uye mapoka aya matatu ndiwo mapoka aro. Mamwe masero 20 anogovana boka nesero iroro anonzi vavakidzani varo; nhamba yakaiswa musero inobvisa nhamba iyoyo kuvavakidzani vose 20.

Masero anonyorwa se r3c7: mutsara 3, koramu 7. Mitsara inoverengwa kubva kumusoro, makoramu kubva kuruboshwe, uye mabhokisi 1 kusvika 9 kubva kumusoro kuruboshwe, mutsara nemutsara. Manyorerwo aya anoshandiswa mugwara rega rega renzira uye akakodzera kudzidzwa: r5c5 ndiro pakati pebhodhi.

sections.h: Sei Sudoku yega yega iine mhinduro imwe chete?
p: Sudoku chaiyo ine mhinduro imwe chete, uye ndizvo zvinoita kuti pfungwa ishande. Pese paunokwanisa kuratidza kuti nhamba haigoni kuenda kumwe kupi zvako mune boka, inofanira kuenda musero rasara, nekuti mhinduro iripo uye ndeimwe chete. Dai chirahwe chaiva nemhinduro mbiri, hapana kufunga kwaigona kudzisiyanisa uye pane imwe nguva waizomanikidzwa kufungidzira.

Bare Sudoku inogadzira chirahwe chimwe nechimwe pamudziyo wako uye inoongorora kuti chine mhinduro imwe chete uye kuti mugadzirisi wayo wepfungwa anogona kuchipedza nenzira dzezinga rawasarudza. Saka kana wakamira, nguva dzose pane nhanho inotevera yekuwana, uye chinongedzo chinoiratidza.

sections.h: Unotanga sei chirahwe cheSudoku?
p: Tanga nepane zvisungo zvakawanda. Nhevedzano iyi inoshanda pazinga rega rega:
list: Sarudza nhamba yatoonekwa kakawanda, tichiti katanhatu kana kanomwe, uye tsvaga mabhokisi achiri kuishaya. Kazhinji sero rimwe chete ndiro rinosara mubhokisi rayo: iyi ndiyo [nzvimbo imwe chete](hidden-single).

Tsvaga masero akamanikidzwa. Sero rine mutsara waro, koramu yaro nebhokisi raro zvakabatanidzwa zvine nhamba sere dzakasiyana rine anokwanisa mumwe chete akasara: uyu ndiye [mumwe chete anokwanisa](naked-single). Masero ari mumitsara kana mumabhokisi anenge azere ndiyo nzvimbo yakanakisa yekutarisa.
Nhamba yega yega yaunoisa inobvisa anokwanisa kubva kuvavakidzani 20, saka ongorora vavakidzani ivavo pakarepo. Mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete zvinowanzouya zvichitevedzana.

Kana kuisa kuri nyore kwapera, nyora manotsi: vanokwanisa vesero rimwe nerimwe risina chinhu. Wobva watsvaga nhamba yakavharirwa mumutsetse mumwe chete mukati mebhokisi ([vanokwanisa vakakiiwa](locked-candidates)) kana masero maviri ane vanokwanisa vaviri vakafanana ([vaviri vari pachena](naked-pairs)).
Dzokera kumumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete mushure mekubvisa kwega kwega. Kunyange zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinogadziriswa zvakanyanya nazvo; nzira yepamusoro inongovhura nhanho inotevera.

sections.h: Manotsi chii uye unofanira kuashandisa riini?
p: Manotsi, anonziwo zviratidzo zvepenzura kana vanokwanisa, inhamba diki dzaunonyora musero risina chinhu kuti uchengete kuti ndedzipi nhamba dzichiri kugoneka ipapo. Muzvirahwe zviri nyore hauwanzoadi; kubva paKuoma zvichikwira anokosha zvikuru, nekuti nzira dzakaita sevaviri, X-Wing neY-Wing dzinobata vanokwanisa, kwete nhamba dzakaiswa.

Chengeta manotsi akarurama: kana waisa nhamba, ibvise pamanotsi evavakidzani vose 20. Mu Bare Sudoku izvi zvinoitika zvoga, uye Zadza manotsi inonyora anokwanisa wese musero rimwe nerimwe risina chinhu nekubaya kamwe, saka unogona kutanga neseti yakakwana uye yakarurama yevanokwanisa. Notsi ichokwadi, kwete kufungidzira: zvinoreva kuti hapana chiri kubvisa nhamba iyi parizvino.

sections.h: Unofanira kuitei kana wakamira?
p: Kutanga ongorora zvakare zvinhu zvekutanga: mutsara wega wega, koramu yega yega nebhokisi rega rega zvinenge zvazara itsime remumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete. Wozoona kuti manotsi akakwana, nekuti anokwanisa asipo anovanza zvimiro uye anokwanisa akare asisina kururama anogadzira zvimiro zvenhema. Wozoshanda ne[nzira](techniques) dzakarongwa nekuoma kwadzo: vanokwanisa vakakiiwa, vaviri nevatatu, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish neXYZ-Wing. Imwe neimwe ine peji rayo nemuenzaniso chaiwo.

Kana pasina chinoshanda, tora chinongedzo. Mu Bare Sudoku chinongedzo chinotanga chaongorora kana nhamba yakaiswa isina kururama, chobva chawana sero rinotevera rinogona kuzadzwa nepfungwa uye chotumidza nzira yacho, saka unodzidza chimwe chinhu kunyange uchichishandisa. Baya chinongedzo zvakare kuti uise nhamba.

sections.h: Unopinza sei nhamba mu Bare Sudoku?
p: Baya sero, wobva wabaya nhamba. Kana kuti baya nhamba kutanga: inokiiwa, uye sero rimwe nerimwe raunobaya rinoiwana, inova nzira inokurumidza kupfuura dzose yekuisa kopi yechitanhatu, yechinomwe neyechisere yenhamba. Baya nhamba zvakare kuti uisunungure. Bhatani reManotsi rinochinjira kuzviratidzo zvepenzura, Dzima rinobvisa zviri musero, Dzokera rinodzosa nhanho ipi zvayo, uye zvikanganiso zvinoratidzwa nemutsvuku kunze kwekunge wazvidzima mumenu.

Pakiibhodhi, shandisa makiyi emiseve kufamba, 1 kusvika 9 kupinza nhamba, Backspace kudzima, N kumanotsi, U kudzokera, H kuchinongedzo, F kuzadza manotsi uye Escape kumenu. Mutambo unozvichengetedza woga, unoshanda pasina internet uye hauna zvishambadzo kana akaunti.

faq: Unombofanira kufungidzira muSudoku here?

Kwete muchirahwe chakanaka. Chirahwe chimwe nechimwe che Bare Sudoku chine mhinduro imwe chete uye chakaongororwa kuti chinogadziriswa nepfungwa chete, kusvika panzira dzezinga racho. Kana uchinzwa kuti unofanira kufungidzira, pane anokwanisa asipo mumanotsi ako kana nzira yakamirira kuwanikwa.
Nhamba inogona kuoneka kaviri mumutsara, mukoramu kana mubhokisi here?

Kwete. Ndiwo mutemo wese: mutsara wega wega pamitsara mipfumbamwe, koramu yega yega pamakoramu mapfumbamwe nebhokisi rega rega pamabhokisi mapfumbamwe zvine nhamba yega yega kubva pa1 kusvika pa9 kamwe chete. Kana nhamba mbiri dzakafanana dzichigovana boka, kanenge imwe yadzo haina kururama.
Musiyano uripi pakati peNyore, Pakati, Kuoma neNyanzvi?

Zinga rinotemwa nenzira dzinodiwa nechirahwe. Nyore nePakati zvinogadziriswa nemumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete chete, uye Nyore inotanga nenhamba dzakapiwa 38 kana kupfuura. Kuoma kunoda vanokwanisa vakakiiwa kana vaviri nevatatu. Nyanzvi inoda X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish kana XYZ-Wing.
Zviri nani here kuzadza manotsi kumasero ose kana kune mamwe chete?

Pazvirahwe zveKuoma neNyanzvi, zadza ose: zvimiro zvakaita sevaviri, X-Wing neY-Wing zvinongooneka kana anokwanisa wese akanyorwa. PaNyore nePakati, manotsi ndeesarudzo uye vatambi vazhinji vanongotsvaga mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete nemaziso.
Sudoku inotora nguva yakareba sei?

Chirahwe cheNyore chinotora maminitsi mashoma; zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinogona kutora maminitsi makumi maviri kana kupfuura, zvichienderana nekukurumidza kwaunoona chimiro chepamusoro. Bare Sudoku inoratidza wachi, inoimisa kana menu yakavhurwa uye haichengeti rondedzero yevakahwina, saka tamba nekumhanya kwako.
Sudoku inoda masvomhu here?
Kwete. Nhamba mazita chete; hapana kuwedzera kana kuverenga. Zviratidzo zvipi zvazvo zvipfumbamwe zvaishanda, uye ndosaka Sudoku iri chirahwe chepfungwa kwete chirahwe chenhamba.

index.title: Nzira dzekugadzirisa Sudoku dzakatsanangurwa nemienzaniso
index.description: Nzira pfumbamwe dzose dzekugadzirisa Sudoku, kubva pamumwe chete anokwanisa kusvika paSwordfish neXYZ-Wing, nenhevedzano yezvinongedzo zve Bare Sudoku.
intro: Sudoku yega yega inogona kugadziriswa neboka duku renzira dzepfungwa. Rondedzero iyi inoratidza nzira pfumbamwe dzinoshandiswa nemugadzirisi we Bare Sudoku nezvinongedzo zvayo, dzakarongwa nenhevedzano yaanodziedza nayo: kutanga mumwe chete anokwanisa nenzvimbo imwe chete, kozobvisa mukati meboka rimwe chete, kozoti zvimiro zvinoyambuka mitsara nemakoramu akati wandei. Nzira imwe neimwe ine peji rayo rine tsananguro, maonero ayo, muenzaniso chaiwo kubva muchirahwe chakagadzirwa uye zvikanganiso zvinowanzoitika.

Zinga rechirahwe rinotemwa nenzira yakaoma kupfuura dzose yachinoda. Zvirahwe zveNyore nePakati zvinoda mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete chete, zvirahwe zveKuoma zvinoda vanokwanisa vakakiiwa kana vaviri nevatatu, uye zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinoda kanenge hove imwe kana bapiro rimwe. Pazinga ripi zvaro, mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete ndizvo zvinoita basa rakawanda; nzira yepamusoro inobvisa anokwanisa mumwe kana vaviri, uye mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete zvinoenderera mberi kubva ipapo.
faq: Ndinofanira kuedza nzira dzeSudoku nenhevedzano ipi?

Dziri nyore kutanga: mumwe chete anokwanisa, nzvimbo imwe chete, vanokwanisa vakakiiwa, vaviri nevatatu vari pachena, vaviri nevatatu vakavanda, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku inodziedza nenhevedzano iyi chaiyo, uye chinongedzo nguva dzose chinotumidza nzira iri nyore kupfuura dzose inoita kuti ufambire mberi.
Ndinoda nzira dzose idzi here kuti ndigadzirise Sudoku?

Pazvirahwe zveNyore nePakati, mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete zvakakwana. Zvirahwe zveKuoma zvinowedzera vanokwanisa vakakiiwa nevaviri nevatatu. Zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinoda kanenge hove imwe kana bapiro rimwe, asi kazhinji kamwe kana kaviri chete pachirahwe.
Pane nzira dzakaoma kupfuura XYZ-Wing here?

Hongu, semuenzaniso maketani, bvunzo dzemhinduro imwe chete uye mambure ekumanikidza. Bare Sudoku haigadziri zvirahwe zvinodzida, saka chirahwe chimwe nechimwe mumutambo chinogona kupedzwa nenzira pfumbamwe dziri papeji rino.
Anokwanisa chii?

Nhamba ichiri kugona kuenda musero risina chinhu nekuti hapana chiri mumutsara waro, mukoramu yaro kana mubhokisi raro chiri kuibvisa parizvino. Manotsi ari mumutambo ndivo vanokwanisa. Nzira yega yega inopfuura mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete inofunga pamusoro pevanokwanisa, saka vachengete vakakwana uye vakarurama.

naked-single.name: Mumwe chete anokwanisa
naked-single.title: Mumwe chete anokwanisa muSudoku: sero rine sarudzo imwe
naked-single.description: Mumwe chete anokwanisa isero risina chinhu rine nhamba imwe chete inogoneka. Dzidza kuriwana nekukurumidza, nemuenzaniso chaiwo nezvikanganiso zvinowanzoitika.
naked-single.summary: Mumwe chete anokwanisa isero risina chinhu rine anokwanisa mumwe chete: dzimwe nhamba sere dzatovapo mumutsara waro, mukoramu yaro kana mubhokisi raro. Nhamba yasara inofanira kuenda ipapo. Ndiyo nzira iri nyore kupfuura dzose yeSudoku, yaunoshandisa zvakanyanya, uye ndiyo inoziviswa nechinongedzo che Bare Sudoku sekuti "Mumwe chete anokwanisa pano".
when: Nguva dzose. Mumwe chete anokwanisa anooneka kubva panhanho yekutanga kusvika yekupedzisira, pazinga rega rega. Muzvirahwe zveNyore nePakati, pamwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete, ndiyo nzira chete yaunoda. Muzvirahwe zvakaoma, kubvisa kwega kwega kunoitwa nenzira yepamusoro kazhinji kunosiya mumwe chete anokwanisa, saka mutsvage mushure menhanho yega yega.
spot: Tarisa masero ane vavakidzani vakawanda vane nhamba: sero riri mumutsara watova nenhamba nomwe, kana sero rine mutsara waro, koramu yaro nebhokisi raro zvakabatanidzwa zvine nhamba sere dzakasiyana. Pasina manotsi, verenga nhamba dzaunoona kubva musero. Nemanotsi, mumwe chete anokwanisa isero rinoratidza anokwanisa mumwe chete, ndosaka Zadza manotsi ichiita kuti awanikwe nyore.

steps: Tarisa {cell}. Harina chinhu, saka nyora nhamba yega yega yatoiswa mumutsara waro, mukoramu yaro nemubhokisi raro.
Mutsara {row} une {rowDigits}. Koramu {col} ine {colDigits}. Bhokisi {box} rine {boxDigits}.
Pamwe chete zvinobvisa nhamba dzose, {d} chete ndiyo inosara, saka {d} ndiye anokwanisa mumwe chete akasara musero {cell}.
Nyora {d} musero {cell}. Wozoongorora kana nhamba itsva ichigadzira mumwe chete kana nzvimbo imwe chete itsva mumutsara, mukoramu kana mubhokisi imomo.

mistakes: Kuverenga mutsara chete kana bhokisi chete. Nhamba sere dzakabviswa kazhinji dzinobva mumapoka ose matatu pamwe chete.
Kukanganwa kuti nhamba yawaisa izvozvi inobvisawo vanokwanisa kuvavakidzani vayo 20; mumwe chete anokwanisa mutsva anooneka pakarepo mushure mekuisa kwega kwega.

Kuvhiringa mumwe chete anokwanisa nenzvimbo imwe chete: mumwe chete anokwanisa zvinoreva kuti musero musara anokwanisa mumwe chete, nzvimbo imwe chete zvinoreva kuti mune boka musara sero rimwe chete renhamba.
faq: Mumwe chete anokwanisa chii muSudoku?
Sero risina chinhu rine anokwanisa mumwe chete. Nhamba sere dzakasiyana dzatoiswa mumutsara waro, mukoramu yaro nemubhokisi raro, saka nhamba yechipfumbamwe ndiyo chete inokwana.
Sei muChirungu achinzi "naked", akashama?

Nekuti anokwanisa mumwe chete anooneka zvakananga musero kana manotsi anyorwa; hapana chinomuvanza. Nzvimbo imwe chete, kusiyana neizvi, iri pakati pevamwe vanokwanisa uye inowanikwa nekutarisa nhamba kwete sero.
Chirahwe chinogona kugadziriswa nemumwe chete anokwanisa chete here?

Zvirahwe zvakawanda zveNyore zvinogona, asi zvizhinji zvinodawo nzvimbo imwe chete. Bare Sudoku inoyera zvirahwe zveNyore nePakati sezvinogadziriswa nemhando mbiri idzi; zvirahwe zveKuoma neNyanzvi zvinoda kanenge imwe nzira yekuwedzera.
Chinongedzo chinoratidza mumwe chete anokwanisa here?
Hongu. Kana kuisa kunotevera kuri mumwe chete anokwanisa, chinongedzo chinosarudza sero uye chinoti "Mumwe chete anokwanisa pano" nenhamba yacho. Baya chinongedzo zvakare kuti uiise.

hidden-single.name: Nzvimbo imwe chete
hidden-single.title: Nzvimbo imwe chete muSudoku: pekuisa nhamba pega
hidden-single.description: Nzvimbo imwe chete isero rimwe chete mumutsara, mukoramu kana mubhokisi rinogona kupinda nhamba. Dzidza kuiwana nekutarisa nhamba imwe panguva.
hidden-single.summary: Nzvimbo imwe chete inhamba yasara nesero rimwe chete rinogoneka mumutsara, mukoramu kana mubhokisi, kunyange sero iroro richiratidza vamwe vanokwanisa. Sezvo boka richifanira kuva nenhamba iyoyo, inoenda ipapo. Chinongedzo che Bare Sudoku chinoizivisa sekuti "Nzvimbo imwe chete ye5 mumutsara uno", kana mukoramu ino kana mubhokisi rino.
when: Pese panhamba yafambira mberi: kana nhamba yaoneka kashanu kana katanhatu, mabhokisi asara anenge akamanikidzwa zvikuru, uye kazhinji nzvimbo imwe chete ndiyo nhanho inotevera. Nzvimbo imwe chete ndiyo nzira huru yezvirahwe zveNyore nePakati uye inoramba iri nzira inoshanda zvakanyanya pazinga rega rega.
spot: Ongorora nhamba imwe panguva. Tora nhamba, tsvaga bhokisi risina iyo, uye dimbura sero rimwe nerimwe rebhokisi iroro rinogovana mutsara kana koramu nekopi yakaiswa yenhamba iyoyo. Kana sero rimwe chete rikasara, wawana nzvimbo imwe chete. Kuongorora ukuku kunoshandawo pamitsara nemakoramu. Mumutambo, baya nhamba yakaiswa: kopi yayo yega yega inovhenekerwa, saka masero akasununguka anobuda pachena.

steps: Bhokisi {box} harisati riine {d}, saka rimwe remasero aro asina chinhu rinofanira kuiva nayo. Masero asina chinhu ndeaya: {empties}.
Mune rimwe nerimwe rawo kunze kwesero {cell}, pane {d} yatoiswa mumutsara kana mukoramu imwe chete inoivharira, saka {d} haisi anokwanisa ipapo.
Izvi zvinosiya sero {cell} riri nzvimbo chete ye{d} mubhokisi {box}. Nyora {d} ipapo, kunyange sero {cell} richiri kuratidza vamwe vanokwanisa.

mistakes: Kuisa nhamba musero rinongoita serakarurama: ongorora sero rimwe nerimwe risina chinhu reboka, kwete iro riri pachena chete.
Kupotsa nzvimbo imwe chete nekuti sero rinoratidza vanokwanisa vakawanda. Vamwe vanokwanisa havana basa; chinokosha ndechekuti nhamba haina imwe nzvimbo mune boka.
Kuongorora mabhokisi chete. Mitsara nemakoramu zvinopa nzvimbo imwe chete kakawanda sezvakangoita mabhokisi, kunyanya pakupedzisira.
faq: Nzvimbo imwe chete chii muSudoku?
Nhamba inogona kuenda musero rimwe chete remutsara, koramu kana bhokisi. Boka rinofanira kuva nenhamba iyoyo, saka sero racho rinenge ratemwa kunyange richine vamwe vanokwanisa.
Musiyano uripi pakati penzvimbo imwe chete nemumwe chete anokwanisa?
Mumwe chete anokwanisa ane chekuita nesero: anokwanisa mumwe chete asara. Nzvimbo imwe chete ine chekuita nenhamba: sero rimwe chete rasara mune boka. Zvose zviri zviviri zvinoisa nhamba nechokwadi.
Ndeipi iri nyore kuwana?

Pasina manotsi, nzvimbo imwe chete kazhinji iri nyore nekuti unogona kuongorora bhodhi nhamba imwe panguva. Nemanotsi akakwana, mumwe chete anokwanisa ndiye ari nyore kupfuura, sezvo sero rine anokwanisa mumwe chete richibuda pachena.
Chinongedzo chinotsanangura sei nzvimbo imwe chete?
Sekuti "Nzvimbo imwe chete ye" nhamba mumutsara uno, mukoramu ino kana mubhokisi rino, sero racho rakasarudzwa. Baya chinongedzo zvakare kuti uiise.

locked-candidates.name: Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa
locked-candidates.title: Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa muSudoku: kunongedza nekuzvitorera
locked-candidates.description: Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa: kana vanokwanisa venhamba mubhokisi vari mumutsetse mumwe, kana zvakapesana, nhamba inobviswa kumwe kwese. Mienzaniso miviri chaiyo.
locked-candidates.summary: Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa ndiyo nzira yekutanga inobvisa vanokwanisa pachinzvimbo chekuisa nhamba. Ine mhando mbiri. Kunongedza: mubhokisi, vanokwanisa vose venhamba vari mumutsara mumwe kana mukoramu imwe, saka nhamba inobviswa kune mamwe masero emutsetse iwoyo. Kuzvitorera: mumutsara kana mukoramu, vanokwanisa vose venhamba vari mubhokisi rimwe, saka nhamba inobviswa kune mamwe masero ebhokisi iroro. Chinongedzo che Bare Sudoku chinoisa zita rekuti "Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa" pakuisa kwainovhura.
when: Kana mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete zvapera muchirahwe cheKuoma, ichi ndicho chinhu chekutanga chekuedza. Chinoda manotsi akakwana kanenge enhamba yauri kuongorora. Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa vanowanikwa kazhinji: zvirahwe zvizhinji zveKuoma zvinovada, uye zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinovashandisa pakati pezvimiro zvikuru.
spot: Pakunongedza, tarisa bhokisi rimwe nerimwe nenhamba yega yega isipo mariri: kana masero evanokwanisa venhamba iyoyo ari mumutsara mumwe kana mukoramu imwe, ongorora kana nhamba iyoyo ichiri kuoneka seanokwanisa mberi mumutsetse iwoyo kunze kwebhokisi. Pakuzvitorera, tarisa mumutsara kana mukoramu: kana vanokwanisa vose venhamba vari mukati mebhokisi rimwe, mamwe masero ebhokisi iroro anogona kucheneswa. Mumutambo, baya kiyi yenhamba kuti uvhenekere anokwanisa wayo wese; mutsetse wemanotsi maviri kana matatu akavhenekerwa mukati mebhokisi rimwe ndicho chimiro.

steps: Mubhokisi {box}, nhamba {d} ine masero aya chete evanokwanisa: {cells}. Ose ari mumutsara {row}.
Bhokisi {box} rinoda {d}, saka {d} yemutsara {row} iri mukati mebhokisi {box}, kunyange ikawira musero ripi pakati peaya.
Mutsara {row} haugoni kuva nenhamba {d} yechipiri, saka bvisa {d} mumasero emutsara {row} ari kunze kwebhokisi: {elim}.
Mumutsara {row}, nhamba {d} inogona kuenda chete mumasero {cells}, uye ose ari mukati mebhokisi {box}.
Mutsara {row} unofanira kuva nenhamba {d}, saka {d} yebhokisi {box} inotorwa nemutsara {row}. Mamwe masero ebhokisi {box} haagoni kuva nenhamba {d}.
Bvisa {d} mumasero {elim}.

mistakes: Kubvisa nhamba mukati mebhokisi pachinzvimbo chekunze kwaro pakunongedza, kana zvakapesana pakuzvitorera. Kubvisa kunogara kuchienda kumasero ari mumutsetse asi asiri mubhokisi, kana ari mubhokisi asi asiri mumutsetse.
Kushandisa mutemo kana vanokwanisa vakapararira mumitsara miviri yebhokisi. Masero ose evanokwanisa venhamba mubhokisi anofanira kuva mumutsetse mumwe chete.
Kukanganwa kutsvaga mumwe chete kana nzvimbo imwe chete inogadzirwa nekubvisa. Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa havawanzoisa nhamba voga; vanogadzirira nhanho iri nyore.
faq: Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa chii muSudoku?

Vanokwanisa venhamba vakavharirwa panosangana bhokisi nemutsetse. Sezvo bhokisi, kana mutsetse, zvichifanira kuva nenhamba iyoyo mukati mepanosangana apo, nhamba inogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero emutsetse, kana mune mamwe masero ebhokisi.
Musiyano uripi pakati pekunongedza nekuzvitorera?

Kunongedza kunotanga nebhokisi: vanokwanisa venhamba mubhokisi vanonongedza vachitevedza mutsara mumwe kana koramu imwe, saka nhamba inobviswa mune mamwe masero emutsetse iwoyo. Kuzvitorera kunotanga nemutsara kana koramu: vanokwanisa vose venhamba vemutsetse vari mubhokisi rimwe, saka mutsetse unozvitorera nhamba uye inobviswa mune mamwe masero ebhokisi.
Vanokwanisa vakakiiwa vanonziwo intersection removal here?
Hongu. Mamwe mazita ndeaya: box-line reduction yemhando yekuzvitorera uye pointing pairs kana pointing triples yemhando yekunongedza. Bare Sudoku inoshandisa zita rimwe chete kune dzose.
Izinga ripi rinoda vanokwanisa vakakiiwa?
Kuoma. Chirahwe chinoda vanokwanisa vakakiiwa kana vaviri nevatatu asi pasina chakaoma kupfuura ipapo chinoyerwa seKuoma; zvirahwe zveNyanzvi zvinodawo hove kana bapiro.

naked-pairs.name: Vaviri nevatatu vari pachena
naked-pairs.title: Vaviri nevatatu vari pachena muSudoku: mashandiro avo
naked-pairs.description: Vaviri nevatatu vari pachena: masero maviri kana matatu mune boka ane vanokwanisa vakafanana. Dzidza kuvaona nezvekubvisa, nemienzaniso chaiyo.
naked-pairs.h1: Vaviri nevatatu vari pachena (naked pair, naked triple)
naked-pairs.summary: Vaviri vari pachena masero maviri ari mumutsara mumwe, mukoramu imwe kana mubhokisi rimwe ane vanokwanisa vaviri vakafanana chaizvo. Nhamba mbiri idzi dzinofanira kuenda mumasero maviri aya, saka dzinogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero ose eboka. Vatatu vari pachena ipfungwa imwe chete nemasero matatu nenhamba nhatu; sero rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuratidza mbiri kana nhatu dzose. Chinongedzo che Bare Sudoku chinoisa zita rekuti "Vaviri kana vatatu" pakuisa kunotevera.
when: Mushure mekunge manotsi akwana uye mumwe chete, nzvimbo imwe chete nevanokwanisa vakakiiwa zvapera. Vaviri vari pachena vanowanikwa zvikuru muzvirahwe zveKuoma, vatatu vari pachena kwete zvakanyanya. Zvose zvakakodzera kuongororwa mune boka rimwe nerimwe richiri nemasero mashanu kana kupfuura asina chinhu.
spot: Tsvaga masero ane vanokwanisa vaviri chete uye tsvaga rimwe sero mune boka rimwe chete rine vaviri ivavo. Pavatatu, tarisa mapoka ane masero akati wandei evanokwanisa vaviri nevatatu uye ongorora kana matatu awo pamwe chete achishandisa nhamba nhatu chete dzakasiyana. Masero ane vanokwanisa vakafanana chaizvo ari nyore kuona kana manotsi anyorwa; Zadza manotsi mumutambo inozviita nekubaya kamwe.

steps: {cellA} uye {cellB} mu{unit} ane vanokwanisa vaviri vakafanana chaizvo: {d1} uye {d2}.
Rimwe rawo rinofanira kuva {d1} uye rimwe rive {d2}. Hatizivi kuti nderipi, asi nhamba mbiri idzi dzose dzinoshandiswa nemasero maviri aya.
Saka hapana rimwe sero mu{unit} ringava nenhamba {d1} kana {d2}. Bvisa {elim}.
Masero matatu e{unit} anotora vanokwanisa vavo vose kubva panhamba nhatu dzimwe chete, {digits}: {cells}.

Nhamba nhatu idzi dzinofanira kuzadza masero matatu aya neimwe nhevedzano. Sero harifaniri kuratidza vanokwanisa vose vatatu; chinokosha ndechekuti hapana sero pamatatu aya rine anokwanisa ari kunze kweseti iyi.
Bvisa {digits} mune mamwe masero ose e{unit}: {elim}.

mistakes: Kutora masero maviri anogovana vanokwanisa vaviri asi aine wechitatu. Pavaviri vari pachena, sero rimwe nerimwe rinofanira kuva nevanokwanisa vaviri ivavo chete, pasina mumwe.
Kubvisa nhamba mumasero evaviri ivavo pachavo. Vaviri vanochengeta vanokwanisa vavo; kubvisa kunoenda kune mamwe masero eboka.
Kuda kuti sero rimwe nerimwe revatatu riratidze nhamba nhatu dzose. Sero rine mbiri pane nhatu rakanaka, chero pasina sero rine anokwanisa ari kunze kweseti.
faq: Vaviri vari pachena chii muSudoku?
Masero maviri mune boka rimwe ose ane vanokwanisa vaviri vakafanana chaizvo. Nhamba mbiri idzodzo dzakakiiwa mumasero maviri iwayo, saka dzinogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero eboka.
Vatatu vari pachena chii?

Masero matatu mune boka rimwe ane vanokwanisa vavo pamwe chete vari nhamba nhatu chete. Sero rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuva nembiri kana nhatu dzadzo. Nhamba nhatu dzinozadza masero matatu, saka dzinogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero eboka.
Vaviri vari pachena vanoisa nhamba here?

Kwete voga. Vanobvisa vanokwanisa, uye kubvisa ikoko kazhinji kunosiya mumwe chete kana nzvimbo imwe chete. Chinongedzo mu Bare Sudoku chinoratidza izvozvo uye chinotumidza nzira yakazviita kuti zvigoneke.
Vaviri vari pachena vanogona kuva mubhokisi nemumutsara panguva imwe chete here?
Hongu. Kana masero maviri acho achigovana mutsara nebhokisi, vaviri ivavo vanobvisa mumapoka ose ari maviri. Bare Sudoku inozvibata boka rimwe panguva.

hidden-pairs.name: Vaviri nevatatu vakavanda
hidden-pairs.title: Vaviri nevatatu vakavanda muSudoku: maonero avo
hidden-pairs.description: Vaviri vakavanda inhamba mbiri dzinogona kuenda mumasero maviri mamwe chete eboka, saka vamwe vanokwanisa vemasero iwayo vanobviswa. Dzidza kuvawana.
hidden-pairs.h1: Vaviri nevatatu vakavanda (hidden pair, hidden triple)
hidden-pairs.summary: Vaviri vakavanda inhamba mbiri dzinova vanokwanisa, mumutsara, koramu kana bhokisi rimwe, mumasero maviri mamwe chete uye kwete kumwe kupi zvako. Masero maviri iwayo anofanira kuva nenhamba mbiri idzodzo, saka vamwe vanokwanisa vose vari mauri vanogona kubviswa. Vatatu vakavanda vanoshanda zvimwe chetezvo nenhamba nhatu dzakavharirwa mumasero matatu. Mushure mekubvisa, masero anoratidza vaviri kana vatatu vari pachena. Chinongedzo che Bare Sudoku chinoisa zita rekuti "Vaviri kana vatatu" pakuisa kunotevera.
when: Kana boka riine masero ane vanokwanisa vakawanda uye mumwe chete nenzvimbo imwe chete zvapera. Vaviri vakavanda vanohwanda mukati memasero akazara, ndosaka zvakakodzera kuvatsvaga chaipo panenge pasingaoneki vaviri vari pachena. Vatatu vakavanda havawanzowanikwa; Bare Sudoku inovaongorora, asi zvirahwe zvizhinji zveKuoma zvinogadziriswa pasina ivo.
spot: Shanda nenhamba, kwete nesero. Mune boka, cherechedza masero angaenda nhamba yega yega isipo. Kana nhamba mbiri imwe neimwe ichingova nemasero maviri chete anogoneka uye ari masero maviri mamwe chete, wawana vaviri vakavanda. Mumutambo, baya kiyi yenhamba kuti uvhenekere vanokwanisa vayo; kana nhamba mbiri dzichivhenekera masero maviri mamwe chete eboka pasina chimwe chinhu mariri, ndicho chimiro.

steps: Mu{unit}, nhamba {d1} uye {d2} imwe neimwe ine masero maviri chete anogoneka, uye ndiwo maviri mamwe chete: {cells}.
Masero maviri iwayo anofanira kutora nhamba {d1} uye {d2}, saka vamwe vanokwanisa vawo havagoneki.
Bvisa {elim}. Zvino masero maviri aya anoratidza vaviri vari pachena, izvo zvinogona kuvhura zvimwe.

mistakes: Kubvisa nhamba mbiri dzevaviri mumasero evaviri. Vamwe vanokwanisa vemasero iwayo ndivo vanobviswa; nhamba dzevaviri dzinosara.
Kugamuchira nhamba ine sero rechitatu rinogoneka mune boka. Nhamba dzose dziri mbiri dzinofanira kuganhurirwa kumasero maviri iwayo chete.
Kutarisa mumabhokisi chete. Vaviri vakavanda vanooneka kakawanda mumitsara nemumakoramu sezvavanoita mumabhokisi.
faq: Vaviri vakavanda chii muSudoku?
Nhamba mbiri dzinogona kuenda chete mumasero maviri mamwe chete eboka. Masero iwayo anofanira kutora nhamba idzodzo, saka vamwe vanokwanisa vawo vanobviswa.
Vaviri vakavanda vanosiyana sei nevaviri vari pachena?

Vaviri vari pachena vanooneka: masero maviri anoratidza vanokwanisa vaviri vakafanana chete. Vaviri vakavanda vakafukidzwa nevamwe vanokwanisa vekuwedzera mumasero maviri iwayo. Kubvisa vekuwedzera ivavo kunoshandura vaviri vakavanda kuva vaviri vari pachena.
Vatatu vakavanda chii?
Nhamba nhatu dzakavharirwa mumasero matatu eboka. Nhamba imwe neimwe haifaniri kuoneka mumasero ose matatu; chinokosha ndechekuti hapana panhamba nhatu idzi ine anokwanisa kunze kwemasero iwayo.
Chinongedzo chinosiyanisa vaviri vakavanda nevari pachena here?
Kwete. Bare Sudoku inowana vose uye inoisa zita rekuti "Vaviri kana vatatu" pakuisa kunotevera. Mapeji aya anovaparadzanisa nekuti vanowanikwa nenzira dzakasiyana.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing muSudoku: mashandiro anoita nzira iyi
x-wing.description: X-Wing: nhamba ine masero maviri chete evanokwanisa mumitsara miviri, mumakoramu maviri mamwe chete, inobviswa mune mamwe masero emakoramu iwayo.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing chimiro chenhamba imwe nemasero mana ari pamakona erekitangi. Kana nhamba iine masero maviri chete evanokwanisa mune imwe neimwe yemitsara miviri, uye masero iwayo ari mumakoramu maviri mamwe chete, nhamba inofanira kugara pamakona maviri akatarisana erekitangi. Saka inogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero ose emakoramu maviri iwayo. Zvinoshandawo kana mitsara nemakoramu zvachinjaniswa. Ndiyo nzira yekutanga yeNyanzvi mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Kana mumwe chete, nzvimbo imwe chete, vanokwanisa vakakiiwa nevaviri nevatatu zvapera. X-Wing ndicho chimiro cheNyanzvi chinonyanya kuwanikwa uye kazhinji chinooneka kana nhamba yasara nevanokwanisa vashoma, kazhinji kana kopi ina kusvika nhanhatu dzatoiswa. Chinoda manotsi akakwana enhamba yauri kuongorora.
spot: Sarudza nhamba uye tsvaga mitsara ine masero maviri chete evanokwanisa venhamba iyoyo. Kana mitsara miviri yakadaro ichigovana makoramu maviri mamwe chete, ongorora makoramu iwayo kuti uone vamwe vanokwanisa venhamba: ndivo vanobviswa. Wozodzokorora uchishandisa makoramu sehwaro. Mumutambo, baya kiyi yenhamba: anokwanisa wayo wese anovhenekerwa, uye rekitangi remanotsi mana akavhenekerwa riri nyore kuona.

steps: Nhamba {d} ine masero maviri chete evanokwanisa mumutsara {r1} uye maviri chete mumutsara {r2}, uye akatevedzana mumakoramu maviri mamwe chete, {c1} uye {c2}: {cells}.
Mutsara {r1} unoisa {d} yawo mukoramu {c1} kana {c2}, uye mutsara {r2} unoisa {d} yawo mune imwe yacho. Chero zvakadini, koramu {c1} nekoramu {c2} imwe neimwe inowana {d} kubva kumitsara miviri iyi.
Saka {d} haigoni kuoneka kumwe kupi zvako mumakoramu {c1} uye {c2}. Bvisa {d} mumasero {elim}.

mistakes: Kushandisa mutsara une masero matatu evanokwanisa venhamba. Mutsara wega wega wehwaro unofanira kuva nemaviri chete, uye ose ari maviri anofanira kuva mumakoramu maviri anogovaniswa.
Kubvisa nhamba mumitsara pachinzvimbo chemumakoramu. Kana mitsara iri hwaro, kubvisa kunoitwa mumakoramu, uye zvakapesana.
Kukanganwa mhando yakachinjaniswa. X-Wing yakavakwa pamakoramu inobvisa mumitsara.
faq: X-Wing chii muSudoku?

Nhamba ine masero maviri chete evanokwanisa mune imwe neimwe yemitsara miviri, mumakoramu maviri mamwe chete. Nhamba inogara pamakona maviri akatarisana erekitangi iroro, saka inobviswa mune mamwe masero emakoramu maviri. Mitsara nemakoramu zvinogona kuchinjaniswa.
Sei X-Wing ichishanda?

Mutsara wega wega pamitsara miviri unofanira kuisa nhamba mune imwe yemakoramu maviri, uye mitsara miviri iyi haigoni kushandisa koramu imwe chete. Saka koramu imwe neimwe inowana kopi yayo yenhamba kubva kumitsara iyi, uye vamwe vanokwanisa vose mumakoramu iwayo havagoneki.
X-Wing ihove here?
Hongu. X-Wing ihove yemitsara miviri; Swordfish ihove yemitsara mitatu. Bare Sudoku inowana dzose.
Izinga ripi rine maX-Wing?
Nyanzvi. Chirahwe chinoda X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish kana XYZ-Wing chinoyerwa seNyanzvi.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing muSudoku: mashandiro anoita nzira iyi
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): sero repakati rine vanokwanisa vaviri nemapapiro maviri anogovana mumwe wavo zvinobvisa nhamba mumasero anoona mapapiro ose.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, inonziwo XY-Wing, inoshandisa masero matatu ane vanokwanisa vaviri rimwe nerimwe. Sero repakati rine vanokwanisa X uye Y. Bapiro rekutanga rinoona sero repakati uye rine X uye Z; bapiro rechipiri rinoona sero repakati uye rine Y uye Z. Chero sero repakati rikava chii, rimwe remapapiro rinofanira kuva Z, saka Z inogona kubviswa musero rimwe nerimwe rinoona mapapiro ose ari maviri. Inzira yeNyanzvi mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Kana chirahwe chine masero akati wandei ane vanokwanisa vaviri chete uye pasina hove iripo. MaY-Wing anowanikwa kazhinji muzvirahwe zveNyanzvi uye anowanikwa nekutevera masero evanokwanisa vaviri: rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuva sero repakati kana bapiro.
spot: Nyora masero ane vanokwanisa vaviri chete. Parimwe nerimwe, riite sero repakati rine vanokwanisa X uye Y, uye tsvaga pakati pevavakidzani varo sero rine X nenhamba imwe Z, nesero rine Y neZ iyoyo. Masero maviri iwayo ndiwo mapapiro. Wozotsvaga masero anoona mapapiro ose ari maviri uye ane Z. Cherechedza kuti mapapiro haafaniri kuonana.

steps: Sero repakati {pivot} rine vanokwanisa {x} uye {y}. Rinoona {wingA}, rine {x} uye {z}, uye {wingB}, rine {y} uye {z}.
Kana {pivot} riri {x}, {wingA} rinorasikirwa ne{x} rova {z}. Kana {pivot} riri {y}, {wingB} rova {z}. Rimwe remapapiro maviri rinova {z} pazviitiko zvose.
Sero rinoona mapapiro ose ari maviri harimbogoni kuva {z}. Bvisa {z} mumasero {elim}.

mistakes: Kusarudza mapapiro asingaoni sero repakati ose ari maviri. Bapiro rimwe nerimwe rinofanira kugovana mutsara, koramu kana bhokisi nesero repakati.
Kubvisa Z mumasero anoona bapiro rimwe chete. Sero rinobviswa rinofanira kuona mapapiro ose ari maviri.
Kubvisa Z musero repakati. MuY-Wing sero repakati harina Z; kana riinayo, chimiro ichocho iXYZ-Wing ine mitemo yakasiyana.
faq: Y-Wing chii muSudoku?

Masero matatu evanokwanisa vaviri: sero repakati rine X uye Y, bapiro rine X uye Z rinoona sero repakati, nebapiro rine Y uye Z rinoona sero repakati. Rimwe bapiro nguva dzose rinova Z, saka Z inobviswa mumasero anoona mapapiro ose ari maviri.
Y-Wing yakafanana neXY-Wing here?
Hongu. Mazita maviri aya anotsanangura chimiro chimwe chete. Bare Sudoku inochidana kuti Y-Wing.
Sei rimwe bapiro richifanira kuva Z?
Kana sero repakati riri X, bapiro rekutanga rinorasikirwa neX rova Z. Kana sero repakati riri Y, bapiro rechipiri rova Z. Sero repakati nderimwe rezviviri izvi, saka rimwe bapiro rinova Z.
Y-Wing inobvisa mumasero mangani?
Kazhinji rimwe kana maviri: masero chete anoona mapapiro ose ari maviri uye achine Z. Izvozvo zvakakwana kugadzira mumwe chete kana nzvimbo imwe chete.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish muSudoku: mashandiro anoita nzira iyi
swordfish.description: Swordfish: nhamba yakavharirwa mumakoramu matatu mumitsara mitatu inobviswa mune mamwe masero emakoramu iwayo. Hove yemitsara mitatu, nemuenzaniso chaiwo.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish iX-Wing ine mitsara mitatu nemakoramu matatu. Kana nhamba iine masero asingapfuuri matatu evanokwanisa mune imwe neimwe yemitsara mitatu, uye masero iwayo ose achiwira mumakoramu matatu mamwe chete, mitsara mitatu inopedza nhamba iyoyo mumakoramu iwayo, uye nhamba inogona kubviswa mune mamwe masero ose emakoramu matatu. Mitsara nemakoramu zvinogona kuchinjaniswa. Bare Sudoku inotsvaga Swordfish mushure meY-Wing, muzvirahwe zveNyanzvi.
when: Kana X-Wing neY-Wing zvisina zvawana. MaSwordfish haawanikwi kakawanda semaX-Wing uye anoda nhamba ine vanokwanisa vakapararira zvishoma pamitsetse mitatu. Anoda manotsi akakwana uye akarurama enhamba iyoyo.
spot: Sarudza nhamba uye tsvaga mitsara ine masero maviri kana matatu evanokwanisa vayo. Kana mitsara mitatu yakadaro ichingovhara makoramu matatu chete pamwe chete, ongorora makoramu iwayo kuti uone vamwe vanokwanisa venhamba. Hazvidi kuti mutsara wega wega uve neanokwanisa mukoramu yega yega: Swordfish inogona kuva nemasero matanhatu, manomwe, masere kana mapfumbamwe. Mumutambo, vhenekera nhamba nekiyi yayo uye tsvaga mitsara mitatu ine vanokwanisa vakatevedzana mumakoramu matatu.

steps: Nhamba {d} ine masero asingapfuuri matatu evanokwanisa mune imwe neimwe yemitsara {rows}, uye masero iwayo ose anowira mumakoramu {cols}: {cells}.

Mutsara wega wega pamitsara mitatu unofanira kuisa {d} yawo mune imwe yemakoramu matatu, uye hapana mitsara miviri ingashandisa koramu imwe chete. Saka makoramu matatu anowana {d} yawo kubva kumitsara mitatu iyi.
Chero mumwe anokwanisa we{d} mumakoramu {cols} haagoneki. Bvisa {d} mumasero {elim}.

mistakes: Kuda masero ose mapfumbamwe. Swordfish ine vanokwanisa vaviri mune dzimwe mitsara ichiri yakarurama, chero mitsara mitatu ichingovhara makoramu matatu chete.
Kuisa mutsara une masero mana evanokwanisa. Mutsara wega wega wehwaro unofanira kuva nemasero asingapfuuri matatu, ose ari mukati memakoramu matatu.
Kubvisa mumitsara yehwaro. Kana mitsara iri hwaro, kubvisa kunoitwa mumakoramu matatu, kunze kwemitsara yehwaro.
faq: Swordfish chii muSudoku?

Nhamba ine vanokwanisa vayo mumitsara mitatu vakavharirwa mumakoramu matatu. Mitsara mitatu inofanira kuisa nhamba mumakoramu matatu iwayo, imwe mune imwe neimwe, saka nhamba inobviswa mune mamwe masero emakoramu iwayo.
Swordfish inosiyana sei neX-Wing?
Muhukuru chete: X-Wing inoshandisa mitsara miviri nemakoramu maviri, Swordfish mitatu nematatu. Kufunga kwacho kwakafanana.
Swordfish inoda masero mapfumbamwe chaiwo here?
Kwete. Mutsara wega wega unogona kuva nevanokwanisa vaviri kana vatatu; chimiro chinongoda kuti mitsara mitatu pamwe chete isashandise makoramu anopfuura matatu.
Pane hove yemitsara mina here?
Hongu, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku haiishandisi, nekuti zvirahwe zvayo hazvimboidi.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing muSudoku: mashandiro anoita nzira iyi
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: sero repakati rine vanokwanisa vatatu nemapapiro maviri anogovana mumwe wavo zvinobvisa nhamba iyoyo mumasero anoona ose matatu.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing iY-Wing ine sero repakati rine vanokwanisa vatatu. Sero repakati rine X, Y uye Z; bapiro rimwe rinoona sero repakati uye rine X uye Z, rimwe rinoona sero repakati uye rine Y uye Z. Rimwe remasero matatu rinofanira kuva Z, saka Z inogona kubviswa musero rimwe nerimwe rinoona ose matatu. Sezvo sero repakati pacharo richigona kuva Z, sero rinobviswa rinofanira kuona sero repakati pamwe nemapapiro ose ari maviri, izvo zvinoriganhurira kubhokisi kana mutsetse unogovaniswa nemasero aya. Ndiyo nzira yakaoma kupfuura dzose inoshandiswa ne Bare Sudoku.
when: Chete kana zvimwe zvose zvakundikana. MaXYZ-Wing ndicho chimiro chisingawanzowanikwi kupfuura zvose mu Bare Sudoku uye anooneka chete muzvirahwe zveNyanzvi. Atsvage kana sero revanokwanisa vatatu riri mubhokisi rimwe nesero revanokwanisa vaviri rinogovana nhamba mbiri dzaro.
spot: Tanga nemasero ane vanokwanisa vatatu chete; rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuva sero repakati. Pakati pevavakidzani varo, tsvaga masero maviri ane vanokwanisa vaviri rimwe nerimwe, vose vachibva pavatatu vesero repakati, vanogovana nhamba imwe chete Z. Wozotsvaga masero anoona sero repakati nemapapiro ose ari maviri uye ane Z. Muchiitiko chaicho bapiro rimwe riri mubhokisi resero repakati uye rimwe mumutsara waro kana mukoramu yaro, uye masero anobviswa ndiwo masero akasara ebhokisi iroro ari mumutsara iwoyo kana mukoramu iyoyo.

steps: Sero repakati {pivot} rine vanokwanisa vatatu: {x}, {y} uye {z}. Rinoona {wingA} rine {x} uye {z}, uye {wingB} rine {y} uye {z}.
Kana {pivot} riri {z}, zvapera. Kana riri {x}, {wingA} rinofanira kuva {z}. Kana riri {y}, {wingB} rinofanira kuva {z}. Pazviitiko zvose rimwe remasero matatu rinova {z}.
Sero rinoona ose matatu harigoni kuva {z}. Bvisa {z} mumasero {elim}.

mistakes: Kubvisa mumasero anoona mapapiro maviri chete. Kusiyana neY-Wing, sero repakati rinogona kuva Z, saka sero rinofanira kuonawo sero repakati.
Kushandisa mapapiro ane vanokwanisa vasiri vose mukati mevanokwanisa vatatu vesero repakati.
Kuivhiringa neY-Wing: musiyano ndiye anokwanisa wechitatu musero repakati, uye anoshandura kuti ndeapi masero angacheneswa.
faq: XYZ-Wing chii muSudoku?

Sero repakati rine vanokwanisa X, Y uye Z nemapapiro maviri, rimwe rine X uye Z uye rimwe rine Y uye Z, ose achiona sero repakati. Rimwe remasero matatu rinova Z, saka Z inobviswa mumasero anoona ose matatu.
XYZ-Wing inosiyana sei neY-Wing?

Sero repakati rine vanokwanisa vatatu pachinzvimbo chevaviri, kusanganisira Z. Izvi zvinoita kuti sero repakati rive nzvimbo inogoneka yeZ, saka masero chete anoona sero repakati nemapapiro ose ari maviri ndiwo angarasikirwa neZ.
XYZ-Wing inowanzooneka kangani?
Kashoma. Mu Bare Sudoku zvirahwe zveNyanzvi chete ndizvo zvingaida XYZ-Wing, uye zvizhinji hazviidi. Bare Sudoku inoiongorora pakupedzisira, mushure meX-Wing, Y-Wing neSwordfish.
Pane WXYZ-Wing here?
Hongu, ine sero repakati revanokwanisa vana, asi Bare Sudoku haiishandisi. Chirahwe chimwe nechimwe mumutambo chinogona kupedzwa nenzira pfumbamwe dzegwara iri.

rw.learnText: Uri mushya muri Sudoku, cyangwa waheze ku kibazo gikomeye? Imfashanyigisho ebyiri zisobanura amategeko n'uburyo bwose bwo gukemura inama zikoresha, buri buryo bufite urugero nyarwo.

howTo.title: Uko Sudoku ikinwa: amategeko, urubuga n'intambwe za mbere
howTo.description: Iga gukina Sudoku: amategeko, uko imirongo, inkingi n'udusanduku bikora, impamvu buri kibazo gifite igisubizo kimwe, inyandiko n'intambwe za mbere.
howTo.summary: Sudoku ni ikibazo cy'ubwenge gikinirwa ku rubuga rwa 9×9. Uzuza buri kazu k'ubusa umubare kuva kuri 1 kugeza kuri 9 ku buryo buri murongo, buri nkingi na buri gasanduku ka 3×3 birimo buri mubare rimwe gusa. Imibare imwe itangwa mu ntangiriro; indi uyibona ukoresheje ubwenge, akazu ku kandi, buri gihe ufite ikizere, kandi ntuzigera ukenera gukeka. Iyi mfashanyigisho isobanura urubuga, amategeko, ihame ry'igisubizo kimwe, inyandiko n'ingamba yoroshye y'intambwe zawe za mbere. Ushobora kwitoza byose muri [Bare Sudoku](play), ni ubuntu kandi ifite inama zisobanura uko bitekerezwa.

sections.h: Amategeko ya Sudoku ni ayahe?
p: Hari amategeko atatu gusa, kandi ni itegeko rimwe rirebwa mu mpande eshatu: buri murongo ugomba kugira imibare 1 kugeza 9, buri nkingi igomba kugira imibare 1 kugeza 9, na buri gasanduku ka 3×3 kagomba kugira imibare 1 kugeza 9. Bityo umubare ntushobora kugaragara kabiri ku murongo umwe, mu nkingi imwe cyangwa mu gasanduku kamwe.

Imibare yatanzwe, yanditse ibyibushye, ntihinduka. Akazi kawe ni ukuzuza utuzu tw'ubusa. Nta kubara kurimo kandi nta ruhererekane: imibare ni ibimenyetso icyenda bitandukanye gusa. Wakina ukoresheje inyuguti cyangwa amashusho kandi nta cyahinduka.

sections.h: Urubuga ruteye rute?
p: Urubuga rufite utuzu 81 mu mirongo 9 n'inkingi 9. Imbibi zibyibushye zirugabanyamo udusanduku icyenda twa 3×3. Buri kazu kari ku murongo umwe gusa, mu nkingi imwe gusa no mu gasanduku kamwe gusa, kandi ayo matsinda atatu ni yo matsinda yako. Utundi tuzu 20 dusangiye itsinda n'akazu twitwa abaturanyi bako; umubare ushyizwe mu kazu ukuraho uwo mubare mu baturanyi bose 20.

Utuzu twandikwa nka r3c7: umurongo wa 3, inkingi ya 7. Imirongo ibarwa uhereye hejuru, inkingi uhereye ibumoso, naho udusanduku kuva kuri 1 kugeza kuri 9 uhereye hejuru ibumoso, umurongo ku wundi. Uyu mwandikire ukoreshwa muri buri mfashanyigisho y'uburyo kandi ni byiza kuwumenya: r5c5 ni hagati y'urubuga.

sections.h: Kuki buri Sudoku ifite igisubizo kimwe gusa?
p: Sudoku nyayo ifite igisubizo kimwe, kandi ni cyo gituma ubwenge bukora. Igihe cyose ushoboye kwerekana ko umubare udashobora kujya ahandi hose mu itsinda, ugomba kujya mu kazu gasigaye, kuko igisubizo kiriho kandi ari kimwe gusa. Iyo ikibazo kiba gifite ibisubizo bibiri, nta bitekerezo byashoboraga kubitandukanya kandi igihe runaka wari guhatirwa gukeka.

Bare Sudoku ikora buri kibazo ku gikoresho cyawe kandi igenzura ko gifite igisubizo kimwe gusa kandi ko umukemuzi wayo w'ubwenge ashobora kukirangiza akoresheje uburyo bw'urwego wahisemo. Bityo niba waheze, buri gihe hari intambwe ikurikira yo kubona, kandi inama irayikwereka.

sections.h: Utangira ute ikibazo cya Sudoku?
p: Tangirira aho bifunganye kurusha ahandi. Uru ruhererekane rukora kuri buri rwego:
list: Hitamo umubare umaze kugaragara inshuro nyinshi, urugero esheshatu cyangwa zirindwi, maze ushake udusanduku tutarawugira. Akenshi hasigara akazu kamwe gusa mu gasanduku kawo: uwo ni [umwanya umwe gusa](hidden-single).

Shaka utuzu tukikijwe n'imibare myinshi. Akazu umurongo wako, inkingi yako n'agasanduku kako bifatanyije birimo imibare umunani itandukanye gasigaranye umukandida umwe gusa: uwo ni [umukandida umwe gusa](naked-single). Utuzu turi ku mirongo cyangwa mu dusanduku hafi yo kuzura ni ho heza ho kureba.
Buri mubare ushyize ukuraho umukandida mu baturanyi 20, bityo genzura abo baturanyi ako kanya. Umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa bikunze gukurikirana nk'urunigi.

Iyo gushyira byoroshye birangiye, andika inyandiko: abakandida ba buri kazu k'ubusa. Hanyuma shaka umubare ufungiranye ku murongo umwe cyangwa mu nkingi imwe imbere mu gasanduku ([abakandida bafunze](locked-candidates)) cyangwa utuzu tubiri dufite abakandida babiri bamwe ([babiri bagaragara](naked-pairs)).
Garuka ku mukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa nyuma ya buri gukuraho. N'ibibazo by'Inzobere bikemurwa ahanini na byo; uburyo buhanitse bufungura intambwe ikurikira gusa.

sections.h: Inyandiko ni iki kandi uzikoresha ryari?
p: Inyandiko, zitwa kandi ibimenyetso by'ikaramu cyangwa abakandida, ni imibare mito wandika mu kazu k'ubusa kugira ngo wibuke imibare igishoboka aho. Mu bibazo byoroshye ntukunze kuzikenera; guhera kuri Bigoye kuzamura ni ingenzi cyane, kuko uburyo nka babiri, X-Wing na Y-Wing bureba abakandida, si imibare yashyizwe.

Komeza inyandiko zibe nyazo: iyo ushyize umubare, uwukure mu nyandiko z'abaturanyi bose 20. Muri Bare Sudoku ibi biba byikora, kandi Uzuza inyandiko yandika buri mukandida muri buri kazu k'ubusa ukanze rimwe, bityo ushobora gutangirana n'abakandida bose kandi nyabo. Inyandiko ni ukuri, si ugukeka: bisobanura ko nta kintu kirabuza uyu mubare.

sections.h: Wakora iki niba waheze?
p: Banza usubiremo iby'ibanze: buri murongo, buri nkingi na buri gasanduku hafi kuzura ni isoko y'umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa. Hanyuma wemeze ko inyandiko zuzuye, kuko umukandida ubura ahisha amashusho naho umukandida utakiri ukuri akora amashusho y'ibinyoma. Hanyuma ukoreshe [uburyo](techniques) bukurikije uko bugoye: abakandida bafunze, babiri na batatu, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish na XYZ-Wing. Buri buryo bufite urupapuro rwabwo n'urugero nyarwo.

Niba nta cyakunze, fata inama. Muri Bare Sudoku inama ibanza kugenzura niba umubare washyizwe ari mubi, hanyuma igashaka akazu gakurikira gashobora kuzuzwa hakoreshejwe ubwenge kandi ikavuga izina ry'uburyo, bityo wiga ikintu n'iyo uyikoresheje. Kanda inama nanone kugira ngo ushyire umubare.

sections.h: Winjiza ute imibare muri Bare Sudoku?
p: Kanda akazu, hanyuma umubare. Cyangwa kanda umubare mbere: urafungwa, kandi buri kazu ukanze karawakira, ubu ni bwo buryo bwihuse bwo gushyira kopi ya gatandatu, iya karindwi n'iya munani y'umubare. Kanda umubare nanone kugira ngo uwurekure. Buto ya Inyandiko ihindurira ku bimenyetso by'ikaramu, Siba isiba akazu, Subiza inyuma isubiza inyuma intambwe iyo ari yo yose, kandi amakosa agaragazwa mu mutuku keretse ubihagaritse muri menu.

Ku mwandikisho, koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugenda, 1 kugeza 9 kwinjiza umubare, Backspace gusiba, N ku nyandiko, U gusubiza inyuma, H ku nama, F kuzuza inyandiko na Escape kuri menu. Umukino wibika ubwawo, ukora nta interineti kandi nta matangazo cyangwa konti bigira.

faq: Ese muri Sudoku ujya ukenera gukeka?

Oya, mu kibazo nyacyo. Buri kibazo cya Bare Sudoku gifite igisubizo kimwe gusa kandi cyagenzuwe ko gishobora gukemurwa n'ubwenge bwonyine, kugeza ku buryo bw'urwego rwacyo. Niba wumva ugomba gukeka, hari umukandida ubura mu nyandiko zawe cyangwa uburyo butegereje kubonwa.
Ese umubare ushobora kugaragara kabiri ku murongo, mu nkingi cyangwa mu gasanduku?

Oya. Iryo ni ryo tegeko ryose: buri murongo mu mirongo icyenda, buri nkingi mu nkingi icyenda na buri gasanduku mu dusanduku icyenda birimo buri mubare kuva kuri 1 kugeza kuri 9 rimwe gusa. Niba imibare ibiri isa isangiye itsinda, nibura umwe muri yo ni mubi.
Itandukaniro hagati ya Byoroshye, Hagati, Bigoye n'Inzobere ni irihe?

Urwego rugenwa n'uburyo ikibazo gikenera. Byoroshye na Hagati bikemurwa n'umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa byonyine, kandi Byoroshye itangirana nibura n'imibare 38 yatanzwe. Bigoye ikenera abakandida bafunze cyangwa babiri na batatu. Inzobere ikenera X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish cyangwa XYZ-Wing.
Ese ni byiza kuzuza inyandiko muri buri kazu cyangwa muri tumwe gusa?

Ku bibazo bya Bigoye n'Inzobere, uzuze zose: amashusho nka babiri, X-Wing na Y-Wing agaragara gusa iyo buri mukandida yanditswe. Kuri Byoroshye na Hagati, inyandiko ni ku bushake kandi abakinnyi benshi bashakisha umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa n'amaso gusa.
Sudoku imara igihe kingana iki?

Ikibazo cya Byoroshye kimara iminota mike; ibibazo by'Inzobere bishobora kumara iminota makumyabiri cyangwa irenga, bitewe n'uko ubona vuba ishusho ihanitse. Bare Sudoku yerekana igihe, igihagarika iyo menu ifunguye kandi ntibika urutonde rw'abatsinze, bityo kina ku muvuduko wawe.
Ese Sudoku isaba kubara?
Oya. Imibare ni ibimenyetso gusa; nta guteranya cyangwa kubara birimo. Ibimenyetso ibyo ari byo byose icyenda byakora, kandi ni yo mpamvu Sudoku ari ikibazo cy'ubwenge aho kuba ikibazo cy'imibare.

index.title: Uburyo bwo gukemura Sudoku busobanuwe n'ingero
index.description: Uburyo icyenda bwose bwo gukemura Sudoku, kuva ku mukandida umwe gusa kugeza kuri Swordfish na XYZ-Wing, uko inama za Bare Sudoku zibukoresha, n'ingero nyazo.
intro: Buri Sudoku ishobora gukemurwa n'uburyo buke bw'ubwenge. Uru rutonde rugaragaza uburyo icyenda umukemuzi wa Bare Sudoku n'inama zayo bakoresha, bukurikije uko umukemuzi abugerageza: mbere umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa, hanyuma gukuraho imbere mu itsinda rimwe, hanyuma amashusho akwira imirongo n'inkingi byinshi. Buri buryo bufite urupapuro rwabwo ruriho ibisobanuro, uko wabubona, urugero nyarwo ruvuye mu kibazo cyakozwe n'amakosa akunze gukorwa.

Urwego rw'ikibazo rugenwa n'uburyo bugoye cyane gikenera. Ibibazo bya Byoroshye na Hagati bikenera umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa byonyine, ibibazo bya Bigoye bikenera abakandida bafunze cyangwa babiri na batatu, naho ibibazo by'Inzobere bikenera nibura ifi imwe cyangwa ibaba rimwe. Uko urwego rwaba rumeze kose, umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa ni byo bikora igice kinini cy'akazi; uburyo buhanitse bukuraho umukandida umwe cyangwa babiri, maze ibyo byombi bigakomeza kuva aho.
faq: Nkwiye kugerageza uburyo bwa Sudoku nkurikije uruhe ruhererekane?

Ubworoshye mbere: umukandida umwe gusa, umwanya umwe gusa, abakandida bafunze, babiri na batatu bagaragara, babiri na batatu bihishe, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku ibugerageza neza neza muri uru ruhererekane, kandi inama buri gihe ivuga uburyo bworoshye kurusha ubundi butuma utera imbere.
Ese nkeneye ubu buryo bwose kugira ngo nkemure Sudoku?

Ku bibazo bya Byoroshye na Hagati, umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa birahagije. Ibibazo bya Bigoye byongeraho abakandida bafunze na babiri na batatu. Ibibazo by'Inzobere bikenera nibura ifi imwe cyangwa ibaba rimwe, ariko akenshi rimwe cyangwa kabiri gusa mu kibazo.
Ese hari uburyo bugoye kurusha XYZ-Wing?

Yego, urugero iminyururu, ibizamini by'igisubizo kimwe n'inshundura zihatira. Bare Sudoku ntikora ibibazo bibukenera, bityo buri kibazo cyo mu mukino gishobora kurangizwa n'uburyo icyenda buri kuri uru rupapuro.
Umukandida ni iki?

Umubare ugishobora kujya mu kazu k'ubusa kuko nta kintu kiri ku murongo wako, mu nkingi yako cyangwa mu gasanduku kako kirawubuza. Inyandiko zo mu mukino ni abakandida. Uburyo bwose burenze umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa butekereza ku bakandida, bityo ubagumishe bose kandi ari nyabo.

naked-single.name: Umukandida umwe gusa
naked-single.title: Umukandida umwe gusa muri Sudoku: akazu k'ihitamo rimwe
naked-single.description: Umukandida umwe gusa ni akazu k'ubusa gafite umubare umwe rukumbi ushoboka. Iga kukabona vuba, ukoresheje urugero nyarwo intambwe ku yindi n'amakosa akunze.
naked-single.summary: Umukandida umwe gusa ni akazu k'ubusa gafite umukandida umwe nyirizina: indi mibare umunani isanzwe iri ku murongo wako, mu nkingi yako cyangwa mu gasanduku kako. Umubare usigaye ugomba kujya aho. Ni bwo buryo bworoshye kurusha ubundi muri Sudoku, ubwo ukoresha kenshi, kandi ni bwo inama ya Bare Sudoku itangaza ivuga iti "Umukandida umwe gusa hano".
when: Buri gihe. Umukandida umwe gusa agaragara kuva ku ntambwe ya mbere kugeza ku ya nyuma, kuri buri rwego. Mu bibazo bya Byoroshye na Hagati, hamwe n'umwanya umwe gusa, ni bwo buryo bwonyine ukenera. Mu bibazo bigoye, buri gukuraho gukozwe n'uburyo buhanitse akenshi gusiga umukandida umwe gusa, bityo umushake nyuma ya buri ntambwe.
spot: Reba utuzu dufite abaturanyi benshi bafite imibare: akazu kari ku murongo umaze kugira imibare irindwi, cyangwa akazu umurongo wako, inkingi yako n'agasanduku kako bifatanyije birimo imibare umunani itandukanye. Nta nyandiko, bara imibare ubona uhereye ku kazu. Ufite inyandiko, umukandida umwe gusa ni akazu kerekana umukandida umwe gusa, ni yo mpamvu Uzuza inyandiko ituma aboneka byoroshye.

steps: Reba {cell}. Ni ubusa, bityo andika buri mubare umaze gushyirwa ku murongo wako, mu nkingi yako no mu gasanduku kako.
Umurongo wa {row} urimo {rowDigits}. Inkingi ya {col} irimo {colDigits}. Agasanduku ka {box} karimo {boxDigits}.
Byose hamwe bikuraho imibare yose uretse {d}, bityo {d} ni we mukandida wenyine usigaye muri {cell}.
Andika {d} muri {cell}. Hanyuma genzura niba umubare mushya utera undi mukandida umwe gusa cyangwa undi mwanya umwe gusa kuri uwo murongo, muri iyo nkingi cyangwa muri ako gasanduku.

mistakes: Kubara umurongo gusa cyangwa agasanduku gusa. Imibare umunani ikurwaho akenshi ituruka mu matsinda uko ari atatu hamwe.
Kwibagirwa ko umubare umaze gushyira na wo ukuraho abakandida mu baturanyi bawo 20; umukandida umwe gusa mushya agaragara ako kanya nyuma ya buri gushyira.
Kwitiranya umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa: umukandida umwe gusa bivuze ko mu kazu hasigaye umukandida umwe, umwanya umwe gusa bivuze ko mu itsinda hasigaye akazu kamwe k'umubare.
faq: Umukandida umwe gusa ni iki muri Sudoku?
Akazu k'ubusa gafite umukandida umwe nyirizina. Imibare umunani itandukanye yamaze gushyirwa ku murongo wako, mu nkingi yako no mu gasanduku kako, bityo umubare wa cyenda ni wo wonyine ukwiriye.
Kuki mu Cyongereza witwa "naked", ugaragara?
Kubera ko umukandida wenyine agaragara neza mu kazu iyo inyandiko zanditswe; nta kimuhisha. Umwanya umwe gusa wo uri hagati y'abandi bakandida kandi uboneka urebye umubare aho kureba akazu.
Ese ikibazo gishobora gukemurwa n'umukandida umwe gusa wenyine?

Ibibazo byinshi bya Byoroshye birashoboka, ariko ibyinshi bikenera n'umwanya umwe gusa. Bare Sudoku ifata ibibazo bya Byoroshye na Hagati nk'ibikemurwa n'ubwo bwoko bwombi; ibibazo bya Bigoye n'Inzobere bikenera nibura ubundi buryo bumwe.
Ese inama yerekana umukandida umwe gusa?
Yego. Iyo gushyira gukurikira ari umukandida umwe gusa, inama ihitamo akazu ikavuga iti "Umukandida umwe gusa hano" hamwe n'umubare. Kanda inama nanone kugira ngo uwushyire.

hidden-single.name: Umwanya umwe gusa
hidden-single.title: Umwanya umwe gusa muri Sudoku: aho umubare wajya honyine
hidden-single.description: Umwanya umwe gusa ni akazu konyine ku murongo, mu nkingi cyangwa mu gasanduku umubare ugishobora kujyamo. Iga kuwubona usuzuma umubare umwe umwe.
hidden-single.summary: Umwanya umwe gusa ni umubare usigaranye akazu kamwe gusa gashoboka ku murongo, mu nkingi cyangwa mu gasanduku, n'ubwo ako kazu kaba kerekana abandi bakandida. Kubera ko itsinda rigomba kugira uwo mubare, ujya aho. Inama ya Bare Sudoku iwutangaza ivuga iti "Umwanya umwe gusa wa 5 kuri uyu murongo", cyangwa kuri iyi nkingi cyangwa muri aka gasanduku.
when: Igihe cyose umubare umaze gutera imbere: iyo umubare umaze kugaragara inshuro eshanu cyangwa esheshatu, udusanduku dusigaye tuba dufunganye cyane, kandi akenshi umwanya umwe gusa ni yo ntambwe ikurikira. Umwanya umwe gusa ni uburyo nyamukuru bw'ibibazo bya Byoroshye na Hagati kandi ukomeza kuba uburyo bukora cyane kuri buri rwego.
spot: Suzuma umubare umwe umwe. Fata umubare, ushake agasanduku katawufite, maze ukureho buri kazu k'ako gasanduku gasangiye umurongo cyangwa inkingi na kopi y'uwo mubare yashyizwe. Niba hasigaye akazu kamwe, wabonye umwanya umwe gusa. Iri suzuma rikora no ku mirongo no ku nkingi. Mu mukino, kanda umubare washyizwe: buri kopi yawo iragaragazwa, bityo utuzu twisanzuye tukigaragaza.

steps: Agasanduku ka {box} ntikaragira {d}, bityo kamwe mu tuzu twako tw'ubusa kagomba kuwugira. Utuzu tw'ubusa ni {empties}.
Muri buri kamwe muri two uretse {cell}, umubare {d} ubuzwa n'undi {d} wamaze gushyirwa ku murongo cyangwa mu nkingi bihuriyeho, bityo {d} si umukandida aho.
Ibyo bisiga {cell} ari wo mwanya wonyine wa {d} mu gasanduku ka {box}. Andika {d} aho, n'ubwo {cell} gashobora kuba kakigaragaza abandi bakandida.

mistakes: Gushyira umubare mu kazu gashobora kuba ari ko gusa: genzura buri kazu k'ubusa k'itsinda, si utugaragara gusa.
Kutabona umwanya umwe gusa kubera ko akazu kerekana abakandida benshi. Abandi bakandida nta cyo batwaye; icy'ingenzi ni uko umubare nta handi ufite mu itsinda.
Gusuzuma udusanduku gusa. Imirongo n'inkingi bitanga imyanya imwe gusa kenshi nk'udusanduku, cyane cyane ku mpera.
faq: Umwanya umwe gusa ni iki muri Sudoku?
Umubare ushobora kujya mu kazu kamwe gusa k'umurongo, inkingi cyangwa agasanduku. Itsinda rigomba kugira uwo mubare, bityo ako kazu kaba kamenyekanye n'ubwo kagifite abandi bakandida.
Itandukaniro hagati y'umwanya umwe gusa n'umukandida umwe gusa ni irihe?
Umukandida umwe gusa areba akazu: hasigaye umukandida umwe. Umwanya umwe gusa ureba umubare: hasigaye akazu kamwe mu itsinda. Byombi bishyira umubare nta gushidikanya.
Ni ikihe cyoroshye kubona?

Nta nyandiko, umwanya umwe gusa akenshi uroroshye kuko ushobora gusuzuma urubuga umubare umwe umwe. Ufite inyandiko zuzuye, umukandida umwe gusa ni we woroshye kurusha, kuko akazu gafite umukandida umwe kigaragaza.
Inama isobanura ite umwanya umwe gusa?
Ivuga iti "Umwanya umwe gusa wa" umubare kuri uyu murongo, kuri iyi nkingi cyangwa muri aka gasanduku, akazu kahiswemo. Kanda inama nanone kugira ngo uwushyire.

locked-candidates.name: Abakandida bafunze
locked-candidates.title: Abakandida bafunze muri Sudoku: kwerekeza no kwiyegurira
locked-candidates.description: Abakandida bafunze: iyo abakandida b'umubare mu gasanduku bari ku murongo umwe cyangwa mu nkingi imwe, cyangwa ibinyuranye, umubare ukurwaho ahandi.
locked-candidates.summary: Abakandida bafunze ni bwo buryo bwa mbere bukuraho abakandida aho gushyira umubare. Bufite ubwoko bubiri. Kwerekeza: mu gasanduku, abakandida bose b'umubare bari ku murongo umwe cyangwa mu nkingi imwe, bityo umubare ukurwa mu tundi tuzu tw'uwo murongo cyangwa iyo nkingi. Kwiyegurira: ku murongo cyangwa mu nkingi, abakandida bose b'umubare bari mu gasanduku kamwe, bityo umubare ukurwa mu tundi tuzu tw'ako gasanduku. Inama ya Bare Sudoku yita "Abakandida bafunze" gushyira ubu buryo bufungura.
when: Iyo umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa birangiye mu kibazo cya Bigoye, ubu ni bwo buryo bwa mbere bwo kugerageza. Bukenera inyandiko zuzuye nibura ku mubare usuzuma. Abakandida bafunze bakunze kuboneka: ibibazo byinshi bya Bigoye birabakenera, kandi ibibazo by'Inzobere bibakoresha hagati y'amashusho manini.
spot: Ku kwerekeza, reba buri gasanduku na buri mubare kabura: niba utuzu tw'abakandida b'uwo mubare turi ku murongo umwe cyangwa mu nkingi imwe, genzura niba uwo mubare ukigaragara nk'umukandida kure kuri uwo murongo cyangwa muri iyo nkingi hanze y'agasanduku. Ku kwiyegurira, reba ku murongo cyangwa mu nkingi: niba abakandida bose b'umubare bari imbere mu gasanduku kamwe, utundi tuzu tw'ako gasanduku dushobora gusukurwa. Mu mukino, kanda buto y'umubare kugira ngo ugaragaze buri mukandida wawo; umurongo w'inyandiko ebyiri cyangwa eshatu zigaragajwe imbere mu gasanduku kamwe ni yo shusho.

steps: Mu gasanduku ka {box}, umubare {d} ufite utu tuzu gusa tw'abakandida: {cells}. Twose turi ku murongo wa {row}.
Agasanduku ka {box} gakeneye {d}, bityo {d} w'umurongo wa {row} uri imbere mu gasanduku ka {box}, aho waba uguye hose muri utwo tuzu.
Umurongo wa {row} ntushobora kugira {d} wa kabiri, bityo kuraho {d} mu tuzu tw'umurongo wa {row} turi hanze y'agasanduku: {elim}.
Ku murongo wa {row}, umubare {d} ushobora kujya gusa muri {cells}, kandi twose turi imbere mu gasanduku ka {box}.
Umurongo wa {row} ugomba kugira {d}, bityo umurongo wa {row} wiyegurira {d} w'agasanduku ka {box}. Utundi tuzu tw'agasanduku ka {box} ntidushobora kugira {d}.
Kuraho {d} muri {elim}.

mistakes: Gukuraho umubare imbere mu gasanduku aho kuwukuraho hanze yako mu kwerekeza, cyangwa ibinyuranye mu kwiyegurira. Gukuraho buri gihe bijya mu tuzu turi ku murongo cyangwa mu nkingi ariko tutari mu gasanduku, cyangwa turi mu gasanduku ariko tutari kuri uwo murongo cyangwa iyo nkingi.
Gukoresha iri tegeko iyo abakandida bakwiriye ku mirongo ibiri y'agasanduku. Utuzu twose tw'abakandida b'umubare mu gasanduku tugomba kuba ku murongo umwe cyangwa mu nkingi imwe.
Kwibagirwa gushaka umukandida umwe gusa cyangwa umwanya umwe gusa uturuka ku gukuraho. Abakandida bafunze ntibakunze gushyira umubare ubwabo; bategura intambwe yoroshye ikurikira.
faq: Abakandida bafunze ni iki muri Sudoku?

Abakandida b'umubare bafungiranye aho agasanduku gahurira n'umurongo cyangwa inkingi. Kubera ko agasanduku, cyangwa umurongo, bigomba kugira umubare muri iryo huriro, umubare ushobora gukurwa mu bindi bice by'umurongo, cyangwa mu bindi bice by'agasanduku.
Itandukaniro hagati yo kwerekeza no kwiyegurira ni irihe?

Kwerekeza bihera ku gasanduku: abakandida b'umubare mu gasanduku berekeza ku murongo umwe cyangwa inkingi imwe, bityo umubare ukurwa mu bindi bice by'uwo murongo cyangwa iyo nkingi. Kwiyegurira bihera ku murongo cyangwa ku nkingi: abakandida b'umubare bose baho bari mu gasanduku kamwe, bityo umurongo cyangwa inkingi byiyegurira umubare ugakurwa mu bindi bice by'agasanduku.
Ese abakandida bafunze bitwa kandi intersection removal?
Yego. Andi mazina ni box-line reduction ku bwoko bwo kwiyegurira na pointing pairs cyangwa pointing triples ku bwoko bwo kwerekeza. Bare Sudoku ikoresha izina rimwe kuri byombi.
Ni uruhe rwego rukenera abakandida bafunze?
Bigoye. Ikibazo gikenera abakandida bafunze cyangwa babiri na batatu ariko nta kindi kigoye kurushaho gifatwa nka Bigoye; ibibazo by'Inzobere bikenera kandi ifi cyangwa ibaba.

naked-pairs.name: Babiri na batatu bagaragara
naked-pairs.title: Babiri na batatu bagaragara muri Sudoku: uko bikora
naked-pairs.description: Babiri na batatu bagaragara: utuzu tubiri cyangwa dutatu two mu itsinda rimwe dufite abakandida bamwe. Iga kubabona n'icyo ukuraho, n'ingero nyazo.
naked-pairs.h1: Babiri na batatu bagaragara (naked pair, naked triple)
naked-pairs.summary: Babiri bagaragara ni utuzu tubiri turi ku murongo umwe, mu nkingi imwe cyangwa mu gasanduku kamwe dufite abakandida babiri bamwe neza neza. Iyo mibare ibiri igomba kujya muri utwo tuzu tubiri, bityo ishobora gukurwa mu tundi tuzu twose tw'itsinda. Batatu bagaragara ni igitekerezo kimwe n'utuzu dutatu n'imibare itatu; buri kazu gashobora kwerekana ibiri cyangwa itatu yose. Inama ya Bare Sudoku yita "Babiri cyangwa batatu" gushyira gukurikiraho.
when: Nyuma y'uko inyandiko zuzuye kandi umukandida umwe gusa, umwanya umwe gusa n'abakandida bafunze birangiye. Babiri bagaragara bakunze kuboneka cyane mu bibazo bya Bigoye, batatu bagaragara ntibakunze. Byombi bikwiye kugenzurwa muri buri tsinda rigifite utuzu dutanu cyangwa turenga tw'ubusa.
spot: Shaka utuzu dufite abakandida babiri gusa maze ushake akandi kazu mu itsinda rimwe gafite abo babiri. Kuri batatu, reba amatsinda afite utuzu twinshi tw'abakandida babiri n'abatatu maze ugenzure niba dutatu muri two hamwe dukoresha imibare itatu itandukanye gusa. Utuzu dufite abakandida bamwe neza neza turoroshye kubona iyo inyandiko zanditswe; Uzuza inyandiko mu mukino ibikora ukanze rimwe.

steps: Utuzu {cellA} na {cellB} two mu {unit} dufite abakandida babiri bamwe neza neza: {d1} na {d2}.
Kamwe muri two kagomba kuba {d1} akandi kakaba {d2}. Ntituzi ako ari ko, ariko imibare yombi ifatwa n'utu tuzu tubiri.
Bityo nta kandi kazu ko mu {unit} gashobora kugira {d1} cyangwa {d2}. Kuraho {elim}.
Mu {unit}, utuzu dutatu dufite abakandida bose bava mu mibare itatu imwe, {digits}: {cells}.
Iyo mibare itatu igomba kuzuza utu tuzu dutatu mu buryo runaka. Akazu ntikagomba kwerekana abakandida batatu bose; icy'ingenzi ni uko nta kazu muri dutatu gafite umukandida uri hanze y'iyo mibare.
Kuraho {digits} mu tundi tuzu twose two mu {unit}: {elim}.

mistakes: Gufata utuzu tubiri dusangiye abakandida babiri ariko dufite n'uwa gatatu. Kuri babiri bagaragara, buri kazu kagomba kugira abo bakandida babiri gusa, nta wundi.
Gukuraho imibare mu tuzu tw'ababiri ubwatwo. Ababiri bagumana abakandida babo; gukuraho bijya mu tundi tuzu tw'itsinda.
Gusaba ko buri kazu k'abatatu kerekana imibare itatu yose. Akazu gafite ibiri muri itatu nta kibazo, igihe cyose nta kazu gafite umukandida uri hanze y'iyo mibare.
faq: Babiri bagaragara ni iki muri Sudoku?
Utuzu tubiri two mu itsinda rimwe twombi dufite abakandida babiri bamwe neza neza. Iyo mibare ibiri ifungiranye muri utwo tuzu tubiri, bityo ishobora gukurwa mu bindi bice by'itsinda.
Batatu bagaragara ni iki?

Utuzu dutatu two mu itsinda rimwe abakandida batwo hamwe ari imibare itatu gusa. Buri kazu gashobora kugira ibiri cyangwa itatu muri yo. Imibare itatu yuzuza utuzu dutatu, bityo ishobora gukurwa mu tundi tuzu tw'itsinda.
Ese babiri bagaragara bashyira umubare?
Ubwabo oya. Bakuraho abakandida, kandi uko gukuraho akenshi gusiga umukandida umwe gusa cyangwa umwanya umwe gusa. Inama muri Bare Sudoku yerekana ibyo kandi ivuga uburyo bwabishobotse.
Ese babiri bagaragara bashobora kuba mu gasanduku no ku murongo icyarimwe?
Yego. Niba utwo tuzu tubiri dusangiye umurongo n'agasanduku, ababiri bakuraho mu matsinda yombi. Bare Sudoku ibikora itsinda rimwe rimwe.

hidden-pairs.name: Babiri na batatu bihishe
hidden-pairs.title: Babiri na batatu bihishe muri Sudoku: uko wababona
hidden-pairs.description: Babiri bihishe ni imibare ibiri ishobora kujya gusa mu tuzu tubiri tumwe tw'itsinda, bityo abandi bakandida b'utwo tuzu barakurwaho. Iga kubabona.
hidden-pairs.h1: Babiri na batatu bihishe (hidden pair, hidden triple)
hidden-pairs.summary: Babiri bihishe ni imibare ibiri, ku murongo, mu nkingi cyangwa mu gasanduku, ari abakandida mu tuzu tubiri tumwe gusa kandi nta handi. Utwo tuzu tubiri tugomba kugira iyo mibare ibiri, bityo abandi bakandida bose badurimo bashobora gukurwaho. Batatu bihishe bakora kimwe n'imibare itatu ifungiranye mu tuzu dutatu. Nyuma yo gukuraho, utwo tuzu twerekana babiri cyangwa batatu bagaragara. Inama ya Bare Sudoku yita "Babiri cyangwa batatu" gushyira gukurikiraho.
when: Iyo itsinda rifite utuzu dufite abakandida benshi kandi umukandida umwe gusa n'umwanya umwe gusa birangiye. Babiri bihishe bihisha mu tuzu twuzuye, ni yo mpamvu ari byiza kubashaka neza aho babiri bagaragara batagaragara. Batatu bihishe ni gake; Bare Sudoku irabagenzura, ariko ibibazo byinshi bya Bigoye bikemurwa batariho.
spot: Kora ukurikije umubare, si akazu. Mu itsinda, andika utuzu buri mubare ubura ushobora kujyamo. Niba imibare ibiri buri umwe ufite utuzu tubiri gusa dushoboka kandi ari utuzu tubiri tumwe, wabonye babiri bihishe. Mu mukino, kanda buto y'umubare kugira ngo ugaragaze abakandida bawo; niba imibare ibiri igaragaza utuzu tubiri tumwe tw'itsinda kandi nta kindi kiririmo, iyo ni yo shusho.

steps: Mu {unit}, imibare {d1} na {d2} buri umwe ufite utuzu tubiri gusa dushoboka, kandi ni tubiri tumwe: {cells}.
Utwo tuzu tubiri tugomba kugira {d1} na {d2}, bityo abandi bakandida batwo ntibashoboka.
Kuraho {elim}. Ubu utwo tuzu tubiri twerekana babiri bagaragara, bishobora gufungura ibindi.

mistakes: Gukuraho imibare ibiri y'ababiri mu tuzu tw'ababiri. Ni abandi bakandida b'utwo tuzu bakurwaho; imibare y'ababiri igumaho.
Kwemera umubare ufite akazu ka gatatu gashoboka mu itsinda. Imibare yombi igomba kugarukira kuri utwo tuzu tubiri gusa.
Kureba mu dusanduku gusa. Babiri bihishe baboneka kenshi ku mirongo no mu nkingi nk'uko baboneka mu dusanduku.
faq: Babiri bihishe ni iki muri Sudoku?
Imibare ibiri ishobora kujya gusa mu tuzu tubiri tumwe tw'itsinda. Utwo tuzu tugomba gufata iyo mibare, bityo abandi bakandida batwo barakurwaho.
Babiri bihishe batandukanye bate na babiri bagaragara?

Babiri bagaragara barabonwa: utuzu tubiri twerekana abakandida babiri bamwe gusa. Babiri bihishe batwikiriwe n'abakandida b'inyongera muri utwo tuzu tubiri. Gukuraho abo b'inyongera bihindura babiri bihishe babiri bagaragara.
Batatu bihishe ni iki?
Imibare itatu ifungiranye mu tuzu dutatu tw'itsinda. Buri mubare ntugomba kugaragara mu tuzu dutatu twose; icy'ingenzi ni uko nta mubare muri iyo itatu ufite umukandida hanze y'utwo tuzu.
Ese inama itandukanya babiri bihishe na babiri bagaragara?
Oya. Bare Sudoku ibona bombi kandi yita "Babiri cyangwa batatu" gushyira gukurikiraho. Izi mpapuro zibatandukanya kuko baboneka mu buryo butandukanye.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing muri Sudoku: uko ubu buryo bukora
x-wing.description: X-Wing: umubare ufite utuzu tubiri gusa tw'abakandida ku mirongo ibiri, mu nkingi ebyiri zimwe, ukurwa mu tundi tuzu tw'izo nkingi. Urugero nyarwo.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing ni ishusho y'umubare umwe n'utuzu tune turi mu mfuruka z'urukiramende. Niba umubare ufite utuzu tubiri gusa tw'abakandida kuri buri murongo mu mirongo ibiri, kandi utwo tuzu turi mu nkingi ebyiri zimwe, umubare ugomba kuba mu mfuruka ebyiri ziteganye z'urukiramende. Bityo ushobora gukurwa mu tundi tuzu twose tw'izo nkingi ebyiri. Bikora kimwe iyo imirongo n'inkingi bihinduranyijwe. Ni bwo buryo bwa mbere bw'Inzobere muri Bare Sudoku.
