naked-pairs.h1: Awiri ndi atatu owonekera (naked pairs)
naked-pairs.summary: Awiri owonekera ndi maselo awiri mu mzere, kolamu kapena bokosi limodzi omwe ali ndi opikisana awiri omwewo basi. Manambala awiriwo ayenera kupita m'maselo awiriwo, choncho angachotsedwe mu selo lina lililonse la gululo. Atatu owonekera ndi lingaliro lomwelo ndi maselo atatu ndi manambala atatu; selo lililonse lingaonetse awiri kapena onse atatu. Chithandizo cha Bare Sudoku chimatchula kuika komwe kumatsatira kuti "Awiri kapena atatu".
when: Zolemba zikakhala zathunthu ndipo ma single ndi opikisana otsekedwa atha. Awiri owonekera ndi ofala kwambiri mu puzzle za Zovuta, atatu owonekera ocheperapo. Onse ndi oyenera kuwafufuza mu gulu lililonse lomwe lidakali ndi maselo opanda kanthu asanu kapena kuposerapo.
spot: Yang'anani maselo omwe ali ndi opikisana awiri okha ndipo pezani selo lina mu gulu lomwelo lomwe lili ndi awiri omwewo. Pa atatu, yang'anani magulu omwe ali ndi maselo angapo a opikisana awiri kapena atatu ndipo onani ngati atatu mwa iwo pamodzi amagwiritsa ntchito manambala atatu osiyana okha. Maselo omwe ali ndi opikisana omwewo ndendende ndi osavuta kuwaona zolemba zikalembedwa; Lembani zolemba zonse mu masewera imachita zimenezo ndi kudina kamodzi.

steps: {cellA} ndi {cellB} mu {unit} ali ndi opikisana awiri omwewo ndendende: {d1} ndi {d2}.
Limodzi mwa iwo liyenera kukhala {d1} ndipo linalo {d2}. Sitikudziwa kuti ndi liti, koma manambala onse awiri agwiritsidwa ntchito ndi maselo awiriwa.
Choncho palibe selo lina la {unit} lomwe lingakhale ndi {d1} kapena {d2}. Chotsani {elim}.
Maselo atatu a {unit} amatenga opikisana awo onse kuchokera ku manambala atatu omwewo, {digits}: {cells}.

Manambala atatuwo ayenera kudzaza maselo atatuwa mwa dongosolo lina. Selo silifunika kuonetsa opikisana onse atatu; chofunika ndi chakuti palibe selo mwa atatuwo lomwe lili ndi wopikisana kunja kwa manambala atatuwo.
Chotsani {digits} mu selo lina lililonse la {unit}: {elim}.

mistakes: Kutenga maselo awiri omwe amagawana opikisana awiri koma ali ndi wachitatu. Pa awiri owonekera, selo lililonse liyenera kukhala ndi opikisana awiriwo basi, palibe wina.
Kuchotsa manambala m'maselo a awiriwo omwe. Awiriwo amasunga opikisana awo; kuchotsa kumapita ku maselo ena a gululo.
Kufuna kuti selo lililonse la atatu lionetse manambala onse atatu. Selo lokhala ndi awiri mwa atatuwo lili bwino, bola palibe selo lomwe lili ndi wopikisana kunja kwa manambala atatuwo.
faq: Kodi awiri owonekera mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?
Maselo awiri mu gulu limodzi omwe onse ali ndi opikisana awiri omwewo basi. Manambala awiriwo atsekeredwa m'maselo awiriwo, choncho angachotsedwe m'maselo ena onse a gululo.
Kodi atatu owonekera ndi chiyani?

Maselo atatu mu gulu limodzi omwe opikisana awo pamodzi ndi manambala atatu okha. Selo lililonse lingakhale ndi awiri kapena atatu mwa iwo. Manambala atatuwo amadzaza maselo atatuwo, choncho angachotsedwe m'maselo ena a gululo.
Kodi awiri owonekera amaika nambala?

Osati paokha. Amachotsa opikisana, ndipo kuchotsako kawirikawiri kumasiya wopikisana mmodzi yekha kapena malo amodzi okha. Chithandizo mu Bare Sudoku chimaonetsa single imeneyo ndipo chimatchula njira imene inaipangitsa kukhala yotheka.
Kodi awiri owonekera angakhale mu bokosi ndi mzere nthawi imodzi?
Inde. Ngati maselo awiriwo amagawana mzere ndi bokosi, awiriwo amachotsa opikisana m'magulu onse awiri. Bare Sudoku imawagwira gulu limodzi pa nthawi.

hidden-pairs.name: Awiri ndi atatu obisika
hidden-pairs.title: Awiri ndi Atatu Obisika mu Sudoku: Momwe Mungawapezere
hidden-pairs.description: Awiri obisika ndi manambala awiri omwe angapite m'maselo awiri omwewo a gulu okha, choncho opikisana ena amachoka. Phunzirani kuwapeza pang'onopang'ono.
hidden-pairs.h1: Awiri ndi atatu obisika (hidden pairs)
hidden-pairs.summary: Awiri obisika ndi manambala awiri omwe, mu mzere, kolamu kapena bokosi limodzi, ali opikisana m'maselo awiri omwewo osati kwina kulikonse. Maselo awiriwo ayenera kukhala ndi manambala awiriwo, choncho wopikisana wina aliyense m'maselowo angachotsedwe. Atatu obisika amagwira ntchito chimodzimodzi ndi manambala atatu otsekeredwa m'maselo atatu. Pambuyo pochotsa, maselowo amaonetsa awiri kapena atatu owonekera. Chithandizo cha Bare Sudoku chimatchula kuika komwe kumatsatira kuti "Awiri kapena atatu".
when: Pamene gulu lili ndi maselo okhala ndi opikisana ambiri ndipo ma single atha. Awiri obisika amabisala mkati mwa maselo odzaza, ndichifukwa chake ndi oyenera kuwafufuza ndendende pomwe awiri owonekera sakuoneka. Atatu obisika ndi osowa; Bare Sudoku imawafufuza, koma puzzle zambiri za Zovuta zimathetsedwa popanda iwo.
spot: Gwirani ntchito motsatira nambala, osati selo. Mu gulu, lembani maselo omwe nambala iliyonse yosowa ingapiteko. Ngati manambala awiri, iliyonse ili ndi maselo awiri okha otheka ndipo ndi maselo awiri omwewo, mwapeza awiri obisika. Mu masewera, dinani batani la nambala kuti muwunikire opikisana ake; ngati manambala awiri awunikira maselo awiri omwewo a gulu osati kwina kulikonse mmenemo, ndiwo kapangidwe kake.

steps: Mu {unit}, manambala {d1} ndi {d2} iliyonse ili ndi maselo awiri okha otheka, ndipo ndi awiri omwewo: {cells}.
Maselo awiriwo ayenera kukhala ndi {d1} ndi {d2}, choncho opikisana awo ena ndi osatheka.
Chotsani {elim}. Tsopano maselo awiriwo akuonetsa awiri owonekera, zomwe zingatsegule zina.

mistakes: Kuchotsa manambala awiri a awiriwo m'maselo awo. Ndi opikisana ena a maselowo omwe amachoka; manambala a awiriwo amatsala.
Kuvomereza nambala yomwe ili ndi selo lachitatu lotheka mu gululo. Manambala onse awiri ayenera kukhala m'maselo awiriwo okha.
Kuyang'ana m'mabokosi okha. Awiri obisika amapezeka kawirikawiri chimodzimodzi mu mizere ndi makolamu.
faq: Kodi awiri obisika mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?
Manambala awiri omwe angapite m'maselo awiri omwewo a gulu okha. Maselowo ayenera kutenga manambala amenewo, choncho opikisana awo ena amachotsedwa.
Kodi awiri obisika amasiyana bwanji ndi awiri owonekera?

Awiri owonekera amaoneka: maselo awiri omwe amaonetsa opikisana awiri omwewo okha. Awiri obisika amaphimbidwa ndi opikisana owonjezera m'maselo awiriwo. Kuchotsa zowonjezerazo kumasandutsa awiri obisika kukhala awiri owonekera.
Kodi atatu obisika ndi chiyani?

Manambala atatu otsekeredwa m'maselo atatu a gulu. Nambala iliyonse siyenera kuonekera m'maselo onse atatu; chofunika ndi chakuti palibe nambala mwa atatuwo yomwe ili ndi wopikisana kunja kwa maselowo.
Kodi chithandizo chimasiyanitsa awiri obisika ndi owonekera?
Ayi. Bare Sudoku imapeza onse awiri ndipo imatchula kuika komwe kumatsatira kuti "Awiri kapena atatu". Masamba ano amawalekanitsa chifukwa amapezeka m'njira zosiyana.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing mu Sudoku: Momwe Njirayi Imagwirira Ntchito
x-wing.description: X-Wing: nambala yokhala ndi maselo opikisana awiri ndendende m'mizere iwiri, m'makolamu awiri omwewo, imachotsedwa m'makolamuwo. Chitsanzo chenicheni.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing ndi kapangidwe ka nambala imodzi ndi maselo anayi pa makona a chithunzi chamakona anayi. Ngati nambalayo ili ndi maselo opikisana awiri ndendende mu mzere uliwonse mwa mizere iwiri, ndipo maselowo ali m'makolamu awiri omwewo, ndiye kuti nambalayo iyenera kukhala pa makona awiri oyang'anizana a chithunzicho. Choncho ingachotsedwe mu selo lina lililonse la makolamu awiriwo. Zomwezo zimagwira ntchito mizere ndi makolamu atasinthana. Ndi njira yoyamba ya Katswiri mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Pamene ma single, opikisana otsekedwa ndi awiri ndi atatu atha. X-Wing ndiye kapangidwe kofala kwambiri ka Katswiri ndipo nthawi zambiri kamaonekera pamene nambala yatsala ndi opikisana ochepa, kawirikawiri ikaikidwa kale kanayi mpaka kasanu ndi kamodzi. Kamafuna zolemba zathunthu za nambala imene mukuiona.
spot: Sankhani nambala ndipo yang'anani mizere yomwe ili ndi maselo opikisana awiri ndendende a nambalayo. Ngati mizere iwiri yotere igawana makolamu awiri omwewo, yang'anani makolamuwo kuti mupeze opikisana ena a nambalayo: amenewo ndiwo oti muchotse. Kenako bwerezani ndi makolamu ngati maziko. Mu masewera, dinani batani la nambalayo: wopikisana wake aliyense amawunikiridwa, ndipo makona anayi a zolemba zowunikiridwa amaonekera mosavuta.

steps: Nambala {d} ili ndi maselo opikisana awiri ndendende mu mzere {r1} ndi awiri ndendende mu mzere {r2}, ndipo ali m'makolamu awiri omwewo, {c1} ndi {c2}: {cells}.

Mzere {r1} umaika {d} yake mu kolamu {c1} kapena {c2}, ndipo mzere {r2} umaika {d} yake mu kolamu inayo. Mulimonse momwe zingakhalire, kolamu {c1} ndi kolamu {c2} iliyonse imalandira {d} kuchokera ku mizere iwiriyi.
Choncho {d} singaonekere kwina kulikonse m'makolamu {c1} ndi {c2}. Chotsani {d} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Kugwiritsa ntchito mzere womwe uli ndi maselo opikisana atatu a nambalayo. Mzere uliwonse wa maziko uyenera kukhala ndi awiri ndendende, ndipo onse ayenera kukhala m'makolamu awiri ogawanidwawo.
Kuchotsa nambala m'mizere m'malo mwa makolamu. Mizere ikakhala maziko, kuchotsa kumachitika m'makolamu, ndipo mosiyana.
Kuiwala mtundu wosinthana. X-Wing yomangidwa pa makolamu imachotsa m'mizere.
faq: Kodi X-Wing mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?

Nambala yomwe ili ndi maselo opikisana awiri ndendende mu mzere uliwonse mwa mizere iwiri, m'makolamu awiri omwewo. Nambalayo imakhala pa makona awiri oyang'anizana a chithunzicho, choncho imachotsedwa m'maselo ena a makolamu awiriwo. Mizere ndi makolamu zingasinthane.
Chifukwa chiyani X-Wing imagwira ntchito?

Mzere uliwonse mwa mizere iwiriyo uyenera kuika nambalayo mu imodzi mwa makolamu awiriwo, ndipo mizere iwiriyo singagwiritse ntchito kolamu imodzi. Choncho kolamu iliyonse mwa ziwirizo imalandira nambala yake kuchokera ku mizere imeneyi, ndipo wopikisana wina aliyense m'makolamuwo ndi wosatheka.
Kodi X-Wing ndi nsomba?
Inde. X-Wing ndi nsomba ya kukula kwa awiri; Swordfish ndi nsomba ya kukula kwa atatu. Bare Sudoku imapeza zonse ziwiri.
Ndi mlingo uti umene uli ndi X-Wing?
Katswiri. Puzzle yomwe imafuna X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish kapena XYZ-Wing imaikidwa pa Katswiri.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing mu Sudoku: Momwe Njirayi Imagwirira Ntchito
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): tsinde la opikisana awiri ndi mapiko awiri ogawana limodzi mwa iwo amachotsa nambala m'selo lililonse loona mapiko onse. Chitsanzo.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, yomwe imatchedwanso XY-Wing, imagwiritsa ntchito maselo atatu, lililonse lili ndi opikisana awiri. Tsinde lili ndi opikisana X ndi Y. Phiko limodzi limaona tsinde ndipo lili ndi X ndi Z; phiko linalo limaona tsinde ndipo lili ndi Y ndi Z. Kaya tsinde likhale chiyani, limodzi mwa mapiko liyenera kukhala Z, choncho Z ingachotsedwe mu selo lililonse lomwe limaona mapiko onse awiri. Ndi njira ya Katswiri mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Pamene puzzle ili ndi maselo angapo okhala ndi opikisana awiri ndendende ndipo palibe nsomba. Y-Wing ndi yofala mu puzzle za Katswiri ndipo imapezeka potsatira maselo a opikisana awiri: lililonse lingakhale tsinde kapena phiko.
spot: Lembani maselo omwe ali ndi opikisana awiri ndendende. Pa lililonse, liyeseni ngati tsinde lokhala ndi opikisana X ndi Y, ndipo yang'anani pakati pa anzake selo lokhala ndi X ndi nambala ina Z, ndi selo lokhala ndi Y ndi Z yomweyo. Awiriwo ndiwo mapiko. Kenako pezani maselo omwe amaona mapiko onse awiri ndipo ali ndi Z. Dziwani kuti mapiko safunika kuonana.

steps: Tsinde {pivot} lili ndi opikisana {x} ndi {y}. Limaona {wingA}, lomwe lili ndi {x} ndi {z}, ndi {wingB}, lomwe lili ndi {y} ndi {z}.
Ngati {pivot} ndi {x}, ndiye {wingA} limataya {x} ndipo limakhala {z}. Ngati {pivot} ndi {y}, ndiye {wingB} limakhala {z}. Mulimonse momwe zingakhalire limodzi mwa mapiko awiriwo ndi {z}.
Selo lomwe limaona mapiko onse awiri silingakhale {z} konse. Chotsani {z} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Kusankha mapiko omwe onse awiri sakuona tsinde. Phiko lililonse liyenera kugawana mzere, kolamu kapena bokosi ndi tsinde.
Kuchotsa Z m'maselo omwe amaona phiko limodzi lokha. Selo lochotsedwalo liyenera kuona mapiko onse awiri.
Kuchotsa Z mu tsinde. Mu Y-Wing tsinde lilibe Z; ngati lili nalo, kapangidweko ndi XYZ-Wing yomwe ili ndi malamulo osiyana.
faq: Kodi Y-Wing mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?

Maselo atatu okhala ndi opikisana awiri: tsinde lokhala ndi X ndi Y, phiko lokhala ndi X ndi Z lomwe limaona tsinde, ndi phiko lokhala ndi Y ndi Z lomwe limaona tsinde. Phiko limodzi nthawi zonse ndi Z, choncho Z imachotsedwa m'maselo omwe amaona mapiko onse awiri.
Kodi Y-Wing ndi yofanana ndi XY-Wing?
Inde. Mayina awiriwo amafotokoza kapangidwe komweko. Bare Sudoku imaitcha Y-Wing.
Chifukwa chiyani phiko limodzi liyenera kukhala Z?
Ngati tsinde ndi X, phiko loyamba limataya X ndipo limakhala Z. Ngati tsinde ndi Y, phiko lachiwiri limakhala Z. Tsinde ndi limodzi mwa awiriwo, choncho phiko limodzi ndi Z.
Kodi Y-Wing imachotsa m'maselo angati?
Kawirikawiri limodzi kapena awiri: maselo okhawo omwe amaona mapiko onse awiri ndipo akadali ndi Z. Zimenezo ndi zokwanira kupanga single.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish mu Sudoku: Momwe Njirayi Imagwirira Ntchito
swordfish.description: Swordfish: nambala yotsekeredwa m'makolamu atatu kudutsa mizere itatu imachotsedwa m'makolamu amenewo. Nsomba ya kukula kwa atatu, ndi chitsanzo chenicheni.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish ndi X-Wing yokhala ndi mizere itatu ndi makolamu atatu. Ngati nambala ili ndi maselo opikisana atatu kapena ochepera mu mzere uliwonse mwa mizere itatu, ndipo maselo onsewo ali m'makolamu atatu omwewo, ndiye kuti mizere itatuyo imagwiritsa ntchito nambalayo m'makolamu amenewo, ndipo nambalayo ingachotsedwe mu selo lina lililonse la makolamu atatuwo. Mizere ndi makolamu zingasinthane. Bare Sudoku imafufuza Swordfish pambuyo pa Y-Wing, mu puzzle za Katswiri.
when: Pamene X-Wing ndi Y-Wing sizikupeza kanthu. Swordfish ndi yosafala kuposa X-Wing ndipo imafuna nambala yomwe opikisana ake afalikira pang'ono pa mizere kapena makolamu atatu. Imafuna zolemba zathunthu komanso zolondola za nambalayo.
spot: Sankhani nambala ndipo yang'anani mizere yokhala ndi maselo opikisana awiri kapena atatu a nambalayo. Ngati mizere itatu yotere ikhudza makolamu atatu okha onse pamodzi, yang'anani makolamuwo kuti mupeze opikisana ena a nambalayo. Si mzere uliwonse umene umafunika wopikisana mu kolamu iliyonse: Swordfish ingakhale ndi maselo asanu ndi limodzi, asanu ndi awiri, asanu ndi atatu kapena asanu ndi anayi. Mu masewera, wunikirani nambalayo ndi batani lake ndipo yang'anani mizere itatu yomwe opikisana ake amagwirizana m'makolamu atatu.

steps: Nambala {d} ili ndi maselo opikisana atatu kapena ochepera mu mzere uliwonse wa mizere {rows}, ndipo maselo onsewo ali m'makolamu {cols}: {cells}.

Mzere uliwonse mwa mizere itatuyo uyenera kuika {d} yake mu imodzi mwa makolamu atatuwo, ndipo mizere iwiri singagwiritse ntchito kolamu imodzi. Choncho makolamu atatuwo amapeza {d} yawo kuchokera ku mizere itatu imeneyi.
Wopikisana wina aliyense wa {d} m'makolamu {cols} ndi wosatheka. Chotsani {d} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Kufuna maselo onse asanu ndi anayi. Swordfish yokhala ndi opikisana awiri m'mizere ina ndi yovomerezeka, bola mizere itatuyo ikhudza makolamu atatu okha.
Kuphatikiza mzere wokhala ndi maselo opikisana anayi. Mzere uliwonse wa maziko uyenera kukhala ndi atatu kapena ochepera, onse m'makolamu atatuwo.
Kuchotsa m'mizere ya maziko. Mizere ikakhala maziko, kuchotsa kumachitika m'makolamu atatuwo, kunja kwa mizere ya maziko.
faq: Kodi Swordfish mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?

Nambala yomwe opikisana ake m'mizere itatu atsekeredwa m'makolamu atatu. Mizere itatuyo iyenera kuika nambalayo m'makolamu atatuwo, imodzi pa kolamu iliyonse, choncho nambalayo imachotsedwa m'maselo ena a makolamuwo.
Kodi Swordfish imasiyana bwanji ndi X-Wing?
Pa kukula kokha: X-Wing imagwiritsa ntchito mizere iwiri ndi makolamu awiri, Swordfish itatu ndi atatu. Kulingalira ndi komweko.
Kodi Swordfish imafuna maselo asanu ndi anayi ndendende?
Ayi. Mzere uliwonse ungakhale ndi opikisana awiri kapena atatu; kapangidweko kamangofuna kuti mizere itatuyo pamodzi isagwiritse ntchito makolamu oposa atatu.
Kodi pali nsomba ya kukula kwa anayi?
Inde, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku siigwiritsa ntchito, chifukwa puzzle zake sizifuna konse.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing mu Sudoku: Momwe Njirayi Imagwirira Ntchito
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: tsinde la opikisana atatu ndi mapiko awiri ogawana limodzi mwa iwo amachotsa nambalayo m'selo lililonse loona onse atatu. Chitsanzo chenicheni.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing ndi Y-Wing yomwe tsinde lake lili ndi opikisana atatu. Tsinde lili ndi X, Y ndi Z; phiko limodzi limaona tsinde ndipo lili ndi X ndi Z, linalo limaona tsinde ndipo lili ndi Y ndi Z. Limodzi mwa maselo atatuwo liyenera kukhala Z, choncho Z ingachotsedwe mu selo lililonse lomwe limaona onse atatu. Chifukwa tsinde lenilenilo likhoza kukhala Z, selo lochotsedwalo liyenera kuona tsinde komanso mapiko onse awiri, zomwe zimalichepetsa ku bokosi kapena mzere kapena kolamu yomwe maselowo amagawana. Ndi njira yovuta kwambiri imene Bare Sudoku imagwiritsa ntchito.
when: Pokhapokha zina zonse zalephera. XYZ-Wing ndiwo kapangidwe kosowa kwambiri mu Bare Sudoku ndipo kamaonekera mu puzzle za Katswiri zokha. Muifufuze pamene selo la opikisana atatu lili mu bokosi limodzi ndi selo la opikisana awiri lomwe limagawana manambala ake awiri.
spot: Yambani ndi maselo omwe ali ndi opikisana atatu ndendende; lililonse lingakhale tsinde. Pakati pa anzake, yang'anani maselo awiri, lililonse lili ndi opikisana awiri otengedwa ku atatu a tsinde, ogawana nambala imodzi yokha Z. Kenako yang'anani maselo omwe amaona tsinde ndi mapiko onse awiri ndipo ali ndi Z. Mwachizolowezi phiko limodzi lili mu bokosi la tsinde ndipo linalo mu mzere kapena kolamu yake, ndipo maselo ochotsedwa ndi maselo otsala a bokosilo mu mzere kapena kolamuyo.

steps: Tsinde {pivot} lili ndi opikisana atatu: {x}, {y} ndi {z}. Limaona {wingA} lokhala ndi {x} ndi {z}, ndi {wingB} lokhala ndi {y} ndi {z}.
Ngati {pivot} ndi {z}, zatha. Ngati ndi {x}, {wingA} liyenera kukhala {z}. Ngati ndi {y}, {wingB} liyenera kukhala {z}. Mulimonse momwe zingakhalire limodzi mwa maselo atatuwo ndi {z}.
Selo lomwe limaona onse atatu silingakhale {z}. Chotsani {z} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Kuchotsa m'maselo omwe amaona mapiko awiri okha. Mosiyana ndi Y-Wing, tsinde likhoza kukhala Z, choncho selo liyenera kuonanso tsinde.
Kugwiritsa ntchito mapiko omwe opikisana awo sali onse mwa opikisana atatu a tsinde.
Kusokoneza ndi Y-Wing: kusiyana ndi wopikisana wachitatu mu tsinde, ndipo kumasintha maselo omwe angachotsedwe.
faq: Kodi XYZ-Wing mu Sudoku ndi chiyani?

Tsinde lokhala ndi opikisana X, Y ndi Z ndi mapiko awiri, limodzi lokhala ndi X ndi Z ndipo lina lokhala ndi Y ndi Z, onse akuona tsinde. Limodzi mwa maselo atatuwo ndi Z, choncho Z imachotsedwa m'maselo omwe amaona onse atatu.
Kodi XYZ-Wing imasiyana bwanji ndi Y-Wing?

Tsinde lili ndi opikisana atatu m'malo mwa awiri, kuphatikizapo Z. Zimenezo zimapangitsa tsinde kukhala malo otheka a Z, choncho maselo okhawo omwe amaona tsinde ndi mapiko onse awiri ndiwo angataye Z.
Kodi XYZ-Wing imaonekera kangati?
Mosowa. Mu Bare Sudoku puzzle za Katswiri zokha ndizo zingaifune, ndipo zambiri siziifuna. Bare Sudoku imaifufuza komaliza, pambuyo pa X-Wing, Y-Wing ndi Swordfish.
Kodi pali WXYZ-Wing?
Inde, yokhala ndi tsinde la opikisana anayi, koma Bare Sudoku siigwiritsa ntchito. Puzzle iliyonse mu masewera ingamalizidwe ndi njira zisanu ndi zinayi za chitsogozo ichi.

om.learnText: Sudoku irratti haaraa dhaa, yookaan hiibboo ulfaataa irratti gufatteettaa? Barnoonni lama seerota fi tooftaalee furmaataa qajeelfamni itti fayyadamu hunda, tokkoon tokkoon isaanii fakkeenya dhugaa waliin ibsu.

howTo.title: Sudoku Taphachuu: Seerota, Gabatee fi Tarkaanfii Jalqabaa
howTo.description: Sudoku taphachuu baradhu: seerota, sararoota, tarreewwan fi saanduqota, hiibboon hundi maaliif furmaata tokko qabu, yaadannoo fi tarkaanfii jalqabaa.
howTo.summary: Sudoku hiibboo yaada qajeelaa gabatee 9×9 irratti taphatamu dha. Kutaa duwwaa hunda lakkoofsa 1 hanga 9 tiin guuti, akka sararri hundi, tarreen hundi fi saanduqni 3×3 hundi lakkoofsa hunda al tokko qofa qabaatuuf. Lakkoofsonni tokko tokko jalqaba irratti kennamu; kan hafan kutaa mirkanaa'aa tokko tokkoon yaada qajeelaan argatta, tilmaamuun immoo gonkumaa si hin barbaachisu. Barnoonni kun gabatee, seerota, seera furmaata tokkoo, yaadannoo fi tooftaa salphaa tarkaanfii kee jalqabaatiif ibsa. Waan kana hunda [Bare Sudoku](play) keessatti shaakaluu dandeessa; bilisaa dha, qajeelfamoota yaada qajeelaa ibsan qaba.

sections.h: Seeronni Sudoku maal fa'i?
p: Seeronni sadii qofa jiru, isaanis seera tokko kallattii sadii irraa ilaalame: sararri hundi lakkoofsota 1 hanga 9 qabaachuu qaba, tarreen hundi lakkoofsota 1 hanga 9 qabaachuu qaba, saanduqni 3×3 hundi immoo lakkoofsota 1 hanga 9 qabaachuu qaba. Kanaaf lakkoofsi tokko sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa tokko keessatti gonkumaa al lama hin mul'atu.

Lakkoofsonni kennaman, kan furdinaan barreeffaman, hin jijjiiraman. Hojiin kee kutaalee duwwaa guutuu dha. Herregni hin jiru, tartiibni hin jiru: lakkoofsonni mallattoo adda addaa sagal qofa. Qubeelee yookaan bocawwaniin taphachuu dandeessa, homtuu hin jijjiiramu.

sections.h: Gabateen akkamitti qindaa'e?
p: Gabateen kutaalee 81 sararoota 9 fi tarreewwan 9 keessatti qaba. Daangaaleen furdoon gabatee saanduqota 3×3 sagalitti qoodu. Kutaan hundi sarara tokko, tarree tokko fi saanduqa tokko qofa keessa jira, gareewwan sadan kunneen immoo gareewwan isaa ti. Kutaaleen biroo 20 kan kutaa sana waliin garee tokko qooddatan hiriyoota isaa jedhamu; lakkoofsi kutaa tokko keessa kaa'ame hiriyoota isaa 20 hunda keessatti lakkoofsa sana ni dhorka.

Kutaaleen akka r3c7 tti barreeffamu: sarara 3, tarree 7. Sararoonni gubbaa irraa, tarreewwan bitaa irraa, saanduqonni 1 hanga 9 immoo gubbaa bitaa irraa jalqabanii sarara sararaan lakkaa'amu. Akkaataan barreeffama kanaa barnoota tooftaa hunda keessatti fayyada, barachuun isaas gatii qaba: r5c5 walakkaa gabatee ti.

sections.h: Sudoku hundi maaliif furmaata tokko qofa qaba?
p: Sudoku sirriin furmaata tokko qaba, kunis kan yaada qajeelaa hojjechiisu dha. Yeroo lakkoofsi tokko garee keessatti bakka biraa seenuu akka hin dandeenye agarsiifte hunda, kutaa hafe keessa seenuu qaba, sababni isaas furmaatni ni jira, tokkichas. Hiibboon tokko furmaata lama yoo qabaate, yaanni qajeelaan kamiyyuu adda isaan baasuu hin danda'u, yeroo tokko tilmaamuuf ni dirqamta.

Bare Sudoku hiibboo hunda meeshaa kee irratti uuma, furmaata tokko qofa akka qabuu fi furaan isaa inni yaada qajeelaan hojjetu tooftaalee sadarkaa filatameetiin xumuruu akka danda'u ni mirkaneeffata. Kanaaf yoo gufatte, yeroo hunda tarkaanfiin itti aanu kan argamu ni jira, qajeelfamnis ni agarsiisa.

sections.h: Hiibboo Sudoku akkamitti jalqabda?
p: Waan baay'ee daanga'e irraa jalqabi. Tartiibni kun sadarkaa hundatti ni hojjeta:
list: Lakkoofsa yeroo baay'ee mul'ate, fakkeenyaaf al jaha yookaan torba, filadhuutii saanduqota ammallee isa hin qabne barbaadi. Yeroo baay'ee saanduqa keessatti kutaan tokko qofa isaaf hafa: sun [bakka tokko qofa](hidden-single) dha.

Kutaalee lakkoofsotaan marfaman ilaali. Kutaan sararri, tarreen fi saanduqni isaa walitti lakkoofsota adda addaa saddeet qaban filatamaa tokko qofa hafe qaba: [filatamaa tokko qofa](naked-single). Kutaaleen sararoota yookaan saanduqota guutamuu ga'an keessa jiran bakka ilaaluuf gaarii dha.
Lakkoofsi ati kaa'itu hundi hiriyoota 20 irraa filatamaa tokko haqa, kanaaf hiriyoota sana battaluma ilaali. Tokkoowwan walitti aananii dhufuu baratu.

Kaa'uun salphaan yoo dhume, yaadannoo barreessi: filatamtoota kutaa duwwaa hundaa. Sana booda lakkoofsa saanduqa tokko keessatti sarara yookaan tarree tokkotti daanga'e ([filatamtoota cufaman](locked-candidates)) yookaan kutaalee lama filatamtoota lama walfakkaatan qaban ([cimdii mul'ataa](naked-pairs)) barbaadi.
Haqiinsa hunda booda gara tokkoowwaniitti deebi'i. Hiibbooleen Ogeessaa illee irra caalaan tokkoowwaniin furamu; tooftaan olaanaan tokkoo itti aanu qofa bana.

sections.h: Yaadannoon maali, yoom itti fayyadamta?
p: Yaadannoon, kan mallattoo irsaasii yookaan filatamtoota jedhamuunis beekamu, lakkoofsota xixiqqoo kutaa duwwaa keessatti barreessitu kan lakkoofsota achitti ammallee danda'aman galmeessanii dha. Hiibboo salphaa keessatti yeroo muraasa qofa si barbaachisa; Ulfaataa irraa jalqabee baay'ee barbaachisaa dha, sababni isaas tooftaaleen akka cimdii, X-Wing fi Y-Wing filatamtoota irratti hundaa'u malee lakkoofsota kaa'aman irratti miti.

Yaadannoo sirrii ta'ee eegi: lakkoofsa yoo kaa'itte, yaadannoo hiriyoota 20 hunda keessaa haqi. Bare Sudoku keessatti kun ofumaan raawwatama, Yaadannoo guuti immoo tuqaa tokkoon filatamaa hunda kutaa duwwaa hunda keessatti barreessa, kanaaf filatamtoota guutuu fi sirrii ta'an irraa jalqabuu dandeessa. Yaadannoon dhugaa dha malee tilmaama miti: waan lakkoofsa kana hanga ammaatti dhorku homtuu hin jiru jechuu dha.

sections.h: Yoo gufatte maal gochuu qabda?
p: Jalqaba bu'uuraalee irra deebi'ii ilaali: sararri, tarreen fi saanduqni guutamuu ga'e hundi madda tokkoowwanii ti. Itti aansuun yaadannoon guutuu ta'uu isaa mirkaneeffadhu, sababni isaas filatamaan dhabame boca dhoksa, filatamaan dullome immoo boca sobaa uuma. Sana booda [tooftaalee](techniques) akka ulfaatina isaaniitti tartiibaan hojjedhu: filatamtoota cufaman, cimdii fi sadii, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish fi XYZ-Wing. Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii fuula mataa isaa fakkeenya dhugaa waliin qaba.

Homtuu yoo hin hojjenne, qajeelfama fudhadhu. Bare Sudoku keessatti qajeelfamni jalqaba lakkoofsi kaa'ame dogoggora ta'uu isaa ilaala, itti aansee kutaa itti aanu kan yaada qajeelaan guutamuu danda'u argee maqaa tooftaa sanaa dhaha, kanaaf yeroo itti fayyadamtu illee waan tokko barachaa jirta. Lakkoofsa sana kaa'uuf qajeelfama irra deebi'ii tuqi.

sections.h: Bare Sudoku keessatti lakkoofsa akkamitti galchita?
p: Kutaa tuqi, itti aansuun lakkoofsa. Yookaan dursa lakkoofsa tuqi: ni cufama, kutaan ati tuqxu hundi isa fudhata; kun karaa saffisaa lakkoofsa tokko al jahaffaa, torbaffaa fi saddeettaffaa kaa'uuti. Gadhiisuuf lakkoofsa sana irra deebi'ii tuqi. Qabduun Yaadannoo gara mallattoo irsaasiitti jijjiira, Haqi kutaa qulqulleessa, Deebisi tarkaanfii kamiyyuu deebisa, dogoggoronni immoo menyuu keessatti yoo hin cufne diimaan mallatteeffamu.

Kiiboordii irratti, socho'uuf furtuuwwan xiyyaa, lakkoofsa galchuuf 1 hanga 9, haquuf Backspace, yaadannoof N, deebisuuf U, qajeelfamaaf H, yaadannoo guutuuf F fi menyuuf Escape fayyadami. Taphni ofumaan olkaa'a, interneetii malee hojjeta, beeksisa fi akkaawuntii hin qabu.

faq: Sudoku keessatti tilmaamuun si barbaachisaa?

Hiibboo sirrii keessatti hin barbaachisu. Hiibboon Bare Sudoku hundi furmaata tokko qofa qaba, yaada qajeelaa qofaan, hanga tooftaalee sadarkaa isaatti, furamuu danda'uun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Tilmaamuu akka qabdu yoo sitti dhaga'ame, filatamaan tokko yaadannoo kee keessaa dhabameera yookaan tooftaan tokko argamuu eegaa jira.
Lakkoofsi tokko sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa keessatti al lama mul'achuu danda'aa?

Lakki. Seerri guutuun kanuma: sararoota sagalan, tarreewwan sagalan fi saanduqota sagalan keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii lakkoofsa 1 hanga 9 hunda al tokko qofa qaba. Lakkoofsonni wal fakkaatan lama garee tokko keessa yoo jiraatan, yoo xiqqaate tokko isaanii dogoggora.
Garaagarummaan Salphaa, Giddu-galeessa, Ulfaataa fi Ogeessa gidduu jiru maali?

Sadarkaan kan murtaa'u tooftaalee hiibboon barbaaduun. Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessi tokkoowwan qofaan furamu, Salphaan immoo yoo xiqqaate lakkoofsota kennaman 38 qabatee jalqaba. Ulfaataan filatamtoota cufaman yookaan cimdii fi sadii barbaada. Ogeessi X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish yookaan XYZ-Wing barbaada.
Kutaa hundaaf yaadannoo guutuu moo kan tokko tokkoof qofa wayya?

Hiibbooleen Ulfaataa fi Ogeessaatiif hunda guuti: bocawwan akka cimdii, X-Wing fi Y-Wing kan mul'atan yeroo filatamaan hundi barreeffame qofa. Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessa keessatti yaadannoon filannoo dha, taphattoonni baay'een tokkoowwan qofa barbaadu.
Sudoku tokko yeroo hammamii fudhata?

Hiibboon Salphaa daqiiqaa muraasa fudhata; hiibbooleen Ogeessaa daqiiqaa digdamii fi isaa ol fudhachuu danda'u, akkaataa ati boca olaanaa ariitiin argattutti. Bare Sudoku sa'aatii agarsiisa, yeroo menyuun banamu ni dhaabsisa, gabatee dorgommii hin qabu, kanaaf saffisa keetiin taphadhu.
Sudoku herrega barbaadaa?
Lakki. Lakkoofsonni mallattoo qofa; ida'uun yookaan lakkaa'uun hin jiru. Mallattoon kamiyyuu sagal ni hojjeta, kanaaf Sudoku hiibboo lakkoofsaa osoo hin taane hiibboo yaada qajeelaa ti.

index.title: Tooftaalee Furmaata Sudoku Fakkeenyaan Ibsaman
index.description: Tooftaalee furmaata Sudoku sagalan, filatamaa tokko qofa irraa hanga Swordfish fi XYZ-Wing, tartiiba qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku itti fayyadamuun, fakkeenyaan.
intro: Sudoku hundi tooftaalee yaada qajeelaa muraasaan furamuu danda'a. Fuulli kun tooftaalee sagalan furaan Bare Sudoku fi qajeelfamoonni isaa itti fayyadaman, tartiiba furaan itti yaalu kaa'a: jalqaba tokkoowwan, itti aansuun haqiinsa garee tokko keessaa, sana booda bocawwan sararoota fi tarreewwan hedduu qaxxaamuran. Tooftaan hundi fuula mataa isaa kan hiika, akkaataa itti argamu, fakkeenya dhugaa hiibboo uumame irraa fudhatame fi dogoggoroota baratamoo qabu qaba.

Sadarkaan hiibboo tokkoo kan murtaa'u tooftaa isa ulfaataa barbaachisuun. Hiibbooleen Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessaa tokkoowwan qofa barbaadu, hiibbooleen Ulfaataa filatamtoota cufaman yookaan cimdii fi sadii barbaadu, hiibbooleen Ogeessaa immoo yoo xiqqaate qurxummii yookaan koola tokko barbaadu. Sadarkaan kamiyyuu yoo ta'e, hojii irra caalu kan hojjetan tokkoowwan; tooftaan olaanaan filatamaa tokko yookaan lama haqa, tokkoowwan achii itti fufu.
faq: Tooftaalee Sudoku tartiiba kamiin yaaluu qaba?

Kan salphaa dursi: filatamaa tokko qofa, bakka tokko qofa, filatamtoota cufaman, cimdii fi sadii mul'ataa, cimdii fi sadii dhokataa, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku tartiiba kanumaan yaala, qajeelfamnis yeroo hunda tooftaa isa salphaa tarkaanfii fidu maqaa dhaha.
Sudoku furuuf tooftaalee kana hunda na barbaachisaa?

Hiibbooleen Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessaatiif tokkoowwan ni ga'u. Hiibbooleen Ulfaataa filatamtoota cufaman fi cimdii fi sadii itti dabalu. Hiibbooleen Ogeessaa yoo xiqqaate qurxummii yookaan koola tokko barbaadu, garuu yeroo baay'ee hiibboo tokko keessatti al tokko yookaan lama qofa.
Tooftaaleen XYZ-Wing caalaa ulfaatan jiruu?

Eeyyee, fakkeenyaaf sansalata, qormaata furmaata tokkichaa fi kiyyoo dirqamsiisaa. Bare Sudoku hiibboo isaan barbaadu hin uumu, kanaaf hiibboon taphicha keessa jiru hundi tooftaalee sagalan fuula kana irra jiraniin xumuramuu danda'a.
Filatamaan maali?

Lakkoofsa kutaa duwwaa keessa ammallee seenuu danda'u, sababni isaas sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa isaa keessaa wanti hanga ammaatti isa dhorku hin jiru. Yaadannoon taphicha keessaa filatamtoota. Tooftaan tokkoowwan caalu hundi filatamtoota irratti yaada, kanaaf guutuu fi sirrii taasisii eegi.

naked-single.name: Filatamaa tokko qofa
naked-single.title: Sudoku: Filatamaa Tokko Qofa, Kutaa Filatamaa Tokko Qabu
naked-single.description: Filatamaan tokko qofa kutaa duwwaa lakkoofsa danda'amu tokko qofa qabu dha. Ariitiin argachuu fakkeenya dhugaa fi dogoggoroota baratamoo waliin baradhu.
naked-single.summary: Filatamaan tokko qofa kutaa duwwaa filatamaa tokkicha qabu dha: lakkoofsonni saddeeti kaan duraanuu sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa isaa keessa jiru. Lakkoofsi hafe achi seenuu qaba. Tooftaa Sudoku isa salphaa, isa ati baay'ee itti fayyadamtu, isa qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku "Asitti filatamaa tokko qofa" jedhee himu dha.
when: Yeroo hunda. Filatamaan tokko qofa tarkaanfii jalqabaa irraa hanga isa dhumaatti, sadarkaa hunda irratti mul'ata. Hiibbooleen Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessaa keessatti, bakka tokko qofa waliin, tooftaa si barbaachisu isa qofa dha. Hiibbooleen ulfaataa keessatti haqiinsi tooftaa olaanaan godhamu hundi yeroo baay'ee filatamaa tokko qofa dhiisa, kanaaf tarkaanfii hunda booda isa barbaadi.
spot: Kutaalee hiriyoota kaa'aman baay'ee qaban ilaali: kutaa sarara lakkoofsota torba duraanuu qabu keessa jiru, yookaan kutaa sararri, tarreen fi saanduqni isaa walitti lakkoofsota adda addaa saddeet qaban. Yaadannoo malee, lakkoofsota kutaa sana irraa argitu lakkaa'i. Yaadannoo waliin, filatamaan tokko qofa kutaa filatamaa tokko qofa agarsiisu dha, kanaafis Yaadannoo guuti isaan argachuu salphisa.

steps: {cell} ilaali. Duwwaa dha, kanaaf lakkoofsota sarara, tarree fi saanduqa isaa keessatti duraanuu kaa'aman hunda tarreessi.
Sararri {row} {rowDigits} qaba. Tarreen {col} {colDigits} qaba. Saanduqni {box} {boxDigits} qaba.
Walitti lakkoofsa {d} malee hunda ni dhorku, kanaaf {d} filatamaa {cell} keessatti hafe isa qofa dha.
{d} {cell} keessatti barreessi. Sana booda lakkoofsi haaraan sun sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa sanuma keessatti tokkoo biraa uumuu isaa ilaali.

mistakes: Sarara qofa yookaan saanduqa qofa lakkaa'uu. Lakkoofsonni saddeen dhorkaman yeroo baay'ee gareewwan sadan walitti irraa dhufu.
Lakkoofsi ati amma kaa'itte hiriyoota isaa 20 irraas filatamtoota akka haqu irraanfachuu; tokkoowwan haaraan kaa'uu hunda booda battaluma mul'atu.
Filatamaa tokko qofa bakka tokko qofa waliin walitti makuu: filatamaan tokko qofa kutaa keessatti filatamaa tokko hafe qaba, bakki tokko qofa garee keessatti lakkoofsichaaf kutaa tokko hafe qaba.
faq: Sudoku keessatti filatamaan tokko qofa maali?
Kutaa duwwaa filatamaa tokkicha qabu. Lakkoofsonni adda addaa saddeet duraanuu sarara, tarree fi saanduqa isaa keessa kaa'amaniiru, kanaaf lakkoofsi sagalaffaan isa qofa kan itti galu.
Afaan Ingiliziitiin maaliif naked, jechuunis qullaa, jedhama?

Sababni isaas filatamaan tokkichi sun erga yaadannoon barreeffamee booda kutaa keessatti kallattiin mul'ata; wanti isa dhoksu hin jiru. Bakki tokko qofa garuu filatamtoota biroo gidduu taa'a, kutaa osoo hin taane lakkoofsa ilaaluun argama.
Hiibboon filatamaa tokko qofa qofaan furamuu danda'aa?

Hiibbooleen Salphaa hedduun ni danda'u, garuu baay'een isaanii bakka tokko qofas barbaadu. Bare Sudoku hiibbooleen Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessaa tokkoowwan gosa lamaaniin furamuu akka danda'an madaala; hiibbooleen Ulfaataa fi Ogeessaa yoo xiqqaate tooftaa dabalataa tokko barbaadu.
Qajeelfamni filatamaa tokko qofa ni agarsiisaa?
Eeyyee. Kaa'uun itti aanu filatamaa tokko qofa yoo ta'e, qajeelfamni kutaa sana filatee lakkoofsa waliin "Asitti filatamaa tokko qofa" jedha. Kaa'uuf qajeelfama irra deebi'ii tuqi.

hidden-single.description: Bakki tokko qofa kutaa sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa keessatti lakkoofsi itti seenuu danda'u isa qofa dha. Lakkoofsa tokko tokkoon ilaaluun argachuu baradhu.
hidden-single.summary: Bakki tokko qofa lakkoofsa sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa keessatti kutaa danda'amu tokko qofa hafe qabu dha, kutaan sun filatamtoota biroo agarsiisuu yoo danda'e illee. Gareen sun lakkoofsa sana qabaachuu waan qabuuf, achi seena. Qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku "Sarara kana keessatti 5 bakka tokko qofa", yookaan tarree yookaan saanduqa, jedhee himu.
when: Yeroo lakkoofsi tokko bakka baay'ee qabate: lakkoofsi tokko erga al shan yookaan jaha mul'atee booda, saanduqonni hafan baay'ee daanga'u, bakki tokko qofa immoo yeroo baay'ee tarkaanfii itti aanu dha. Bakki tokko qofa tooftaa guddaa hiibbooleen Salphaa fi Giddu-galeessaa ti, sadarkaa hunda irrattis tooftaa hojii baay'ee hojjetu ta'ee itti fufa.

Lakkoofsa tokko fudhadhu, saanduqa isa hin qabne barbaadi, kutaa saanduqa sanaa kan lakkoofsa sana isa kaa'ame waliin sarara yookaan tarree qooddatu hunda balleessi. Kutaan tokko yoo hafe, bakka tokko qofa argatteetta. Ilaalchi wal fakkaatu sararootaa fi tarreewwan irrattis ni hojjeta. Taphicha keessatti lakkoofsa kaa'ame tuqi: lakkoofsi sun bakka jiru hundatti ifa godhama, kanaaf kutaaleen bilisaa ifatti mul'atu.

steps: Saanduqni {box} ammallee {d} hin qabu, kanaaf kutaalee isaa duwwaa keessaa tokko isa qabaachuu qaba. Kutaaleen duwwaan {empties} dha.
Isaan keessaa {cell} malee hunda keessatti, {d} {d} sarara yookaan tarree sanuma keessatti duraanuu kaa'ameen dhorkameera, kanaaf {d} achitti filatamaa miti.
Kanaaf {cell} saanduqa {box} keessatti bakka {d} isa qofa ta'ee hafa. {cell} ammallee filatamtoota biroo agarsiisuu yoo danda'e illee, {d} achitti barreessi.

mistakes: Lakkoofsa kutaa tarii sirrii ta'uu danda'u keessa kaa'uu: kutaa duwwaa garee sanaa kaan hunda ilaali, kan ifatti mul'atan qofa miti.
Kutaan filatamtoota hedduu waan agarsiisuuf bakka tokko qofa dhabuu. Filatamtoonni kaan hin barbaachisan; kan barbaachisu lakkoofsi sun garee keessatti bakka biraa dhabuu isaa ti.
Saanduqota qofa ilaaluu. Sararoonni fi tarreewwan bakka tokko qofa baay'ina walfakkaatuun uumu, keessattuu dhuma irratti.
faq: Sudoku keessatti bakki tokko qofa maali?
Lakkoofsa sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa keessatti kutaa tokko qofa keessa seenuu danda'u. Gareen sun lakkoofsa sana qabaachuu qaba, kanaaf kutaan sun filatamtoota biroo qabaatus murtaa'eera.
Garaagarummaan bakka tokko qofa fi filatamaa tokko qofa gidduu jiru maali?
Filatamaan tokko qofa waa'ee kutaa ti: filatamaan tokko hafe. Bakki tokko qofa waa'ee lakkoofsaa ti: garee keessatti kutaan tokko hafe. Lamaanuu lakkoofsa mirkaneeffannaan kaa'u.
Kam argachuun salphaa dha?

Yaadannoo malee, bakki tokko qofa yeroo baay'ee salphaa dha, sababni isaas gabatee lakkoofsa tokko tokkoon ilaaluu dandeessa. Yaadannoo guutuu waliin, filatamaan tokko qofa isa salphaa dha, sababni isaas kutaan filatamaa tokko qabu ifatti mul'ata.
Qajeelfamni bakka tokko qofa akkamitti ibsa?
Lakkoofsichaaf "Sarara kana keessatti", "Tarree kana keessatti" yookaan "Saanduqa kana keessatti bakka tokko qofa" jedhee, kutaa sana filatee. Kaa'uuf qajeelfama irra deebi'ii tuqi.

locked-candidates.name: Filatamtoota cufaman
locked-candidates.title: Filatamtoota Cufaman Sudoku Keessatti: Akeekuu fi Qabachuu
locked-candidates.description: Filatamtoota cufaman: filatamtoonni lakkoofsaa saanduqa keessatti sarara yookaan tarree tokko irra yoo jiraatan, yookaan faallaa, lakkoofsi bakka biraa haqama.
locked-candidates.summary: Filatamtoonni cufaman tooftaa jalqabaa lakkoofsa kaa'uu mannaa filatamtoota haqu dha. Gosa lama qaba. Akeekuu: saanduqa keessatti filatamtoonni lakkoofsa tokkoo hundi sarara yookaan tarree tokko irra jiru, kanaaf lakkoofsi sun hafe sarara yookaan tarree sanaa irraa haqama. Qabachuu: sarara yookaan tarree keessatti filatamtoonni lakkoofsa tokkoo hundi saanduqa tokko keessa jiru, kanaaf lakkoofsi sun hafe saanduqa sanaa irraa haqama. Qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku kaa'uu inni banu "Filatamtoota cufaman" jedhee moggaasa.
when: Hiibboo Ulfaataa keessatti yeroo tokkoowwan dhuman, wanti jalqaba yaaltu kana. Yoo xiqqaate lakkoofsa ati qorattuuf yaadannoo guutuu barbaada. Filatamtoonni cufaman baratamoo dha: hiibbooleen Ulfaataa baay'een isaan barbaadu, hiibbooleen Ogeessaa immoo bocawwan gurguddaa gidduutti itti fayyadamu.
spot: Akeekuuf, saanduqa hundaa fi lakkoofsa isa keessaa dhabame hunda ilaali: kutaaleen filatamaa lakkoofsa sanaa sarara yookaan tarree tokko qofa irra yoo jiraatan, lakkoofsi sun saanduqa ala sarara yookaan tarree sana irra akka filatamaatti mul'achuu isaa ilaali. Qabachuuf, sarara yookaan tarree hordofi: filatamtoonni lakkoofsa tokkoo hundi saanduqa tokko keessa yoo jiraatan, hafe saanduqa sanaa irraa haqamuu danda'a. Taphicha keessatti filatamaa isaa hunda ifa gochuuf furtuu lakkoofsaa tuqi; yaadannoo ifa ta'an lama yookaan sadii saanduqa tokko keessatti toora tokko irratti argamuun bocicha.

steps: Saanduqa {box} keessatti, lakkoofsi {d} kutaalee filatamaa kanneen qofa qaba: {cells}. Hundi isaanii sarara {row} irra jiru.
Saanduqni {box} {d} barbaada, kanaaf {d} sarara {row} saanduqa {box} keessa jira, kutaalee sana keessaa kam irra haa bu'u malee.
Sararri {row} {d} lammaffaa qabaachuu hin danda'u, kanaaf {d} kutaalee sarara {row} kan saanduqa ala jiran irraa haqi: {elim}.
Sarara {row} keessatti, lakkoofsi {d} {cells} qofa keessa seenuu danda'a, hundi isaanii immoo saanduqa {box} keessa jiru.
Sararri {row} {d} qabaachuu qaba, kanaaf {d} saanduqa {box} sarara {row}n qabatama. Kutaaleen saanduqa {box} kaan {d} qabaachuu hin danda'an.
{d} {elim} irraa haqi.

mistakes: Haala akeekuu keessatti lakkoofsa saanduqa ala osoo hin taane saanduqa keessaa haquu, yookaan haala qabachuu keessatti faallaa isaa. Haqiinsi yeroo hunda kutaalee sarara yookaan tarree keessa jiran garuu saanduqa keessa hin jirre, yookaan saanduqa keessa jiran garuu sarara yookaan tarree keessa hin jirre irratti raawwatama.
Filatamtoonni sararoota saanduqa lama irra yoo babal'atan seera kana hojiirra oolchuu. Kutaaleen filatamaa lakkoofsa sanaa saanduqa keessa jiran hundi sarara yookaan tarree tokko irra ta'uu qabu.
Tokkoo haqiinsi uumu barbaaduu irraanfachuu. Filatamtoonni cufaman ofumaan lakkoofsa kaa'uun darbee darbee; tokkoo qopheessu.
faq: Sudoku keessatti filatamtoonni cufaman maali?

Filatamtoota lakkoofsa tokkoo kan walqunnamtii saanduqaa fi sarara yookaan tarree tokkoo keessatti daanga'an. Saanduqni, yookaan sararri yookaan tarreen, lakkoofsa sana walqunnamtii sana keessatti qabaachuu waan qabuuf, lakkoofsi sun hafe sarara yookaan tarree sanaa, yookaan hafe saanduqa sanaa irraa haqamuu danda'a.
Garaagarummaan akeekuu fi qabachuu gidduu jiru maali?

Akeekuun saanduqa irraa jalqaba: filatamtoonni lakkoofsichaa saanduqa keessa jiran sarara yookaan tarree tokko akeeku, kanaaf lakkoofsi sun hafe sarara yookaan tarree sanaa irraa haqama. Qabachuun sarara yookaan tarree irraa jalqaba: filatamtoonni lakkoofsichaa achi keessa jiran hundi saanduqa tokko keessa jiru, kanaaf sararri yookaan tarreen sun lakkoofsa sana qabata, lakkoofsi sunis hafe saanduqa sanaa irraa haqama.
Filatamtoonni cufaman intersection removal jedhamuunis beekamuu?
Eeyyee. Maqaaleen biroo gosa qabachuutiif box-line reduction, gosa akeekuutiif immoo pointing pairs yookaan pointing triples dha. Bare Sudoku lamaaniifuu maqaa tokko fayyadama.
Sadarkaan kam filatamtoota cufaman barbaada?

Ulfaataa. Hiibboon filatamtoota cufaman yookaan cimdii fi sadii barbaadu garuu waan isaa ol ulfaatu hin barbaanne Ulfaataa jedhamee madaalama; hiibbooleen Ogeessaa immoo qurxummii yookaan koolas barbaadu.

naked-pairs.name: Cimdii fi sadii mul'ataa
naked-pairs.title: Cimdii fi Sadii Mul'ataa Sudoku Keessatti: Akkamitti Hojjetu
naked-pairs.description: Cimdii fi sadii mul'ataa: kutaalee lama yookaan sadii garee tokko keessatti filatamtoota lama yookaan sadii walfakkaatan qaban. Argachuu fi waan haqamu baradhu.
naked-pairs.h1: Cimdii fi sadii mul'ataa (naked pairs)
naked-pairs.summary: Cimdiin mul'ataan kutaalee lama sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa tokko keessatti filatamtoota lama sirriitti walfakkaatan qabanii dha. Lakkoofsonni lamaan kutaalee lamaan sana keessa seenuu qabu, kanaaf kutaa garee sanaa kan biraa hunda irraa haqamuu danda'u. Sadiin mul'ataan yaada wal fakkaatu kutaalee sadii fi lakkoofsota sadiin; kutaan tokko tokko isaan keessaa lama yookaan sadanuu agarsiisuu danda'a. Qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku kaa'uu booda dhufu "Lama yookaan sadii" jedhee moggaasa.
when: Erga yaadannoon guutuu ta'ee tokkoowwan fi filatamtoonni cufaman dhumanii booda. Cimdiin mul'ataan hiibbooleen Ulfaataa keessatti baay'ee baratamaa dha, sadiin mul'ataan immoo xiqqoo. Lamaanuu garee kutaalee duwwaa shanii fi isaa ol ammallee qabu hunda keessatti ilaaluun gatii qaba.
spot: Kutaalee filatamtoota lama qofa qaban ilaaliitii garee sanuma keessatti kutaa biraa lamaanuma qabu barbaadi. Sadiif, gareewwan kutaalee filatamaa lamaa fi sadii hedduu qaban ilaaliitii isaan keessaa sadii walitti lakkoofsota adda addaa sadii qofa fayyadamuu isaanii mirkaneessi. Kutaaleen filatamtoota sirriitti walfakkaatan qaban erga yaadannoon barreeffamee booda salphaatti mul'atu; taphicha keessatti Yaadannoo guuti kana tuqaa tokkoon raawwata.

steps: {cellA} fi {cellB} {unit} keessatti filatamtoota lama sirriitti walfakkaatan qabu: {d1} fi {d2}.
Tokko isaanii {d1}, kaan immoo {d2} ta'uu qaba. Kam akka ta'e hin beeknu, garuu lakkoofsonni lamaan kutaalee lamaan kanaan fudhatamaniiru.
Kanaaf kutaan {unit} kan biraa kamiyyuu {d1} yookaan {d2} qabaachuu hin danda'u. {elim} haqi.
Kutaaleen {unit} sadii filatamtoota isaanii hunda lakkoofsota sadan walfakkaatan, {digits}, irraa fudhatu: {cells}.

Lakkoofsonni sadan kutaalee sadan kana tartiiba tokkoon guutuu qabu. Kutaan tokko filatamtoota sadan hunda agarsiisuu hin barbaachisu; kan barbaachisu kutaalee sadan keessaa tokko illee filatamaa lakkoofsota sadan kanaan ala hin qabaachuu isaa ti.
{digits} kutaalee {unit} kan biraa hunda irraa haqi: {elim}.

mistakes: Kutaalee lama filatamtoota lama qooddatan garuu kan sadaffaas qaban fudhachuu. Cimdii mul'ataaf kutaan tokkoon tokkoon filatamtoota lamaan sana qofa qabaachuu qaba, homaa dabalataa malee.
Lakkoofsota sana kutaalee cimdichaa irraa haquu. Cimdichi filatamtoota isaa eeggata; haqiinsi kutaalee garee sanaa kaan irratti raawwatama.

Kutaan sadii keessa jiru hundi lakkoofsota sadan hunda akka agarsiisu barbaaduu. Kutaan sadan keessaa lama qabu ni hojjeta, kutaan tokko illee filatamaa lakkoofsota sadan kanaan ala hin qabne taanaan.
faq: Sudoku keessatti cimdiin mul'ataan maali?

Kutaalee lama garee tokko keessatti lamaanuu filatamtoota lama sirriitti walfakkaatan qaban. Lakkoofsonni lamaan kutaalee lamaan sana keessatti cufamaniiru, kanaaf hafe garee sanaa irraa haqamuu danda'u.
Sadiin mul'ataan maali?

Kutaalee sadii garee tokko keessatti kan filatamtoonni isaanii walitti lakkoofsota sadii qofa ta'an. Kutaan tokko tokko isaan keessaa lama yookaan sadii qabaachuu danda'a. Lakkoofsonni sadan kutaalee sadan guutu, kanaaf kutaalee garee sanaa kaan irraa haqamuu danda'u.
Cimdiin mul'ataan lakkoofsa ni kaa'aa?

Ofumaan hin kaa'u. Filatamtoota haqa, haqiinsi sun immoo yeroo baay'ee filatamaa tokko qofa yookaan bakka tokko qofa dhiisa. Qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku tokkoo sana agarsiisee tooftaa isa danda'amsiise maqaa dhaha.
Cimdiin mul'ataan yeroo tokkotti saanduqa fi sarara keessa jiraachuu danda'aa?
Eeyyee. Kutaaleen lamaan sarara fi saanduqa yoo qooddatan, cimdichi gareewwan lamaan keessattuu haqa. Bare Sudoku garee tokko tokkoon hojjeta.

hidden-pairs.name: Cimdii fi sadii dhokataa
hidden-pairs.title: Cimdii fi Sadii Dhokataa Sudoku Keessatti: Akkamitti Argatta
hidden-pairs.description: Cimdiin dhokataan lakkoofsota lama kutaalee lama walfakkaatan qofa keessa seenuu danda'anii dha, kanaaf filatamtoonni kaan haqamu. Tarkaanfiin argachuu baradhu.
hidden-pairs.h1: Cimdii fi sadii dhokataa (hidden pairs)
hidden-pairs.summary: Cimdiin dhokataan lakkoofsota lama kan sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa tokko keessatti kutaalee lama walfakkaatan keessatti qofa filatamtoota ta'anii bakka biraa hin jirre dha. Kutaaleen lamaan sun lakkoofsota lamaan sana qabaachuu qabu, kanaaf filatamtoonni isaan keessa jiran kaan hundi haqamuu danda'u. Sadiin dhokataan akkasuma lakkoofsota sadii kutaalee sadiitti daanga'aniin hojjeta. Haqiinsa booda kutaaleen sun cimdii yookaan sadii mul'ataa agarsiisu. Qajeelfamni Bare Sudoku kaa'uu booda dhufu "Lama yookaan sadii" jedhee moggaasa.
when: Yeroo gareen tokko kutaalee filatamtoota baay'ee qaban qabuu fi tokkoowwan dhuman. Cimdiin dhokataan kutaalee guutaman keessatti dhokata, kanaaf bakka cimdiin mul'ataan hin mul'anne sanatti barbaaduun gatii qaba. Sadiin dhokataan darbee darbee; Bare Sudoku ni barbaada, garuu hiibbooleen Ulfaataa baay'een isaan malee furamu.
spot: Kutaa osoo hin taane lakkoofsaan hojjedhu. Garee tokko keessatti, lakkoofsi dhabame hundi kutaalee itti seenuu danda'u barreessi. Lakkoofsota lama keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii kutaalee danda'aman lama qofa yoo qabaatanii fi kutaaleen sun lamaan walfakkaatoo yoo ta'an, cimdii dhokataa argatteetta. Taphicha keessatti filatamtoota isaa ifa gochuuf furtuu lakkoofsaa tuqi; lakkoofsonni lama kutaalee lama walfakkaatan garee tokkoo qofa ifa godhanii bakka biraa isa keessatti yoo hin jirre, bocichi sana.

steps: {unit} keessatti, lakkoofsonni {d1} fi {d2} tokkoon tokkoon isaanii kutaalee danda'aman lama qofa qabu, isaanis lamaan walfakkaatoo dha: {cells}.
Kutaaleen lamaan sun {d1} fi {d2} qabaachuu qabu, kanaaf filatamtoonni isaanii kaan hin danda'aman.
{elim} haqi. Amma kutaaleen lamaan cimdii mul'ataa agarsiisu, kunis waan dabalataa banuu danda'a.

mistakes: Lakkoofsota cimdichaa lamaan kutaalee cimdichaa irraa haquu. Kan haqaman filatamtoota kutaalee sanaa kaan; lakkoofsonni cimdichaa ni hafu.
Lakkoofsa garee keessatti kutaa sadaffaa danda'amu qabu fudhachuu. Lakkoofsonni lamaanuu kutaalee lamaan sanatti qofa daanga'uu qabu.
Saanduqota qofa keessa ilaaluu. Cimdiin dhokataan sararootaa fi tarreewwan keessattis baay'ina walfakkaatuun argama.
faq: Sudoku keessatti cimdiin dhokataan maali?
Lakkoofsota lama kan garee tokko keessatti kutaalee lama walfakkaatan qofa keessa seenuu danda'an. Kutaaleen sun lakkoofsota sana fudhachuu qabu, kanaaf filatamtoonni isaanii kaan ni haqamu.
Cimdiin dhokataan cimdii mul'ataa irraa akkamitti adda?

Cimdiin mul'ataan ni mul'ata: kutaalee lama filatamtoota lama walfakkaatan qofa agarsiisan. Cimdiin dhokataan kutaalee lamaan keessatti filatamtoota dabalataatiin haguugama. Dabalataa sana haquun cimdii dhokataa gara cimdii mul'ataatti jijjiira.
Sadiin dhokataan maali?

Lakkoofsota sadii kutaalee sadii garee tokkootti daanga'an. Lakkoofsi tokko tokko kutaalee sadan hunda keessatti mul'achuu hin barbaachisu; kan barbaachisu lakkoofsota sadan keessaa tokko illee kutaalee sanaan ala filatamaa hin qabaachuu isaa ti.
Qajeelfamni cimdii dhokataa fi mul'ataa adda baasaa?
Lakki. Bare Sudoku lamaanuu argatee kaa'uu booda dhufu "Lama yookaan sadii" jedhee moggaasa. Fuulonni kunneen karaa adda addaan waan argamaniif adda isaan baasu.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing Sudoku Keessatti: Tooftaan Kun Akkamitti Hojjeta
x-wing.description: X-Wing: lakkoofsi sararoota lama keessatti filatamaa lama qofa, tarreewwan lama walfakkaatan irratti qabu, hafe tarreewwan sanaa irraa haqama. Fakkeenya.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing boca lakkoofsa tokkoo fi kutaalee afur golee rog-afurii irra jiranii ti. Lakkoofsi sun sararoota lama keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii keessatti kutaalee filatamaa lama qofa yoo qabaatee, kutaaleen sun tarreewwan lama walfakkaatan keessa yoo jiraatan, lakkoofsi sun golee lama wal-faallaa rog-afurii sanaa qabachuu qaba. Kanaaf kutaalee tarreewwan lamaan sanaa kaan hunda irraa haqamuu danda'a. Sararoonni fi tarreewwan bakka yoo wal jijjiiran akkasuma hojjeta. Bare Sudoku keessatti tooftaa Ogeessaa isa jalqabaa ti.
when: Yeroo tokkoowwan, filatamtoonni cufaman fi cimdii fi sadii dhuman. X-Wing boca Ogeessaa isa baay'ee baratamaa dha, yeroo baay'ees yeroo lakkoofsi tokko filatamtoota muraasa qofa qabu, yeroo baay'ee erga al afur hanga jaha kaa'amee booda, mul'ata. Lakkoofsa ati qorattuuf yaadannoo guutuu barbaada.
spot: Lakkoofsa tokko filadhuutii sararoota inni keessatti kutaalee filatamaa lama qofa qabu barbaadi. Sararoonni akkasii lama tarreewwan lama walfakkaatan yoo qooddatan, tarreewwan sana keessatti filatamtoota lakkoofsa sanaa kaan ilaali: isaan haqamuu qabu. Sana booda tarreewwan akka bu'uuraatti fudhachuun irra deebi'i. Taphicha keessatti furtuu lakkoofsichaa tuqi: filatamaan isaa hundi ifa godhama, rog-afuriin yaadannoo ifa ta'an afurii salphaatti mul'ata.

steps: Lakkoofsi {d} sarara {r1} keessatti kutaalee filatamaa lama qofa, sarara {r2} keessattis lama qofa qaba, isaanis tarreewwan lama walfakkaatan, {c1} fi {c2}, irratti wal-sirra dhaabatu: {cells}.

Sararri {r1} {d} isaa tarree {c1} yookaan {c2} keessa kaa'a, sararri {r2} immoo {d} isaa isa kaan keessa kaa'a. Haala kamiinuu, tarreewwan {c1} fi {c2} tokkoon tokkoon isaanii sararoota lamaan kana irraa {d} tokko argatu.
Kanaaf {d} tarreewwan {c1} fi {c2} keessatti bakka biraa kamittuu mul'achuu hin danda'u. {d} {elim} irraa haqi.

mistakes: Sarara lakkoofsichaaf kutaalee filatamaa sadii qabu fayyadamuu. Sararri bu'uuraa hundi lama qofa qabaachuu qaba, lamaanuu tarreewwan lamaan qooddataman keessa ta'uu qabu.
Lakkoofsa tarreewwan osoo hin taane sararoota irraa haquu. Sararoonni bu'uura yoo ta'an, haqiinsi tarreewwan keessatti raawwatama, faallaan isaas akkasuma.
Gosa bakki isaa jijjiirame irraanfachuu. X-Wing tarreewwan irratti ijaarame sararoota keessatti haqa.
faq: Sudoku keessatti X-Wing maali?

Lakkoofsa sararoota lama keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii keessatti kutaalee filatamaa lama qofa, tarreewwan lama walfakkaatan keessatti qabu. Lakkoofsi sun golee lama wal-faallaa rog-afurii sanaa qabata, kanaaf hafe tarreewwan lamaanii irraa haqama. Sararoonni fi tarreewwan bakka wal jijjiiruu danda'u.
X-Wing maaliif hojjeta?

Sararoota lamaan keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii lakkoofsa sana tarreewwan lamaan keessaa tokko keessa kaa'uu qaba, sararoonni lamaan immoo tarree tokko fayyadamuu hin danda'an. Kanaaf tarreewwan lamaan tokkoon tokkoon isaanii lakkoofsa isaanii sararoota kana irraa argatu, filatamaan tarreewwan sana keessa jiru kaan hundi hin danda'amu.
X-Wing qurxummii dhaa?
Eeyyee. X-Wing qurxummii hamma lamaa ti; Swordfish qurxummii hamma sadii ti. Bare Sudoku lamaanuu ni argata.
Sadarkaan kam X-Wing qaba?
Ogeessa. Hiibboon X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish yookaan XYZ-Wing barbaadu Ogeessa jedhamee madaalama.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing Sudoku Keessatti: Tooftaan Kun Akkamitti Hojjeta
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): utubaan filatamaa lama qabuu fi koolli lama tokko isaa qooddatan lakkoofsa sana kutaa koolota lamaan argu hunda keessaa baasu. Fakkeenya.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, kan XY-Wing jedhamuunis beekamu, kutaalee sadii kan tokkoon tokkoon isaanii filatamtoota lama qaban fayyadama. Utubaan filatamtoota X fi Y qaba. Koolli tokko utubaa arga, X fi Z qaba; koolli kaan utubaa arga, Y fi Z qaba. Utubaan maal iyyuu haa ta'u, koolota keessaa tokko Z ta'uu qaba, kanaaf Z kutaa koolota lamaanuu argu hunda irraa haqamuu danda'a. Bare Sudoku keessatti tooftaa Ogeessaa ti.
when: Yeroo hiibboon kutaalee filatamtoota lama qofa qaban hedduu qabuu fi qurxummiin hin jirre. Y-Wing hiibbooleen Ogeessaa keessatti baratamaa dha, kutaalee filatamaa lamaa hordofuun argama: tokkoon tokkoon isaanii utubaa yookaan koola ta'uu danda'a.
spot: Kutaalee filatamtoota lama qofa qaban tarreessi. Tokkoon tokkoon isaaniif, akka utubaa filatamtoota X fi Y qabuutti ilaaliitii hiriyoota isaa keessaa kutaa X fi lakkoofsa biraa Z qabu, akkasumas kutaa Y fi Z sanuma qabu barbaadi. Lamaan sun koolota dha. Sana booda kutaalee koolota lamaanuu arganii Z qaban barbaadi. Koolonni wal arguu akka hin barbaachisne hubadhu.

steps: Utubaan {pivot} filatamtoota {x} fi {y} qaba. {wingA} kan {x} fi {z} qabuu fi {wingB} kan {y} fi {z} qabu arga.
{pivot} yoo {x} ta'e, {wingA} {x} dhabee {z} ta'a. {pivot} yoo {y} ta'e, {wingB} {z} ta'a. Haala hundumaa keessatti koolota lamaan keessaa tokko {z} dha.
Kutaan koolota lamaanuu argu gonkumaa {z} ta'uu hin danda'u. {z} {elim} irraa haqi.

mistakes: Koolota lamaanuu utubaa hin argine filachuu. Koolli tokkoon tokkoon utubaa waliin sarara, tarree yookaan saanduqa qooddachuu qaba.
Z kutaalee koola tokko qofa argan irraa haquu. Kutaan irraa haqamu koolota lamaanuu arguu qaba.
Z utubaa irraa haquu. Y-Wing keessatti utubaan Z hin qabu; yoo qabaate, bocichi XYZ-Wing seera adda ta'e qabu dha.
faq: Sudoku keessatti Y-Wing maali?

Kutaalee filatamaa lamaa sadii: utubaa X fi Y qabu, koola X fi Z qabuu fi utubaa argu, akkasumas koola Y fi Z qabuu fi utubaa argu. Koolli tokko yeroo hunda Z dha, kanaaf Z kutaalee koolota lamaanuu argan irraa haqama.
Y-Wing fi XY-Wing tokkuma?
Eeyyee. Maqaaleen lamaan boca tokkicha ibsu. Bare Sudoku Y-Wing jedhee waama.
Koolli tokko maaliif Z ta'uu qaba?
Utubaan yoo X ta'e, koolli jalqabaa X dhabee Z ta'a. Utubaan yoo Y ta'e, koolli lammaffaan Z ta'a. Utubaan lamaan keessaa tokko dha, kanaaf koolli tokko Z dha.
Y-Wing kutaalee meeqa irraa haqa?
Yeroo baay'ee tokko yookaan lama: kutaalee koolota lamaanuu arganii ammallee Z qaban qofa. Kun tokkoo uumuuf ga'aa dha.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish Sudoku Keessatti: Tooftaan Kun Akkamitti Hojjeta
swordfish.description: Swordfish: lakkoofsi sararoota sadii keessatti tarreewwan sadiitti daanga'e hafe tarreewwan sanaa irraa haqama. Qurxummii hamma sadii, fakkeenya dhugaa waliin.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish X-Wing sararoota sadii fi tarreewwan sadii qabu dha. Lakkoofsi tokko sararoota sadii keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii keessatti kutaalee filatamaa hanga sadii yoo qabaatee, kutaaleen sun hundi tarreewwan sadii walfakkaatan keessa yoo jiraatan, sararoonni sadan lakkoofsa sana tarreewwan sana keessatti fixu, lakkoofsi sunis kutaalee tarreewwan sadanii kaan hunda irraa haqamuu danda'a. Sararoonni fi tarreewwan bakka wal jijjiiruu danda'u. Bare Sudoku Swordfish Y-Wing booda, hiibbooleen Ogeessaa keessatti barbaada.
when: Yeroo X-Wing fi Y-Wing homaa hin arganne. Swordfish akka X-Wing baratamaa miti, lakkoofsa filatamtoonni isaa sararoota sadii irra xiqqoo xiqqoon faca'an barbaada. Lakkoofsa sanaaf yaadannoo guutuu fi sirrii barbaada.
spot: Lakkoofsa tokko filadhuutii sararoota isaaf kutaalee filatamaa lama yookaan sadii qaban barbaadi. Sararoonni akkasii sadii walitti tarreewwan sadii qofa yoo tuqan, tarreewwan sana keessatti filatamtoota lakkoofsa sanaa dabalataa ilaali. Sararri hundi tarree hunda keessatti filatamaa qabaachuu hin barbaachisu: Swordfish kutaalee jaha, torba, saddeet yookaan sagal qabaachuu danda'a. Taphicha keessatti lakkoofsicha furtuu isaatiin ifa godhiitii sararoota sadii filatamtoonni isaanii tarreewwan sadii irratti wal-sirra dhaabatan barbaadi.

steps: Lakkoofsi {d} sararoota {rows} keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii keessatti kutaalee filatamaa hanga sadii qaba, kutaaleen sun hundi tarreewwan {cols} keessa jiru: {cells}.

Sararoota sadan keessaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii {d} isaa tarreewwan sadan keessaa tokko keessa kaa'uu qaba, sararoonni lama immoo tarree tokko fayyadamuu hin danda'an. Kanaaf tarreewwan sadan {d} isaanii sararoota sadan kana irraa argatu.
Filatamaan {d} kan biraa tarreewwan {cols} keessa jiru kamiyyuu hin danda'amu. {d} {elim} irraa haqi.

mistakes: Kutaalee sagalan hunda barbaaduu. Swordfish sararoota tokko tokko keessatti filatamtoota lama qabu ni hojjeta, sararoonni sadan tarreewwan sadii qofa yoo tuqan.
Sarara kutaalee filatamaa afur qabu itti dabaluu. Sararri bu'uuraa hundi hanga sadii qabaachuu qaba, hundi tarreewwan sadan keessa.
Sararoota bu'uuraa keessatti haquu. Sararoonni bu'uura yoo ta'an, haqiinsi tarreewwan sadan keessatti, sararoota bu'uuraan ala raawwatama.
faq: Sudoku keessatti Swordfish maali?

Lakkoofsa filatamtoonni isaa sararoota sadii keessatti tarreewwan sadiitti daanga'an. Sararoonni sadan lakkoofsa sana tarreewwan sadan keessa, tokko tokkoon, kaa'uu qabu, kanaaf lakkoofsi sun kutaalee tarreewwan sanaa kaan irraa haqama.
Swordfish X-Wing irraa akkamitti adda?
Hamma qofaan: X-Wing sararoota lama fi tarreewwan lama fayyadama, Swordfish sadii fi sadii. Yaanni qajeelaan tokkuma.
Swordfish kutaalee sagal qofa barbaadaa?
Lakki. Sararri tokko tokko filatamtoota lama yookaan sadii qabaachuu danda'a; bocichi kan barbaadu sararoonni sadan walitti tarreewwan sadii ol akka hin fayyadamne qofa.
Qurxummiin hamma afurii jiraa?
Eeyyee, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku itti hin fayyadamu, sababni isaas hiibbooleen isaa gonkumaa isa hin barbaadan.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing Sudoku Keessatti: Tooftaan Kun Akkamitti Hojjeta
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: utubaan filatamaa sadii qabuu fi koolli lama tokko isaa qooddatan lakkoofsa sana kutaa sadanuu argu hunda keessaa baasu. Fakkeenya dhugaa waliin.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing Y-Wing utubaan isaa filatamtoota sadii qabu dha. Utubaan X, Y fi Z qaba; koolli tokko utubaa arga, X fi Z qaba, kaan utubaa arga, Y fi Z qaba. Kutaalee sadan keessaa tokko Z ta'uu qaba, kanaaf Z kutaa sadanuu argu hunda irraa haqamuu danda'a. Utubaan mataan isaa Z ta'uu waan danda'uuf, kutaan irraa haqamu koolota lamaan qofa osoo hin taane utubaas arguu qaba, kunis saanduqa yookaan sarara yookaan tarree kutaaleen sun qooddatanitti daangessa. Tooftaalee Bare Sudoku itti fayyadamu keessaa isa ulfaataa dha.
when: Yeroo wanti biraa hundi hojjechuu dadhabe qofa. XYZ-Wing Bare Sudoku keessatti boca baay'ee hin mul'anne dha, hiibbooleen Ogeessaa keessatti qofa mul'ata. Yeroo kutaan filatamaa sadii qabu saanduqa tokko keessatti kutaa filatamaa lama qabu kan lakkoofsota isaa lama qooddatu waliin jiru barbaadi.
spot: Kutaalee filatamtoota sadii qofa qaban irraa jalqabi; tokkoon tokkoon isaanii utubaa ta'uu danda'a. Hiriyoota isaa keessaa, kutaalee lama kan tokkoon tokkoon isaanii filatamtoota lama sadan utubaa keessaa fudhataman qabanii lakkoofsa tokko qofa, Z, qooddatan barbaadi. Sana booda kutaalee utubaa fi koolota lamaanuu arganii Z qaban barbaadi. Hojii irratti koolli tokko saanduqa utubaa keessa, kaan immoo sarara yookaan tarree isaa keessa jira, kutaaleen irraa haqaman immoo kutaalee saanduqa sanaa kan sarara yookaan tarree sana keessatti hafan.

steps: Utubaan {pivot} filatamtoota sadii qaba: {x}, {y} fi {z}. {wingA} kan {x} fi {z} qabuu fi {wingB} kan {y} fi {z} qabu arga.
{pivot} yoo {z} ta'e, xumurameera. Yoo {x} ta'e, {wingA} {z} ta'uu qaba. Yoo {y} ta'e, {wingB} {z} ta'uu qaba. Haala hundumaa keessatti kutaalee sadan keessaa tokko {z} dha.
Kutaan sadanuu argu {z} ta'uu hin danda'u. {z} {elim} irraa haqi.

mistakes: Kutaalee koolota lamaan qofa argan irraa haquu. Akka Y-Wing hin taane, utubaan Z ta'uu danda'a, kanaaf kutaan sun utubaas arguu qaba.
Koolota filatamtoonni isaanii lamaanuu filatamtoota sadan utubaa keessatti hin argamne fayyadamuu.
Y-Wing waliin walitti makuu: garaagarummaan filatamaa sadaffaa utubaa keessa jiru dha, innis kutaalee qulqullaa'uu danda'an jijjiira.
faq: Sudoku keessatti XYZ-Wing maali?
Utubaa filatamtoota X, Y fi Z qabuu fi koolota lama, tokko X fi Z, kaan Y fi Z qaban, lamaanuu utubaa argan. Kutaalee sadan keessaa tokko Z dha, kanaaf Z kutaalee sadanuu argan irraa haqama.
XYZ-Wing Y-Wing irraa akkamitti adda?
Utubaan filatamtoota lama mannaa sadii qaba, Z dabalatee. Kun utubaa bakka Z danda'amu taasisa, kanaaf kutaalee utubaa fi koolota lamaanuu argan qofatu Z dhabuu danda'a.
XYZ-Wing hammam mul'ata?
Darbee darbee. Bare Sudoku keessatti hiibbooleen Ogeessaa qofatu isa barbaaduu danda'a, baay'een isaanii immoo hin barbaadan. Bare Sudoku isa dhuma irratti, X-Wing, Y-Wing fi Swordfish booda, ilaala.
WXYZ-Wing jiraa?
Eeyyee, utubaa filatamaa afurii qabu, garuu Bare Sudoku itti hin fayyadamu. Hiibboon taphicha keessa jiru hundi tooftaalee sagalan barnoota kanaatiin xumuramuu danda'a.

wo.learnText: Ndax yaa ngi tàmbale Sudoku, walla jafe-jafe bu metti dafa la tëye? Ñaari njàngale ñoo leeral sàrt yi ak bépp pexe bu xelal yi di jëfandikoo, bu ci nekk ak misaal bu dëgg.

howTo.title: Naka Lañuy Fowe Sudoku: Sàrt yi, Nataal bi ak Tànk yu Njëkk
howTo.description: Jàngal naka lañuy fowe Sudoku: sàrt yi, rëdd yi, kolon yi ak këriñ yi, lu tax bépp jafe-jafe am benn tontu, bindukaay yi ak sa tànk yu njëkk.
howTo.summary: Sudoku jafe-jafe bu xel la ci nataal bu 9×9. Fees bépp kaas bu amul dara ak lim dale ci 1 ba 9 ngir bépp rëdd, bépp kolon ak bépp këriñ bu 3×3 am bépp lim benn yoon rekk. Am na ay lim yu ñu joxe ci ndoorte li; ya des dinga leen xam ak sa xel, benn kaas bu wóor ci benn yoon, te doo tànn mukk ci lu dul wóor. Njàngale mii dafay leeral nataal bi, sàrt yi, sàrtu benn tontu bi, bindukaay yi ak pexe bu yomb ngir sa tànk yu njëkk. Mën nga leen jéem yépp ci [Bare Sudoku](play), bu amul fey te am xelal yuy leeral xalaat bi.

sections.h: Yan ñooy sàrti Sudoku?
p: Ñetti sàrt rekk ñoo am, te benn sàrt la bu ñu seet ci ñetti wet: bépp rëdd war na am lim yi 1 ba 9, bépp kolon war na am lim yi 1 ba 9, te bépp këriñ bu 3×3 war na am lim yi 1 ba 9. Kon benn lim mënul mukk feeñ ñaari yoon ci benn rëdd, benn kolon walla benn këriñ.

Lim yi ñu joxe, yi ñu bind ak mbind mu dëgër, duñu soppiku. Sa liggéey mooy fees kaas yu amul dara yi. Amul kalkil te amul toftal: lim yi juróom-ñeenti màndarga yu wuute rekk lañu. Mën nga fowe ak ay araf walla ay melo te dara du soppiku.

sections.h: Naka la nataal bi tëralee?
p: Nataal bi am na 81 kaas ci 9 rëdd ak 9 kolon. Ay digante yu dëgër dañu koy xaajale ci juróom-ñeenti këriñ yu 3×3. Bépp kaas bokk na ci benn rëdd, benn kolon ak benn këriñ rekk, te ñetti mbooloo yooyu ñooy ay mbooloom. 20 kaas yi ci des te bokk benn mbooloo ak kaas bi, ñu leen di wax ay moroomam; lim bu ñu teg ci benn kaas dafay tere lim boobu ci 20 moroomam yépp.

Kaas yi dañu leen di bind niki r3c7: rëdd 3, kolon 7. Rëdd yi dañu leen di waññ dale ci kaw, kolon yi dale ci càmmoñ, te këriñ yi 1 ba 9 dale ci kaw càmmoñ, rëdd ak rëdd. Mbind mii ñu ngi koy jëfandikoo ci bépp njàngalem pexe te jar na ko jàng: r5c5 mooy diggu nataal bi.

sections.h: Lu tax bépp Sudoku am benn tontu rekk?
p: Sudoku bu baax am na benn tontu, te looloo tax xel mën a liggéey. Saa yu nga wone ne benn lim mënul dem feneen ci benn mbooloo, war na dem ci kaas bi des, ndax tontu bi am na te benn rekk la. Bu jafe-jafe amoon ñaari tontu, benn xalaat mënul leen ràññee te dinga war a tànn ci lu dul wóor ci benn diir.

Bare Sudoku dafay sos bépp jafe-jafe ci sa masin te dafay seet ne am na benn tontu rekk te saafarakatam bu dox ak xel mën na ko jeexal ak pexe yu tolluwaay bi nga tànn. Kon bu la dafa tëyee, bépp yoon am na tànk bu ci topp bu nga mën a gis, te xelal bi dafa koy wone.

sections.h: Naka ngay tàmbalee benn jafe-jafe Sudoku?
p: Tàmbalil ci li gëna xat. Toftal bii dafay dox ci bépp tolluwaay:
list: Tànnal benn lim bu feeñ ba noppi yoon yu bare, maanaam juróom-benn walla juróom-ñaari yoon, te seet këriñ yi ko amagul. Lu bare ci benn këriñ benn kaas rekk moo ko desal: looloo di [benn bërab rekk](hidden-single).

Seetal kaas yu xat yi. Kaas bu rëddam, kolonam ak këriñam boole am juróom-ñetti lim yu wuute, benn kandidaa rekk moo ko des: [benn kandidaa rekk](naked-single). Kaas yi nekk ci rëdd walla këriñ yu bëgg a fees ñoo gëna baax ngir seet.
Bépp lim boo teg dafay far benn kandidaa ci 20 moroom, kon seetal moroom yooyu ci saa si. Benn rekk yi dañuy faral di ñëw ci toftal.

Bu teg yu yomb yi jeexee, bindal bindukaay yi: kandidaa yi ci bépp kaas bu amul dara. Te nga seet benn lim bu tëju ci benn rëdd walla kolon ci biir benn këriñ ([kandidaa yu tëj](locked-candidates)) walla ñaari kaas yu am ñaari kandidaa yu yem ([ñaar yu feeñ](naked-pairs)).
Dellul ci benn rekk yi ginnaaw bépp far. Jafe-jafe yu Xarañ sax, benn rekk yi ñoo leen di saafara ci lu ëpp; pexe bu kawe bi dafay ubbi rekk benn rekk bi ci topp.

sections.h: Lan mooy bindukaay yi te kañ nga leen di jëfandikoo?
p: Bindukaay yi, ñu leen di wax itam màndargay kereyoŋ walla kandidaa, ñooy lim yu tuuti yi ngay bind ci kaas bu amul dara ngir fàttaliku lim yi mënagum a dem foofa. Ci jafe-jafe yu yomb, soxlawoo leen lu bare; dale ci Jafe ba ci kaw, am nañu solo lool, ndax pexe yu mel ni ñaar yi, X-Wing ak Y-Wing ci kandidaa yi lañu sukkandiku, du ci lim yi ñu teg.

Denc bindukaay yi ci anam bu jub: boo tegee benn lim, far ko ci bindukaayu 20 moroom yépp. Ci Bare Sudoku loolu dafay xew moom kese, te Fees bindukaay yi dafay bind bépp kandidaa ci bépp kaas bu amul dara ak benn bës, ngir nga mën a tàmbale ak kandidaa yu mat te jub. Bindukaay dëgg la, du lu nga tànn ci lu dul wóor: mu ngi tekki ne dara teregul lim bii ba tey.

sections.h: Lan ngay def bu la jafe-jafe bi tëyee?
p: Njëkk dellu seet li gëna yomb: bépp rëdd, kolon ak këriñ bu bëgg a fees ab bëtu benn rekk la. Te nga wóorlu ne bindukaay yi mat nañu, ndax kandidaa bu ñàkk dafay nëbb melo, te kandidaa bu ñu yeesalul dafay sos melo yu dul dëgg. Te nga topp [pexe yi](techniques) ci toftalu seen metit: kandidaa yu tëj, ñaar ak ñett, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ak XYZ-Wing. Bu ci nekk am na xëtam ak misaal bu dëgg.

Bu dara doxul, jëlal xelal. Ci Bare Sudoku xelal bi dafay njëkk a seet ndax benn lim bu ñu teg baaxul, te mu gis kaas bi ci topp bu xel mën a fees te mu tudd pexe mi, kon dinga jàng dara boo ko jëfandikoo sax. Bësaatal xelal bi ngir teg lim bi.

sections.h: Naka ngay dugalee lim yi ci Bare Sudoku?
p: Bësal benn kaas, te bës benn lim. Walla bësal lim bi bu njëkk: dafay tëju, te bépp kaas boo bës dafay jot lim boobu, te mooy yoon wi gëna gaaw ngir teg benn lim ci juróom-benneelu, juróom-ñaareelu ak juróom-ñetteelu yoon. Bësaatal lim bi ngir tijji ko. Butoŋu Bindukaay dafay soppi ci màndargay kereyoŋ, Far dafay setal benn kaas, Delloo dafay dindi bépp jëf, te njuumte yi dañuy feeñ ci xonq, lu dul boo ko feyee ci menu bi.

Ci klavye bi, jëfandikool butoŋi fett yi ngir yëngu, 1 ba 9 ngir dugal lim, Backspace ngir far, N ngir bindukaay, U ngir delloo, H ngir xelal, F ngir fees bindukaay yi ak Escape ngir menu bi. Po bi dafay denc boppam, dafay dox lu amul internet te amul pubisite walla kont.

faq: Ndax dangay war a tànn ci lu dul wóor ci Sudoku?

Déedéet ci jafe-jafe bu baax. Bépp jafe-jafe Bare Sudoku am na benn tontu rekk te ñu seet na ne xel doŋŋ mën na ko saafara, ba ci pexe yu tolluwaayam. Boo yégee ne war nga tànn ci lu dul wóor, benn kandidaa dafa ñàkk ci sa bindukaay walla am na pexe buy xaar ñu gis ko.
Ndax benn lim mën na feeñ ñaari yoon ci rëdd, kolon walla këriñ?

Déedéet. Loolu mooy sàrt bi yépp: bépp ci juróom-ñeenti rëdd yi, juróom-ñeenti kolon yi ak juróom-ñeenti këriñ yi am na bépp lim dale ci 1 ba 9 benn yoon rekk. Bu ñaari lim yu yem nekkee ci benn mbooloo, am na benn ci ñoom bu baaxul.
Lan mooy wuute Yomb, Diggu, Jafe ak Xarañ?

Pexe yi jafe-jafe bi soxla ñoo taxawal tolluwaay bi. Yomb ak Diggu, benn rekk yi doŋŋ ñoo leen di saafara, te Yomb dafay tàmbale ak 38 lim yu ñu joxe lu néew néew. Jafe dafay soxla kandidaa yu tëj walla ñaar ak ñett. Xarañ dafay soxla X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish walla XYZ-Wing.
Ndax li gëna baax mooy fees bindukaay ci bépp kaas walla ci yenn yi rekk?

Ci jafe-jafe yu Jafe ak Xarañ, fees leen yépp: melo yu mel ni ñaar yi, X-Wing ak Y-Wing duñu feeñ lu dul bépp kandidaa bindu na. Ci Yomb ak Diggu, bindukaay yi du lu war, te fowkat yu bare dañuy seet benn rekk yi doŋŋ.
Ban diir la Sudoku di yàgg?

Jafe-jafe bu Yomb dafay jël ay minit yu néew; jafe-jafe yu Xarañ mën nañu jël ñaar-fukki minit walla lu ko ëpp, ci ni nga gaawe gis melo wu kawe wi. Bare Sudoku dafay wone waxtu, dafay ko taxawal bu menu bi ubbeekoo te amul limu ñi gëna mën, kon fowal ci sa ndànk.
Ndax Sudoku dafay soxla kalkil?
Déedéet. Lim yi ay màndarga rekk lañu; amul yokk walla waññ. Bépp juróom-ñeenti màndarga mën nañu dox, te looloo tax Sudoku jafe-jafe bu xel la, du jafe-jafe bu lim.

index.title: Pexe yi ngir Saafara Sudoku, Leeral ak ay Misaal
index.description: Juróom-ñeenti pexe yi ngir saafara Sudoku, dale ci benn kandidaa rekk ba Swordfish ak XYZ-Wing, ci toftalu xelal yu Bare Sudoku, bu ci nekk ak misaal.
intro: Bépp Sudoku mën nañu ko saafara ak ay pexe yu xel yu néew. Xët wii dafay lim juróom-ñeenti pexe yi saafarakatu Bare Sudoku ak xelal yam di jëfandikoo, ci toftal bi saafarakat bi di leen jéeme: benn rekk yi njëkk, te far yi ci biir benn mbooloo, te melo yi dal ci ay rëdd ak ay kolon yu bare. Bépp pexe am na xëtam ak firi, naka lañu koy gise, misaal bu dëgg bu jóge ci jafe-jafe bu ñu sos ak njuumte yi ñuy faral di def.

Pexe mi gëna jafe mu jafe-jafe soxla moo taxawal tolluwaayam. Jafe-jafe yu Yomb ak Diggu dañu soxla benn rekk yi doŋŋ, jafe-jafe yu Jafe dañu soxla kandidaa yu tëj walla ñaar ak ñett, te jafe-jafe yu Xarañ dañu soxla benn jën walla benn laaf lu néew néew. Bépp tolluwaay, benn rekk yi ñooy def liggéey bi ci lu ëpp; pexe bu kawe bi dafay far benn walla ñaari kandidaa te benn rekk yi topp ci.
faq: Ban toftal laa war a jéeme pexey Sudoku yi?

Yu gëna yomb yi njëkk: benn kandidaa rekk, benn bërab rekk, kandidaa yu tëj, ñaar ak ñett yu feeñ, ñaar ak ñett yu nëbbu, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku ci toftal boobu la leen di jéeme, te xelal bi dafay tudd bépp yoon pexe mi gëna yomb mu mën a jëme kanam.
Ndax soxla naa pexe yii yépp ngir saafara Sudoku?

Ci jafe-jafe yu Yomb ak Diggu, benn rekk yi doy nañu. Jafe-jafe yu Jafe dañuy yokk kandidaa yu tëj ak ñaar ak ñett. Jafe-jafe yu Xarañ dañu soxla benn jën walla benn laaf lu néew néew, waaye lu bare benn walla ñaari yoon rekk ci benn jafe-jafe.
Ndax am na pexe yu gëna jafe XYZ-Wing?
Waaw, misaal ay jëng, ay natt ci tontu bu benn ak ay mbaal yuy forse. Bare Sudoku du sos jafe-jafe yu leen soxla, kon bépp jafe-jafe ci po bi mën nañu ko jeexal ak juróom-ñeenti pexe yi ci xët wii.
Lan mooy kandidaa?

Lim bu mënagum a dem ci kaas bu amul dara ndax dara ci rëddam, kolonam walla këriñam teregu ko ba tey. Bindukaay yi ci po bi ay kandidaa lañu. Bépp pexe bu ëpp benn rekk yi ci kandidaa yi lay xalaat, kon denc leen ci anam bu mat te jub.

naked-single.name: Benn kandidaa rekk
naked-single.title: Benn Kandidaa Rekk ci Sudoku: Kaas bu am Benn Kandidaa
naked-single.description: Benn kandidaa rekk mooy kaas bu amul dara bu am benn lim rekk bu mën a dem. Jàngal naka ngay gaawe gis ko, ak misaal bu dëgg ak njuumte yi ñuy faral di def.
naked-single.summary: Benn kandidaa rekk mooy kaas bu amul dara bu am benn kandidaa rekk: juróom-ñetti lim yi ci des feeñ nañu ba noppi ci rëddam, kolonam walla këriñam. Lim bi des war na dem foofa. Mooy pexe mi gëna yomb ci Sudoku, bi ngay gëna jëfandikoo, te xelal bu Bare Sudoku dafa koy wax "Benn kandidaa rekk fii".
when: Bépp yoon. Benn kandidaa rekk dafay feeñ dale ci tànk bu njëkk ba ci bu mujj, ci bépp tolluwaay. Ci jafe-jafe yu Yomb ak Diggu, moom ak benn bërab rekk ñooy pexe yi nga soxla doŋŋ. Ci jafe-jafe yu gëna jafe, bépp far bu pexe bu kawe def dafay faral di bàyyi benn kandidaa rekk, kon seetal ko ginnaaw bépp tànk.
spot: Seetal kaas yi am moroom yu bare yu ñu teg: kaas ci rëdd bu am ba noppi juróom-ñaari lim, walla kaas bu rëddam, kolonam ak këriñam boole am juróom-ñetti lim yu wuute. Bu amul bindukaay, waññ lim yi ngay gis dale ci kaas bi. Ak bindukaay, benn kandidaa rekk mooy kaas buy wone benn kandidaa kese, looloo tax Fees bindukaay yi dafa leen di yombal a gis.

steps: Seetal {cell}. Amul dara, kon limal bépp lim bu ñu teg ba noppi ci rëddam, kolonam ak këriñam.
Rëdd {row} am na {rowDigits}. Kolon {col} am na {colDigits}. Këriñ {box} am na {boxDigits}.
Ñoom ñépp dañuy tere bépp lim lu dul {d}, kon {d} mooy kandidaa bi des doŋŋ ci {cell}.
Bindal {d} ci {cell}. Te nga seet ndax lim bu bees bi dafay sos beneen benn rekk ci rëdd, kolon walla këriñ boobu.

mistakes: Waññ rëdd bi rekk walla këriñ bi rekk. Juróom-ñetti lim yi ñu tere, lu bare ci ñetti mbooloo yi ñoo boole lañu jóge.
Fàtte ne lim boo teg léegi dafay far itam kandidaa yi ci 20 moroomam; benn rekk yu bees dañuy feeñ ci saa si ginnaaw bépp teg.
Jaxase benn kandidaa rekk ak benn bërab rekk: ci benn kandidaa rekk, benn kandidaa rekk moo des ci kaas bi; ci benn bërab rekk, benn kaas rekk moo des ngir lim bi ci benn mbooloo.
faq: Lan mooy benn kandidaa rekk ci Sudoku?
Kaas bu amul dara bu am benn kandidaa rekk. Juróom-ñetti lim yu wuute teg nañu ba noppi ci rëddam, kolonam ak këriñam, kon juróom-ñeenteelu lim bi moo ci mën a dugg doŋŋ.
Lu tax ci angale ñu koy wax naked, maanaam lu ñu summi?
Ndax kandidaa boobu dafay feeñ ci kaas bi ci saa si bu bindukaay yi binduwee; dara nëbbul ko. Benn bërab rekk nag, dafa nekk ci diggante yeneen kandidaa te ñu koy gis bu ñu seetee lim bi, du kaas bi.
Ndax mën nañu saafara jafe-jafe ak benn kandidaa rekk doŋŋ?

Jafe-jafe yu Yomb yu bare mën nañu, waaye li ëpp ci ñoom dañu soxla itam benn bërab rekk. Bare Sudoku dafay jàpp ne jafe-jafe yu Yomb ak Diggu mën nañu leen saafara ak ñaari xeeti benn rekk yi; jafe-jafe yu Jafe ak Xarañ dañu soxla beneen pexe lu néew néew.
Ndax xelal bi dafay wone benn kandidaa rekk?
Waaw. Bu teg bi ci topp benn kandidaa rekk la, xelal bi dafay tànn kaas bi te wax "Benn kandidaa rekk fii" ak lim bi. Bësaatal xelal bi ngir teg ko.

hidden-single.name: Benn bërab rekk
hidden-single.title: Benn Bërab Rekk ci Sudoku: Bërab bi Des Doŋŋ ngir Benn Lim
hidden-single.description: Benn bërab rekk mooy kaas bi des doŋŋ ci rëdd, kolon walla këriñ fu benn lim mënagum a dem. Jàngal naka ngay gis ko ci seet benn lim ci benn yoon.
hidden-single.summary: Benn bërab rekk mooy benn lim bu des benn kaas rekk bu mu mën a dem ci rëdd, kolon walla këriñ, doonte kaas boobu mën na wone yeneen kandidaa. Ndax mbooloo mi war na am lim boobu, foofa lay dem. Xelal bu Bare Sudoku dafa koy wax "Benn bërab rekk ngir 5 ci rëdd bii", walla ci kolon walla ci këriñ.
when: Saa yu benn lim jëmee kanam lool: bu benn lim feeñee juróom walla juróom-benni yoon, këriñ yi des dañuy xat lool, te benn bërab rekk mooy faral di doon tànk bi ci topp. Benn bërab rekk mooy pexe mu mag mi ci jafe-jafe yu Yomb ak Diggu te mu ngi des ci bépp tolluwaay pexe mi gëna liggéey.
spot: Seetal benn lim ci benn yoon. Jëlal benn lim, seet benn këriñ bu ko amul, te dagg bépp kaas ci këriñ boobu bu bokk rëdd walla kolon ak benn lim bu mel noonu bu ñu teg. Bu benn kaas desee, gis nga benn bërab rekk. Seet bu mel noonu dafay dox ci rëdd yi ak kolon yi. Ci po bi, bësal benn lim bu ñu teg: bépp lim bu mel noonu dafay leer, kon kaas yu amul dara yi dañuy feeñ bu baax.

steps: Këriñ {box} amagul {d}, kon benn ci kaas yam yu amul dara war na ko am. Kaas yu amul dara yi ñooy {empties}.
Ci ñoom ñépp lu dul {cell}, {d} dafa tëju ndax am na {d} bu ñu teg ba noppi ci benn rëdd walla kolon bi ñu bokk, kon {d} du kandidaa foofa.
Loolu dafay bàyyi {cell} muy bërab bi des doŋŋ ngir {d} ci këriñ {box}. Bindal {d} foofa, doonte {cell} mënagum a wone yeneen kandidaa.

mistakes: Teg lim bi ci kaas bu mën a doon bu jub rekk: seetal bépp kaas bu amul dara ci mbooloo mi, du yi gëna feeñ rekk.
Wàcc benn bërab rekk ndax kaas bi dafay wone ay kandidaa yu bare. Yeneen kandidaa yi amuñu solo; li am solo mooy lim bi amul beneen bërab ci mbooloo mi.
Seet këriñ yi rekk. Rëdd yi ak kolon yi dañuy sos benn bërab rekk ni këriñ yi, rawatina ci mujj gi.
faq: Lan mooy benn bërab rekk ci Sudoku?
Benn lim bu mënul dem lu dul ci benn kaas ci rëdd, kolon walla këriñ. Mbooloo mi war na am lim bi, kon kaas bi wóor na doonte am na yeneen kandidaa.
Lan mooy wuute benn bërab rekk ak benn kandidaa rekk?
Benn kandidaa rekk, kaas la jëm: benn kandidaa moo des. Benn bërab rekk, lim la jëm: benn kaas moo des ci mbooloo. Ñoom ñaar ñépp dañuy teg lim ak wóor.
Ban moo gëna yomb ci gis?

Bu amul bindukaay, benn bërab rekk moo gëna yomb lu bare ndax mën nga seet nataal bi benn lim ci benn yoon. Ak bindukaay yu mat, benn kandidaa rekk moo gëna yomb, ndax kaas bu am benn kandidaa dafay feeñ bu baax.
Naka la xelal bi di waxe benn bërab rekk?
Mu ngi koy wax "Benn bërab rekk ngir" lim bi ci rëdd bii, ci kolon bii walla ci këriñ bii, te kaas bi tànnu na. Bësaatal xelal bi ngir teg ko.

locked-candidates.name: Kandidaa yu tëj
locked-candidates.title: Kandidaa yu Tëj ci Sudoku: Joxoñ ak Moomal
locked-candidates.description: Kandidaa yu tëj: bu kandidaa yu benn lim ci benn këriñ nekkee yépp ci benn rëdd walla kolon, walla walbatu ko, dañuy far lim bi feneen. Ñaari misaal.
locked-candidates.summary: Kandidaa yu tëj mooy pexe mu njëkk mi di far ay kandidaa te du teg lim. Am na ñaari xeet. Joxoñ: ci benn këriñ, kandidaa yu benn lim yépp ci benn rëdd walla benn kolon lañu nekk, kon lim bi dañu koy far ci li des ci rëdd walla kolon boobu. Moomal: ci benn rëdd walla kolon, kandidaa yu benn lim yépp ci benn këriñ lañu nekk, kon lim bi dañu koy far ci li des ci këriñ boobu. Xelal bu Bare Sudoku dafay tudd teg bi mu ubbi "Kandidaa yu tëj".
when: Bu benn rekk yi jeexee ci jafe-jafe bu Jafe, lii mooy li nga war a njëkk a jéem. Dafay soxla bindukaay yu mat lu néew néew ngir lim bi ngay seet. Kandidaa yu tëj yu bare lañu: li ëpp ci jafe-jafe yu Jafe dañu leen soxla, te jafe-jafe yu Xarañ dañu leen di jëfandikoo ci diggante melo yu gëna mag yi.
spot: Ngir joxoñ, seetal bépp këriñ ak bépp lim bu ci ñàkk: bu kaas yi mën a am lim boobu nekkee ci benn rëdd walla benn kolon, seetal ndax lim boobu dafay feeñ niki kandidaa ci rëdd walla kolon boobu ci biti këriñ bi.
