howTo.title: Engeri y'okuzannya Sudoku: amateeka n'entambula ezisooka
howTo.description: Yiga okuzannya Sudoku: amateeka, ennyiriri, kkolamu n'obusanduuko, lwaki buli kizibu kirina eky'okuddamu kimu, ebiwandiiko n'entambula zo ezisooka.
howTo.summary: Sudoku kizibu kya kulowooza ku katimba ka 9×9. Jjuza buli kasenge akataliimu nnamba n'ennamba okuva ku 1 okutuuka ku 9 buli lunyiriri, buli kkolamu na buli kasanduuko ka 3×3 bibeeremu buli nnamba omulundi gumu gwokka. Ennamba ezimu ziweebwa ku ntandikwa; endala ozizuula n'okulowooza, akasenge kamu akakakafu buli mulundi, era tolina kuteebereza n'akatono. Endagiriro eno ennyonnyola akatimba, amateeka, enkola y'eky'okuddamu kimu, ebiwandiiko n'enteekateeka ennyangu ey'entambula zo ezisooka. Osobola okwegezaamu byonna mu [Bare Sudoku](play), eya bwereere era erina obubonero obunnyonnyola okulowooza.

sections.h: Amateeka ga Sudoku ge galuwa?
p: Waliwo amateeka asatu gokka, era lye tteeka limu eritunuuliddwa okuva mu njuyi ssatu: buli lunyiriri lulina okubaamu ennamba 1 okutuuka ku 9, buli kkolamu erina okubaamu ennamba 1 okutuuka ku 9, era buli kasanduuko ka 3×3 kalina okubaamu ennamba 1 okutuuka ku 9. N'olwekyo ennamba teyinza kulabika mirundi ebiri mu lunyiriri lumu, mu kkolamu emu oba mu kasanduuko kamu.

Ennamba eziweereddwa, ezikubiddwa nga nkwafu, tezikyuka. Omulimu gwo kwe kujjuza obusenge obutaliimu nnamba. Tewali kubala era tewali nsengeka: ennamba ziri ng'amannya mwenda ag'enjawulo gokka. Wandizannyidde n'ennukuta oba n'ebifaananyi era tewali kyandikyuse.

sections.h: Akatimba kategekeddwa katya?
p: Akatimba kalina obusenge 81 mu nnyiriri 9 ne kkolamu 9. Layini enzito zikagabanyaamu obusanduuko mwenda obwa 3×3. Buli kasenge kali mu lunyiriri lumu lwokka, kkolamu emu n'akasanduuko kamu, era ebyo ebisatu bye bibinja byako. Obusenge obulala 20 obugabana ekibinja n'akasenge buyitibwa baliraanwa baako; ennamba eteekeddwa mu kasenge eggyawo ennamba eyo mu baliraanwa bonna 20.

Obusenge buwandiikibwa nga r3c7: olunyiriri 3, kkolamu 7. Ennyiriri zibalibwa okuva waggulu, kkolamu okuva ku kkono, n'obusanduuko 1 okutuuka ku 9 okuva waggulu ku kkono, olunyiriri ku lunyiriri. Engeri eno ey'okuwandiika ekozesebwa mu buli ndagiriro y'enkola era kirungi okugiyiga: r5c5 ge makkati g'akatimba.

sections.h: Lwaki buli Sudoku erina eky'okuddamu kimu kyokka?
p: Sudoku entuufu erina eky'okuddamu kimu, era ekyo kye kifuula okulowooza okukola. Buli lw'osobola okulaga nti ennamba tesobola kugenda walala mu kibinja, erina okugenda mu kasenge akasigaddewo, kubanga eky'okuddamu kiriwo era kimu kyokka. Singa ekizibu kyali n'eby'okuddamu bibiri, tewali kulowooza kwandisobodde kubyawulamu, era wandiwaliriziddwa okuteebereza ku kiseera ekimu.

Bare Sudoku ekola buli kizibu ku kyuma kyo era ekebera nti kirina eky'okuddamu kimu kyokka era nti ekigonjoola kyayo eky'okulowooza kisobola okukimaliriza n'enkola z'omutendera gw'olonze. N'olwekyo bw'oba olemereddwa, bulijjo waliwo eddaala eddako ery'okuzuula, era akabonero kaliraga.

sections.h: Otandika otya ekizibu kya Sudoku?
p: Tandika ku ekyo ekisinga okukugirwa. Ensengeka eno ekola ku buli mutendera:
list: Londa ennamba erabise dda emirundi mingi, nga mukaaga oba musanvu, onoonye obusanduuko obukyagibulamu. Emirundi mingi mu kasanduuko musigala akasenge kamu kokka akayinza okugitwala: oyo ye [omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese](hidden-single).

Noonya obusenge obwetooloddwa ennamba nnyingi. Akasenge ng'olunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako n'akasanduuko kaako awamu birimu ennamba munaana ez'enjawulo kasigazza omwesimbyewo omu yekka: [omwesimbyewo omu yekka](naked-single). Obusenge mu nnyiriri oba mu busanduuko ebinaatera okujjula bye bifo ebisinga okutunuulirwa.
Buli nnamba gy'oteeka eggyawo omwesimbyewo mu baliraanwa 20, n'olwekyo kebera baliraanwa abo amangu ddala. Abesimbyewo abali bokka batera okujja mu lujegere.

Entambula ennyangu bwe ziggwaawo, wandiika ebiwandiiko: abesimbyewo ba buli kasenge akataliimu nnamba. Oluvannyuma noonya ennamba esibiddwa mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu emu munda mu kasanduuko ([abasiba](locked-candidates)) oba obusenge bubiri obulina abesimbyewo babiri be bamu ([babiri abeeyoleka](naked-pairs)).

Ddayo ku besimbyewo abali bokka oluvannyuma lwa buli kuggyawo. Ne bizibu bya Mukugu bigonjoolebwa okusinga n'abesimbyewo abali bokka; enkola enzibu ekola kimu kyokka: esumulula omwesimbyewo omu yekka addako.

sections.h: Ebiwandiiko kye ki era ddi lw'obikozesa?
p: Ebiwandiiko, era ebiyitibwa obubonero bwa kkalaamu oba abesimbyewo, ze nnamba entono z'owandiika mu kasenge akataliimu nnamba okujjukira ennamba eziyinza okugendamu. Mu bizibu ebyangu tobyetaaga nnyo; okuva ku Kizibu okwambuka byetaagisa nnyo, kubanga enkola nga babiri, X-Wing ne Y-Wing zikwata ku besimbyewo, so si ku nnamba eziteekeddwa.

Kuuma ebiwandiiko nga bituufu: bw'oteeka ennamba, giggyeewo mu biwandiiko bya baliraanwa bonna 20. Mu Bare Sudoku kino kikolebwa kyokka, era Jjuza ebiwandiiko ewandiika buli mwesimbyewo mu buli kasenge akataliimu nnamba n'okunyiga omulundi gumu, n'olwekyo osobola okutandika n'abesimbyewo bonna abajjuvu era abatuufu. Ekiwandiiko kiba kituufu, si kuteebereza: kitegeeza nti tewali kigaana nnamba eno kutuusa kati.

sections.h: Okola ki bw'oba olemereddwa?
p: Okusooka, kebera ebikulu nate: buli lunyiriri, buli kkolamu na buli kasanduuko ebinaatera okujjula nsibuko ya besimbyewo abali bokka. Oluvannyuma kakasa nti ebiwandiiko bijjuvu, kubanga omwesimbyewo abulawo akweka ebifaananyi, ate omwesimbyewo atakyali mutuufu azaala ebifaananyi eby'obulimba. Oluvannyuma kola ku [nkola](techniques) okusinziira ku buzibu bwazo: abasiba, babiri oba basatu, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ne XYZ-Wing. Buli emu erina olupapula lwayo n'ekyokulabirako ekya ddala.

Bwe wataba kikola, kozesa akabonero. Mu Bare Sudoku akabonero kasooka kukebera oba ennamba eteekeddwa nkyamu, oluvannyuma kanoonya akasenge akaddako akasobola okujjuzibwa n'okulowooza era kategeeza erinnya ly'enkola, n'olwekyo oyiga ekintu ne bw'okakozesa. Nyiga akabonero nate okuteeka ennamba.

sections.h: Oyingiza otya ennamba mu Bare Sudoku?
p: Nyiga akasenge, oluvannyuma ennamba. Oba nyiga ennamba esooka: esibibwa, era buli kasenge k'onyiga kagifuna, eyo y'engeri esinga obwangu ey'okuteeka ennamba y'emu omulundi ogw'omukaaga, ogw'omusanvu n'ogw'omunaana. Nyiga ennamba nate okugisumulula. Eppeesa lya Ebiwandiiko likyusa ku bubonero bwa kkalaamu, Sazaamu esazaamu akasenge, Zzaayo ezzaayo entambula yonna, era ensobi zirambibwa mu langi emmyufu okuggyako ng'okizikizza mu menu.

Ku keyboard, kozesa amappeesa g'obusaale okutambula, 1 okutuuka ku 9 okuyingiza ennamba, Backspace okusazaamu, N ku biwandiiko, U okuzzaayo, H ku kabonero, F okujjuza ebiwandiiko ne Escape ku menu. Omuzannyo gwetereka gwokka, gukola awatali mutimbagano era tegulina bulango wadde akawunti.

faq: Mu Sudoku kyetaagisa okuteebereza?

Nedda, mu kizibu ekituufu. Buli kizibu kya Bare Sudoku kirina eky'okuddamu kimu kyokka era kikeberebwa nti kisobola okugonjoolebwa n'okulowooza kwokka, okutuuka ku nkola z'omutendera gwakyo. Bw'owulira nti olina okuteebereza, waliwo omwesimbyewo abula mu biwandiiko byo oba enkola erindiridde okuzuulibwa.
Ennamba esobola okulabika emirundi ebiri mu lunyiriri, kkolamu oba kasanduuko?

Nedda. Eryo lye tteeka lyonna: buli kimu ku nnyiriri omwenda, kkolamu omwenda n'obusanduuko omwenda kirimu buli nnamba okuva ku 1 okutuuka ku 9 omulundi gumu gwokka. Ennamba bbiri ezifaanagana bwe ziba mu kibinja kimu, waakiri emu ku zo nkyamu.
Njawulo ki eri wakati wa Kyangu, Wakati, Kizibu ne Mukugu?

Omutendera gusalibwawo enkola ekizibu ze kyetaaga. Ebizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati tebyetaaga kisukka ku besimbyewo abali bokka, era ebya Kyangu bitandika n'ennamba waakiri 38 eziweereddwa. Ebya Kizibu byetaaga abasiba oba babiri ne basatu. Ebya Mukugu byetaaga X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish oba XYZ-Wing.
Kisinga okujjuza ebiwandiiko mu buli kasenge oba mu bumu bwokka?

Ku bizibu bya Kizibu ne Mukugu, bijjuze byonna: ebifaananyi nga babiri, X-Wing ne Y-Wing birabika wokka nga buli mwesimbyewo awandiikiddwa. Mu Kyangu ne Wakati, ebiwandiiko si bya buwaze era abazannyi bangi banoonya bunoonya abesimbyewo abali bokka.
Sudoku etwala bbanga ki?

Ekizibu kya Kyangu kitwala eddakiika ntono; ebizibu bya Mukugu biyinza okutwala eddakiika abiri oba okusingawo, okusinziira ku bwangu bw'olaba ekifaananyi eky'enkola enzibu. Bare Sudoku eraga essaawa ebala obudde, egiyimiriza nga menu eggule era tekuuma lukalala lwa bawanguzi, n'olwekyo zannya ku sipiidi yo.
Sudoku yeetaaga kubala?
Nedda. Ennamba mannya gokka; tewali kugatta wadde kubala. Ebintu byonna omwenda eby'enjawulo byandikoze, era y'ensonga lwaki Sudoku kizibu kya kulowooza so si kya nnamba.

index.title: Enkola z'okugonjoola Sudoku n'ebyokulabirako
index.description: Enkola omwenda ez'okugonjoola Sudoku, okuva ku mwesimbyewo omu yekka okutuuka ku Swordfish ne XYZ-Wing, mu nsengeka obubonero bwa Bare Sudoku gye buzikozesa.
intro: Buli Sudoku esobola okugonjoolebwa n'enkola ntono ez'okulowooza. Olukalala luno luliko enkola omwenda ekigonjoola kya Bare Sudoku n'obubonero bwakyo bye bikozesa, mu nsengeka ekigonjoola gye kizigezaamu: abesimbyewo abali bokka okusooka, oluvannyuma okuggyawo munda mu kibinja kimu, oluvannyuma ebifaananyi ebibuna ennyiriri ne kkolamu eziwerako. Buli nkola erina olupapula lwayo n'ennyinyonnyola, engeri y'okugizuula, ekyokulabirako ekya ddala okuva mu kizibu ekyakolebwa n'ensobi ezitera okubaawo.

Omutendera gw'ekizibu gusalibwawo enkola esinga obuzibu gye kyetaaga. Ebizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati tebyetaaga kisukka ku besimbyewo abali bokka, ebya Kizibu byetaaga abasiba oba babiri ne basatu, ate ebya Mukugu byetaaga waakiri ekyennyanja kimu oba Wing emu. Omutendera ne bwe guba gutya, abesimbyewo abali bokka be bakola omulimu omungi; enkola enzibu eggyawo omwesimbyewo omu oba babiri, abesimbyewo abali bokka ne beeyongerayo okuva awo.
faq: Enkola za Sudoku nzigezeemu mu nsengeka ki?

Ennyangu okusooka: omwesimbyewo omu yekka, omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese, abasiba, babiri ne basatu abeeyoleka, babiri ne basatu abakwese, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku ezigezaamu mu nsengeka eno yennyini, era akabonero bulijjo kategeeza enkola esinga obwangu etwala omuzannyo mu maaso.
Nneetaaga enkola zino zonna okugonjoola Sudoku?

Ku bizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati, abesimbyewo abali bokka bamala. Ebizibu bya Kizibu byongerako abasiba ne babiri ne basatu. Ebizibu bya Mukugu byetaaga waakiri ekyennyanja kimu oba Wing emu, naye emirundi mingi omulundi gumu oba ebiri bwokka mu kizibu.
Waliwo enkola enzibu okusinga XYZ-Wing?

Yee, okugeza enjegere (chains), okukebera kw'eky'okuddamu kimu (uniqueness) n'obutimba obukaka (forcing nets). Bare Sudoku tekola bizibu ebizeetaaga, n'olwekyo buli kizibu mu muzannyo kisobola okumalirizibwa n'enkola omwenda eziri ku lupapula luno.
Omwesimbyewo kye ki?

Ennamba ekyayinza okugenda mu kasenge akataliimu nnamba kubanga tewali kintu mu lunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako oba akasanduuko kaako ekigigaana kutuusa kati. Ebiwandiiko mu muzannyo be besimbyewo. Buli nkola esukka ku besimbyewo abali bokka erowooza ku besimbyewo, n'olwekyo bakuume nga bajjuvu era nga batuufu.

naked-single.name: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka
naked-single.title: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka mu Sudoku (naked single)
naked-single.description: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka ke kasenge akataliimu nnamba akalina ennamba emu yokka esoboka. Yiga okumuzuula amangu n'ekyokulabirako ekya ddala n'ensobi ezitera.
naked-single.summary: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka ke kasenge akataliimu nnamba akalina omwesimbyewo omu yekka: ennamba endala munaana ziri dda mu lunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako oba akasanduuko kaako. Ennamba esigadde erina okugenda awo. Y'enkola ya Sudoku esinga obwangu, gy'osinga okukozesa, era akabonero ka Bare Sudoku kagiraga nga "Wano waliwo omu yekka".
when: Bulijjo. Abesimbyewo abali bokka balabika okuva ku ntambula esooka okutuuka ku esembayo, ku buli mutendera. Mu bizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati, wamu n'abesimbyewo abali bokka abakwese, y'enkola yokka gy'oyetaaga. Mu bizibu ebizibu okusingawo, buli kuggyawo okukolebwa enkola enzibu kutera okulekawo omwesimbyewo omu yekka, n'olwekyo banoonye oluvannyuma lwa buli ddaala.
spot: Tunuulira obusenge obulina baliraanwa bangi abajjuziddwa: akasenge mu lunyiriri olulimu dda ennamba musanvu, oba akasenge ng'olunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako n'akasanduuko kaako awamu birimu ennamba munaana ez'enjawulo. Awatali biwandiiko, bala ennamba z'olaba okuva ku kasenge. N'ebiwandiiko, omwesimbyewo omu yekka kasenge bukasenge akalaga omwesimbyewo omu, era y'ensonga lwaki Jjuza ebiwandiiko ebafuula ennyangu okuzuula.

steps: Tunuulira akasenge {cell}. Tekaliimu nnamba, n'olwekyo wandiika buli nnamba eteekeddwa dda mu lunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako n'akasanduuko kaako.
Olunyiriri {row} lulimu {rowDigits}. Kkolamu {col} erimu {colDigits}. Akasanduuko {box} kalimu {boxDigits}.
Awamu ziggyawo buli nnamba okuggyako {d}, n'olwekyo {d} ye mwesimbyewo yekka asigadde mu {cell}.
Wandiika {d} mu {cell}. Oluvannyuma kebera oba ennamba empya ezaala omwesimbyewo omu yekka omulala mu lunyiriri lwayo, kkolamu yaayo oba akasanduuko kaayo.

mistakes: Okubala olunyiriri lwokka oba akasanduuko kokka. Ennamba munaana eziggyibwawo zitera okuva mu bibinja byonna ebisatu awamu.
Okwerabira nti ennamba gy'omaze kaakano okuteeka nayo eggyawo abesimbyewo mu baliraanwa baayo 20; abesimbyewo abali bokka abapya balabika amangu ddala oluvannyuma lwa buli kuteeka.
Okutabula omwesimbyewo omu yekka n'omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese: ku w'olubereberye, mu kasenge musigalamu omwesimbyewo omu; ku w'okubiri, mu kibinja musigalamu akasenge kamu kokka eri ennamba.
faq: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka mu Sudoku kye ki?

Akasenge akataliimu nnamba akalina omwesimbyewo omu yekka. Ennamba munaana ez'enjawulo ziteekeddwa dda mu lunyiriri lwako, kkolamu yaako n'akasanduuko kaako, n'olwekyo ennamba ey'omwenda y'eyokka esaanira.
Lwaki mu Lungereza ayitibwa naked single?

Kubanga ebiwandiiko bwe biwandiikibwa, omwesimbyewo omu yekka alabikira ddala mu kasenge; tewali kimukweka. Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese (hidden single), ku ludda olulala, atuula mu besimbyewo abalala era azuulibwa ng'otunuulira ennamba so si kasenge.
Ekizibu kisobola okugonjoolebwa n'enkola y'omwesimbyewo omu yekka yokka?

Ebizibu bingi ebya Kyangu bisobola, naye ebisinga byetaaga n'abesimbyewo abali bokka abakwese. Bare Sudoku epima ebizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati ng'ebisobola okugonjoolebwa n'abesimbyewo abali bokka ab'ebika byombi; ebizibu bya Kizibu ne Mukugu byetaaga waakiri enkola endala emu.
Akabonero kalaga abesimbyewo abali bokka?
Yee. Entambula eddako bw'eba omwesimbyewo omu yekka, akabonero kalonda akasenge era kagamba nti "Wano waliwo omu yekka" wamu n'ennamba. Nyiga akabonero nate okugiteeka.

hidden-single.name: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese
hidden-single.title: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese mu Sudoku
hidden-single.description: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese ke kasenge kokka mu lunyiriri, kkolamu oba kasanduuko ennamba mw'eyinza okugenda. Yiga okumuzuula ng'otunuulira ennamba emu emu.
hidden-single.summary: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese ye nnamba esigazza akasenge kamu kokka mw'eyinza okugenda mu lunyiriri, kkolamu oba kasanduuko, ne bwe kaba nga akasenge ako kalaga abesimbyewo abalala. Olw'okuba ekibinja kirina okubaamu ennamba eyo, egenda awo. Akabonero ka Bare Sudoku kakiraga nga "Ekifo kimu kyokka ekya 5 mu lunyiriri luno", oba mu kkolamu oba mu kasanduuko.
when: Buli lwe wabaawo ennamba etuuse wala: ennamba bw'eba erabise emirundi etaano oba mukaaga, obusanduuko obusigadde buba bukugiddwa nnyo, era omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese atera okuba ye ntambula eddako. Abesimbyewo abali bokka abakwese y'enkola enkulu mu bizibu bya Kyangu ne Wakati era basigala nga y'enkola esinga okukozesebwa ku buli mutendera.
spot: Tunuulira ennamba emu buli mulundi. Twala ennamba, noonya akasanduuko akatalimu nnamba eyo, osaze ku buli kasenge k'akasanduuko ako akagabana olunyiriri oba kkolamu n'ennamba y'emu eteekeddwa dda. Bwe wasigalawo akasenge kamu, ozudde omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese. Okutunuulira kuno kwe kumu kukola ne ku nnyiriri ne kkolamu. Mu muzannyo, nyiga ennamba eteekeddwa: buli emu efaanana nayo eyakaayakana, n'olwekyo obusenge obwereere bweyoleka.

steps: Akasanduuko {box} tekannabaamu {d}, n'olwekyo akamu ku busenge bwako obutaliimu nnamba kalina okugitwala. Obusenge obutaliimu nnamba bwe {empties}.
Mu buli kamu ku bwo okuggyako {cell}, {d} eziyizibwa {d} eteekeddwa dda mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu y'emu, n'olwekyo {d} si mwesimbyewo awo.
Ekyo kireka {cell} nga kye kifo kyokka ekya {d} mu kasanduuko {box}. Wandiika {d} awo, ne bwe kiba nti {cell} kakyalaga abesimbyewo abalala.

mistakes: Okuteeka ennamba mu kasenge akayinza okuba nga ke katuufu kyokka: kebera buli kasenge akataliimu nnamba mu kibinja, so si obwo obweyoleka bwokka.
Obutalaba mwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese kubanga akasenge kalaga abesimbyewo bangi. Abesimbyewo abalala tebalina kye bakola; ekikulu kiri nti ennamba terina kifo kirala mu kibinja.
Okutunuulira obusanduuko bwokka. Ennyiriri ne kkolamu nazo zizaala abesimbyewo abali bokka abakwese emirundi mingi nga obusanduuko, naddala ku nkomerero.
faq: Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese mu Sudoku kye ki?

Ennamba esobola okugenda mu kasenge kamu kokka ak'olunyiriri, kkolamu oba kasanduuko. Ekibinja kirina okubaamu ennamba eyo, n'olwekyo akasenge kaba kasaliddwawo ne bwe kaba nga kakyalina abesimbyewo abalala.
Njawulo ki eri wakati w'omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese n'omwesimbyewo omu yekka?
Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwata ku kasenge: musigalamu omwesimbyewo omu. Omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese akwata ku nnamba: esigazza akasenge kamu mu kibinja. Bombi bateeka ennamba mu bukakafu.
Ki ekisinga obwangu okuzuula?

Awatali biwandiiko, abesimbyewo abali bokka abakwese batera okuba abangu kubanga osobola okutunuulira akatimba ng'ennamba emu emu. N'ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu, omwesimbyewo omu yekka ye asinga obwangu, kubanga akasenge akalina omwesimbyewo omu kalabika mangu.
Akabonero kannyonnyola katya omwesimbyewo omu yekka akwese?
Nga "Ekifo kimu kyokka ekya" ennamba mu lunyiriri luno, mu kkolamu eno oba mu kasanduuko kano, ng'akasenge kalondeddwa. Nyiga akabonero nate okugiteeka.

locked-candidates.name: Abasiba
locked-candidates.title: Abasiba mu Sudoku: okulaga n'okwetwalira
locked-candidates.description: Abasiba: abesimbyewo b'ennamba mu kasanduuko bwe baba bonna mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu emu, oba mu ngeri endala, ennamba eggyibwa awalala. Ebyokulabirako bibiri.
locked-candidates.summary: Abasiba y'enkola esooka eggyawo abesimbyewo mu kifo ky'okuteeka ennamba. Erina ebika bibiri. Okulaga: mu kasanduuko, abesimbyewo bonna ab'ennamba bali mu lunyiriri lumu oba kkolamu emu, n'olwekyo ennamba eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'olunyiriri oba kkolamu eyo. Okwetwalira: mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu, abesimbyewo bonna ab'ennamba bali mu kasanduuko kamu, n'olwekyo ennamba eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'akasanduuko ako. Akabonero ka Bare Sudoku kayita entambula enkola eno gy'eggulawo "Abasiba".
when: Abesimbyewo abali bokka bwe baggwaawo mu kizibu kya Kizibu, kino kye kintu ekisooka okugezaako. Kyetaaga ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu waakiri eby'ennamba gy'okebera. Abasiba batera okubaawo: ebizibu bya Kizibu ebisinga babeetaaga, era ebizibu bya Mukugu babakozesa wakati w'ebifaananyi ebinene.
spot: Ku kulaga, tunuulira buli kasanduuko na buli nnamba ebulamu: obusenge bw'abesimbyewo b'ennamba eyo bwe buba mu lunyiriri lumu oba kkolamu emu, kebera oba ennamba y'emu erabika ng'omwesimbyewo mu maaso mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu eyo ebweru w'akasanduuko. Ku kwetwalira, tunuulira ng'ogoberera olunyiriri oba kkolamu: abesimbyewo b'ennamba bonna bwe baba munda mu kasanduuko kamu, ekitundu ekisigadde eky'akasanduuko ako kiyinza okulongoosebwa. Mu muzannyo, nyiga eppeesa ly'ennamba okwakaayakanya buli mwesimbyewo waayo; olunyiriri lw'ebiwandiiko bibiri oba bisatu ebyakaayakana munda mu kasanduuko kamu kye kifaananyi.

steps: Mu kasanduuko {box}, ennamba {d} erina obusenge buno bwokka obw'abesimbyewo: {cells}. Bwonna buli mu lunyiriri {row}.
Akasanduuko {box} keetaaga {d}, n'olwekyo {d} ey'olunyiriri {row} eri munda mu kasanduuko {box}, ne bw'egwa mu kasenge ki ku obwo.
Olunyiriri {row} terusobola kubaamu {d} ey'okubiri, n'olwekyo ggyawo {d} mu busenge bw'olunyiriri {row} obuli ebweru w'akasanduuko: {elim}.
Mu lunyiriri {row}, ennamba {d} esobola kugenda mu busenge {cells} bwokka, era bwonna buli munda mu kasanduuko {box}.
Olunyiriri {row} lulina okubaamu {d}, n'olwekyo {d} y'akasanduuko {box} yeetwalirwa olunyiriri {row}. Obusenge obulala obw'akasanduuko {box} tebusobola kubaamu {d}.
Ggyawo {d} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Okuggyawo ennamba munda mu kasanduuko mu kifo ky'ebweru waako ku kulaga, oba mu ngeri endala ku kwetwalira. Okuggyawo bulijjo kugenda mu busenge obuli mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu naye nga tebuli mu kasanduuko, oba obuli mu kasanduuko naye nga tebuli mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu.
Okukozesa etteeka ng'abesimbyewo babunye ennyiriri bbiri ez'akasanduuko. Obusenge bwonna obw'abesimbyewo b'ennamba mu kasanduuko bulina okuba mu lunyiriri lumu oba kkolamu emu.
Okwerabira okunoonya omwesimbyewo omu yekka okuggyawo kw'azaala. Abasiba tebatera kuteeka nnamba bokka; bategekera omwesimbyewo omu yekka.
faq: Abasiba mu Sudoku be baani?

Abesimbyewo b'ennamba abasibiddwa mu kifo akasanduuko n'olunyiriri oba kkolamu we bisisinkanira. Olw'okuba akasanduuko, oba olunyiriri, birina okubaamu ennamba mu kifo ekyo, ennamba esobola okuggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'olunyiriri, oba eky'akasanduuko.
Njawulo ki eri wakati w'okulaga n'okwetwalira?

Okulaga kutandikira ku kasanduuko: abesimbyewo b'ennamba mu kasanduuko balaga ku lunyiriri oba kkolamu emu, n'olwekyo ennamba eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'olunyiriri oba kkolamu eyo. Okwetwalira kutandikira ku lunyiriri oba kkolamu: abesimbyewo baayo bonna ab'ennamba bali mu kasanduuko kamu, n'olwekyo olunyiriri lwetwalira ennamba era eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'akasanduuko.
Abasiba era bayitibwa intersection removal?
Yee. Amannya amalala ge box-line reduction ku kika ky'okwetwalira ne pointing pairs oba pointing triples ku kika ky'okulaga. Bare Sudoku ekozesa erinnya limu ku byombi.
Mutendera ki ogwetaaga abasiba?
Kizibu. Ekizibu ekyetaaga abasiba oba babiri ne basatu naye nga tekyetaaga kisingawo obuzibu kipimibwa nga Kizibu; ebizibu bya Mukugu byetaaga n'ekyennyanja oba Wing.

naked-pairs.name: Babiri ne basatu abeeyoleka
naked-pairs.title: Babiri ne basatu abeeyoleka mu Sudoku: engeri gye bakola
naked-pairs.description: Babiri ne basatu abeeyoleka: obusenge bubiri oba busatu mu kibinja obugabana abesimbyewo babiri oba basatu be bamu. Yiga okubazuula n'eky'okuggyawo.
naked-pairs.h1: Babiri ne basatu abeeyoleka (naked pairs)
naked-pairs.summary: Babiri abeeyoleka bwe busenge bubiri mu kibinja kimu (olunyiriri, kkolamu oba akasanduuko) obulina abesimbyewo babiri be bamu ddala. Ennamba ezo zombi zirina okugenda mu busenge obwo obubiri, n'olwekyo zisobola okuggyibwa mu buli kasenge akalala mu kibinja. Basatu abeeyoleka ndowooza y'emu n'obusenge busatu n'ennamba ssatu; buli kasenge kasobola okulaga bbiri ku zo oba zonna ssatu. Akabonero ka Bare Sudoku kayita entambula evaamu "Babiri oba basatu".
when: Oluvannyuma lw'ebiwandiiko okujjula era abesimbyewo abali bokka n'abasiba nga baggwaawo. Babiri abeeyoleka batera nnyo mu bizibu bya Kizibu, basatu abeeyoleka tebatera nnyo. Bombi kirungi okubanoonya mu buli kibinja ekikyalimu obusenge butaano oba okusingawo obutaliimu nnamba.
spot: Noonya obusenge obulina abesimbyewo babiri bokka era onoonye akasenge akalala mu kibinja kye kimu akalina abo bombi. Ku basatu, tunuulira ebibinja ebirimu obusenge obuwerako obw'abesimbyewo babiri n'abasatu era okebere oba busatu ku bwo awamu bukozesa ennamba ssatu zokka ez'enjawulo. Obusenge obulina abesimbyewo be bamu ddala bulabika mangu ng'ebiwandiiko biwandiikiddwa; Jjuza ebiwandiiko mu muzannyo ekikola n'okunyiga omulundi gumu.

steps: Obusenge {cellA} ne {cellB} {unit} bulina abesimbyewo babiri be bamu ddala: {d1} ne {d2}.
Akamu ku bwo kalina okuba {d1} n'akalala {d2}. Tetumanyi kaliwa, naye ennamba zombi zikozesebwa obusenge buno obubiri.
N'olwekyo tewali kasenge kalala {unit} akasobola kubaamu {d1} oba {d2}. Ggyawo {elim}.
Obusenge busatu {unit} buggya abesimbyewo baabwo bonna mu nnamba ssatu ze zimu, {digits}: {cells}.

Ennamba ezo essatu zirina okujjuza obusenge buno obusatu mu nsengeka emu. Akasenge tekeetaaga kulaga besimbyewo bonna basatu; ekikulu kiri nti tewali kasenge ku busatu kalina mwesimbyewo ebweru w'ennamba ezo essatu.
Ggyawo {digits} mu buli kasenge akalala {unit}: {elim}.

mistakes: Okutwala obusenge bubiri obugabana abesimbyewo babiri naye nga bulina n'owokusatu. Ku babiri abeeyoleka, buli kasenge kalina okuba n'abesimbyewo abo ababiri bokka era nga tekalina mulala.
Okuggyawo ennamba mu busenge bwa babiri bwennyini. Babiri bakuuma abesimbyewo baabwe; okuggyawo kugenda mu busenge obulala obw'ekibinja.
Okwetaaga nti buli kasenge ka basatu kalaga ennamba zonna ssatu. Akasenge akalina bbiri ku ssatu kali bulungi, kasita tewabaawo kasenge kalina mwesimbyewo ebweru w'ennamba ezo essatu.
faq: Babiri abeeyoleka mu Sudoku be baani?

Obusenge bubiri mu kibinja kimu nga bwombi bulina abesimbyewo babiri be bamu ddala. Ennamba ezo zombi zisibiddwa mu busenge obwo obubiri, n'olwekyo zisobola okuggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde eky'ekibinja.
Basatu abeeyoleka be baani?

Obusenge busatu mu kibinja kimu ng'abesimbyewo baabwo awamu nnamba ssatu zokka. Buli kasenge kasobola okubaamu bbiri oba ssatu ku zo. Ennamba essatu zijjuza obusenge obusatu, n'olwekyo zisobola okuggyibwa mu busenge obulala obw'ekibinja.
Babiri abeeyoleka bateeka ennamba?
Si bokka. Baggyawo abesimbyewo, era okuggyawo okwo kutera okulekawo omwesimbyewo omu yekka, eyeeyoleka oba akwese. Akabonero mu Bare Sudoku kalaga omwesimbyewo oyo era kategeeza enkola eyakisobozesa.
Babiri abeeyoleka basobola okuba mu kasanduuko ne mu lunyiriri omulundi gumu?
Yee. Obusenge obubiri bwe bugabana olunyiriri n'akasanduuko, babiri baggyawo mu bibinja byombi. Bare Sudoku ebakolako ekibinja kimu buli mulundi.

hidden-pairs.name: Babiri ne basatu abakwese
hidden-pairs.title: Babiri ne basatu abakwese mu Sudoku: engeri y'okubazuula
hidden-pairs.description: Babiri abakwese nnamba bbiri ezisobola okugenda mu busenge bubiri bwe bumu bwokka mu kibinja, n'olwekyo abesimbyewo abalala mu busenge obwo baggyibwawo.
hidden-pairs.h1: Babiri ne basatu abakwese (hidden pairs)
hidden-pairs.summary: Babiri abakwese nnamba bbiri ezi, mu lunyiriri, kkolamu oba kasanduuko, ziri besimbyewo mu busenge bubiri bwe bumu era tewali walala. Obusenge obwo obubiri bulina okubaamu ennamba ezo zombi, n'olwekyo buli mwesimbyewo omulala mu bwo asobola okuggyibwawo. Basatu abakwese bakola mu ngeri y'emu n'ennamba ssatu ezisibiddwa mu busenge busatu. Oluvannyuma lw'okuggyawo, obusenge bulaga babiri oba basatu abeeyoleka. Akabonero ka Bare Sudoku kayita entambula evaamu "Babiri oba basatu".
when: Ekibinja bwe kiba n'obusenge obulina abesimbyewo bangi era abesimbyewo abali bokka nga baggwaawo. Babiri abakwese beekweka mu busenge obujjudde, y'ensonga lwaki kirungi okubanoonya ddala awo babiri abeeyoleka we batalabika. Basatu abakwese tebatera kubaawo; Bare Sudoku ebanoonya, naye ebizibu bya Kizibu ebisinga bigonjoolebwa awatali bo.
spot: Kola ng'otunuulira ennamba, so si kasenge. Mu kibinja, laga obusenge buli nnamba ebulamu mw'eyinza okugenda. Ennamba bbiri bwe ziba nga buli emu erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obusoboka era nga bwe busenge bubiri bwe bumu, oba ozudde babiri abakwese. Mu muzannyo, nyiga eppeesa ly'ennamba okwakaayakanya abesimbyewo baayo; ennamba bbiri bwe zakaayakanya obusenge bubiri bwe bumu mu kibinja era nga tewali kirala mu kyo, ekyo kye kifaananyi.

steps: Ennamba {d1} ne {d2} {unit}, buli emu erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obusoboka, era bwe bubiri bwe bumu: {cells}.
Obusenge obwo obubiri bulina okubaamu {d1} ne {d2}, n'olwekyo abesimbyewo baabwo abalala tebasoboka.
Ggyawo {elim}. Kaakano obusenge obubiri bulaga babiri abeeyoleka, abayinza okusumulula ebirala.

mistakes: Okuggyawo ennamba bbiri eza babiri mu busenge bwa babiri. Abesimbyewo abalala ab'obusenge obwo be baggyibwawo; ennamba za babiri zisigalawo.
Okukkiriza ennamba erina akasenge ak'okusatu akasoboka mu kibinja. Ennamba zombi zirina okuba nga zikoma ku busenge obwo obubiri bwokka.
Okunoonya mu busanduuko bwokka. Babiri abakwese balabika emirundi mingi mu ngeri y'emu mu nnyiriri ne mu kkolamu.
faq: Babiri abakwese mu Sudoku be baani?
Ennamba bbiri ezisobola okugenda mu busenge bubiri bwe bumu bwokka mu kibinja. Obusenge obwo bulina okutwala ennamba ezo, n'olwekyo abesimbyewo baabwo abalala baggyibwawo.
Babiri abakwese baawukana batya ku beeyoleka?

Babiri abeeyoleka balabika: obusenge bubiri obulaga abesimbyewo babiri be bamu bokka. Babiri abakwese babikkiddwa abesimbyewo abeeyongedde mu busenge obwo obubiri. Okuggyawo abeeyongedde abo kufuula babiri abakwese okuba babiri abeeyoleka.
Basatu abakwese be baani?
Ennamba ssatu ezisibiddwa mu busenge busatu obw'ekibinja. Buli nnamba teyeetaaga kulabika mu busenge bwonna obusatu; ekikulu kiri nti tewali nnamba ku ssatu erina mwesimbyewo ebweru w'obusenge obwo.
Akabonero kaawula babiri abakwese ku beeyoleka?
Nedda. Bare Sudoku ezuula ebika byombi era eyita entambula evaamu "Babiri oba basatu". Empapula zino zibaawula kubanga bazuulibwa mu ngeri ez'enjawulo.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing mu Sudoku: engeri enkola gy'ekola
x-wing.description: X-Wing: ennamba erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obw'abesimbyewo mu nnyiriri bbiri, mu kkolamu bbiri ze zimu, eggyibwa mu kkolamu ezo awalala. Ekyokulabirako.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing kifaananyi ky'ennamba emu n'obusenge buna ku nkoona z'ekifaananyi eky'enkoona nnya. Ennamba bw'eba n'obusenge bubiri bwokka obw'abesimbyewo mu buli emu ku nnyiriri bbiri, era obusenge obwo nga buli mu kkolamu bbiri ze zimu, ennamba erina okubeera ku nkoona bbiri ezitunuuliganye ez'ekifaananyi ekyo. N'olwekyo esobola okuggyibwa mu buli kasenge akalala mu kkolamu ezo ebbiri. Kikola mu ngeri y'emu ng'ennyiriri ne kkolamu biwanyisiddwa. Y'enkola esooka eya Mukugu mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Abesimbyewo abali bokka, abasiba ne babiri ne basatu bwe baggwaawo. X-Wing kye kifaananyi kya Mukugu ekisinga okulabika era kitera okujja ng'ennamba esigazza abesimbyewo batono, emirundi mingi ng'eteekeddwa dda emirundi ena okutuuka ku mukaaga. Kyetaaga ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu eby'ennamba gy'okebera.
spot: Londa ennamba onoonye ennyiriri mw'erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obw'abesimbyewo. Ennyiriri bbiri ng'ezo bwe zigabana kkolamu bbiri ze zimu, kebera kkolamu ezo oba zirimu abesimbyewo abalala ab'ennamba eyo: abo be baggyibwawo. Oluvannyuma ddamu ng'otandikira ku kkolamu. Mu muzannyo, nyiga eppeesa ly'ennamba: buli mwesimbyewo waayo ayakaayakana, era ekifaananyi eky'enkoona nnya eky'ebiwandiiko bina ebyakaayakana kirabika mangu.

steps: Ennamba {d} erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obw'abesimbyewo mu lunyiriri {r1} ne bubiri bwokka mu lunyiriri {r2}, era bugwa mu kkolamu bbiri ze zimu, {c1} ne {c2}: {cells}.
Olunyiriri {r1} luteeka {d} yaalwo mu kkolamu {c1} oba {c2}, ate olunyiriri {r2} luteeka {d} yaalwo mu ndala. Buli ngeri, kkolamu {c1} ne {c2} buli emu efuna {d} okuva mu nnyiriri zino ebbiri.
N'olwekyo {d} teyinza kulabika walala mu kkolamu {c1} ne {c2}. Ggyawo {d} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Okukozesa olunyiriri olulina obusenge busatu obw'abesimbyewo b'ennamba. Buli lunyiriri olw'omusingi lulina okuba n'obubiri bwokka, era bwombi bulina okuba mu kkolamu ebbiri ezigabanyizibwa.
Okuggyawo ennamba mu nnyiriri mu kifo kya kkolamu. Ennyiriri bwe ziba omusingi, okuggyawo kuba mu kkolamu, era ne ku ludda olulala.
Okwerabira ekika ekiwanyisiddwa. X-Wing ezimbiddwa ku kkolamu eggyawo mu nnyiriri.
faq: X-Wing mu Sudoku kye ki?

Ennamba erina obusenge bubiri bwokka obw'abesimbyewo mu buli emu ku nnyiriri bbiri, mu kkolamu bbiri ze zimu. Ennamba ebeera ku nkoona bbiri ezitunuuliganye ez'ekifaananyi ekyo, n'olwekyo eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde ekya kkolamu ezo ebbiri. Ennyiriri ne kkolamu bisobola okuwanyisibwa.
Lwaki X-Wing ekola?

Buli emu ku nnyiriri ebbiri erina okuteeka ennamba mu emu ku kkolamu ebbiri, era ennyiriri ebbiri tezisobola kukozesa kkolamu y'emu. N'olwekyo kkolamu ebbiri buli emu efuna ennamba yaayo okuva mu nnyiriri zino, era buli mwesimbyewo omulala mu kkolamu ezo tasoboka.
X-Wing kyennyanja?
Yee. X-Wing kyennyanja kya bunene bubiri; Swordfish kyennyanja kya bunene busatu. Bare Sudoku ezuula byombi.
Mutendera ki ogulimu X-Wing?
Mukugu. Ekizibu ekyetaaga X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish oba XYZ-Wing kipimibwa nga Mukugu.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing mu Sudoku: engeri enkola gy'ekola
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): akasenge ak'omu makkati ak'abesimbyewo babiri n'ebiwaawaatiro bibiri ebigabana omu ku bo biggyawo ennamba mu busenge obulaba byombi.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, era eyitibwa XY-Wing, ekozesa obusenge busatu nga buli kamu kalina abesimbyewo babiri. Akasenge ak'omu makkati kalina abesimbyewo X ne Y. Ekiwaawaatiro ekimu kiraba akasenge ak'omu makkati era kirina X ne Z; ekiwaawaatiro ekirala kiraba akasenge ak'omu makkati era kirina Y ne Z. Akasenge ak'omu makkati ne bwe kaba ennamba ki, ekimu ku biwaawaatiro kirina okuba Z, n'olwekyo Z esobola okuggyibwa mu buli kasenge akalaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi. Y'enkola ya Mukugu mu Bare Sudoku.
when: Ekizibu bwe kiba n'obusenge obuwerako obulina abesimbyewo babiri bokka era nga tewali kyennyanja. Y-Wing zitera mu bizibu bya Mukugu era zizuulibwa ng'ogoberera obusenge obw'abesimbyewo babiri: buli kamu kasobola okuba akasenge ak'omu makkati oba ekiwaawaatiro.
spot: Wandiika obusenge obulina abesimbyewo babiri bokka. Ku buli kamu, kakwate ng'akasenge ak'omu makkati akalina abesimbyewo X ne Y, onoonye mu baliraanwa baako akasenge akalina X n'ennamba endala Z, n'akasenge akalina Y ne Z y'emu. Obwo obubiri bye biwaawaatiro. Oluvannyuma noonya obusenge obulaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi era obulimu Z. Weetegereze nti ebiwaawaatiro tebyetaaga kulabagana.

steps: Akasenge ak'omu makkati {pivot} kalina abesimbyewo {x} ne {y}. Kalaba {wingA}, akalina {x} ne {z}, ne {wingB}, akalina {y} ne {z}.
{pivot} bwe kaba {x}, {wingA} kafiirwa {x} ne kafuuka {z}. {pivot} bwe kaba {y}, {wingB} kafuuka {z}. Buli ngeri, ekimu ku biwaawaatiro ebibiri kiba {z}.
Akasenge akalaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi tekasobola kuba {z}. Ggyawo {z} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Okulonda ebiwaawaatiro nga byombi tebiraba kasenge ak'omu makkati. Buli kiwaawaatiro kirina okugabana olunyiriri, kkolamu oba akasanduuko n'akasenge ak'omu makkati.
Okuggyawo Z mu busenge obulaba ekiwaawaatiro kimu kyokka. Akasenge akaggyibwamu kalina okulaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi.
Okuggyawo Z mu kasenge ak'omu makkati. Mu Y-Wing akasenge ak'omu makkati tekalimu Z; bwe kaba nako, ekifaananyi kiba XYZ-Wing erina amateeka ag'enjawulo.
faq: Y-Wing mu Sudoku kye ki?

Obusenge busatu obw'abesimbyewo babiri: akasenge ak'omu makkati akalina X ne Y, ekiwaawaatiro ekirina X ne Z ekiraba akasenge ak'omu makkati, n'ekiwaawaatiro ekirina Y ne Z ekiraba akasenge ak'omu makkati. Ekiwaawaatiro kimu bulijjo kiba Z, n'olwekyo Z eggyibwa mu busenge obulaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi.
Y-Wing y'emu ne XY-Wing?
Yee. Amannya gombi ganyonnyola ekifaananyi kimu. Bare Sudoku ekiyita Y-Wing.
Lwaki ekiwaawaatiro kimu kirina okuba Z?

Akasenge ak'omu makkati bwe kaba X, ekiwaawaatiro ekisooka kifiirwa X ne kifuuka Z. Akasenge ak'omu makkati bwe kaba Y, ekiwaawaatiro eky'okubiri kifuuka Z. Akasenge ak'omu makkati kaba kimu ku ebyo ebibiri, n'olwekyo ekiwaawaatiro kimu kiba Z.
Y-Wing eggyawo mu busenge bumeka?
Emirundi mingi kamu oba bubiri: obusenge bwokka obulaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi era nga bukyalimu Z. Ekyo kimala okuzaala omwesimbyewo omu yekka.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish mu Sudoku: engeri enkola gy'ekola
swordfish.description: Swordfish: ennamba esibiddwa mu kkolamu ssatu mu nnyiriri ssatu eggyibwa mu kitundu ekisigadde ekya kkolamu ezo. Ekyennyanja kya bunene busatu n'ekyokulabirako.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish ye X-Wing ey'ennyiriri ssatu ne kkolamu ssatu. Ennamba bw'eba n'obusenge obw'abesimbyewo obutasukka busatu mu buli emu ku nnyiriri ssatu, era obusenge obwo bwonna nga bugwa mu kkolamu ssatu ze zimu, ennyiriri essatu zikozesa ennamba eyo mu kkolamu ezo, era ennamba esobola okuggyibwa mu buli kasenge akalala mu kkolamu essatu. Ennyiriri ne kkolamu bisobola okuwanyisibwa. Bare Sudoku enoonya Swordfish oluvannyuma lwa Y-Wing, mu bizibu bya Mukugu.
when: X-Wing ne Y-Wing bwe bitazuula kintu. Swordfish tezitera nga X-Wing era zeetaaga ennamba ng'abesimbyewo baayo basaasaanidde katono ku nnyiriri ssatu. Zeetaaga ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu era ebituufu eby'ennamba eyo.
spot: Londa ennamba onoonye ennyiriri ezirina obusenge bubiri oba busatu obw'abesimbyewo baayo. Ennyiriri ssatu ng'ezo bwe zibuna kkolamu ssatu zokka zonna awamu, kebera kkolamu ezo oba zirimu abesimbyewo abalala ab'ennamba. Buli lunyiriri si lwe lwetaaga omwesimbyewo mu buli kkolamu: Swordfish esobola okuba n'obusenge mukaaga, musanvu, munaana oba mwenda. Mu muzannyo, yakaayakanya ennamba n'eppeesa lyayo onoonye ennyiriri ssatu ng'abesimbyewo baazo bagwa mu kkolamu ssatu.

steps: Ennamba {d} erina obusenge obw'abesimbyewo obutasukka busatu mu buli emu ku nnyiriri {rows}, era obusenge obwo bwonna bugwa mu kkolamu {cols}: {cells}.

Buli emu ku nnyiriri essatu erina okuteeka {d} yaayo mu emu ku kkolamu essatu, era tewali nnyiriri bbiri eziyinza kukozesa kkolamu y'emu. N'olwekyo kkolamu essatu zifuna {d} yaazo okuva mu nnyiriri zino essatu.
Buli mwesimbyewo omulala owa {d} mu kkolamu {cols} tasoboka. Ggyawo {d} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Okwetaaga obusenge bwonna omwenda. Swordfish erina abesimbyewo babiri mu nnyiriri ezimu ekyali ntuufu, kasita ennyiriri essatu zibuna kkolamu ssatu zokka.
Okuteekamu olunyiriri olulina obusenge buna obw'abesimbyewo. Buli lunyiriri olw'omusingi lulina okuba n'obutasukka busatu, bwonna munda mu kkolamu essatu.
Okuggyawo mu nnyiriri ez'omusingi. Ennyiriri bwe ziba omusingi, okuggyawo kuba mu kkolamu essatu, ebweru w'ennyiriri ez'omusingi.
faq: Swordfish mu Sudoku kye ki?

Ennamba ng'abesimbyewo baayo mu nnyiriri ssatu basibiddwa mu kkolamu ssatu. Ennyiriri essatu zirina okuteeka ennamba mu kkolamu ezo essatu, emu mu buli emu, n'olwekyo ennamba eggyibwa mu busenge obulala obwa kkolamu ezo.
Swordfish eyawukana etya ku X-Wing?
Mu bunene bwokka: X-Wing ekozesa ennyiriri bbiri ne kkolamu bbiri, Swordfish ssatu ne ssatu. Okulowooza kwe kumu.
Swordfish yeetaaga obusenge mwenda ddala?
Nedda. Buli lunyiriri lusobola okuba n'abesimbyewo babiri oba basatu; ekifaananyi kyetaaga kyokka nti ennyiriri essatu awamu tezikozesa kkolamu ezisukka ssatu.
Waliwo ekyennyanja kya bunene buna?
Yee, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku tekikozesa, kubanga ebizibu byayo tebikyetaaga n'akatono.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing mu Sudoku: engeri enkola gy'ekola
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: akasenge ak'omu makkati ak'abesimbyewo basatu n'ebiwaawaatiro bibiri ebigabana omu ku bo biggyawo ennamba eyo mu busenge obulaba obusatu bwonna.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing ye Y-Wing ng'akasenge kaayo ak'omu makkati kalina abesimbyewo basatu. Akasenge ak'omu makkati kalina X, Y ne Z; ekiwaawaatiro ekimu kiraba akasenge ak'omu makkati era kirina X ne Z, ekirala kikalaba era kirina Y ne Z. Akamu ku busenge obusatu kalina okuba Z, n'olwekyo Z esobola okuggyibwa mu buli kasenge akalaba obusatu bwonna. Olw'okuba akasenge ak'omu makkati kennyini kasobola okuba Z, akasenge akaggyibwamu kalina okulaba akasenge ak'omu makkati wamu n'ebiwaawaatiro byombi, ekikakoma ku kibinja obusenge kye bugabana. Y'enkola esinga obuzibu Bare Sudoku gy'ekozesa.
when: Nga buli kirala kyonna kigaanye. XYZ-Wing kye kifaananyi ekisinga obutalabika mu Bare Sudoku era kirabika mu bizibu bya Mukugu byokka. Kinoonye ng'akasenge ak'abesimbyewo basatu kali mu kasanduuko n'akasenge ak'abesimbyewo babiri akagabana ennamba zaako bbiri.
spot: Tandikira ku busenge obulina abesimbyewo basatu bokka; buli kamu kasobola okuba akasenge ak'omu makkati. Mu baliraanwa baako, noonya obusenge bubiri nga buli kamu kalina abesimbyewo babiri, bonna nga baggyiddwa mu basatu ab'akasenge ak'omu makkati, era nga bugabana ennamba emu yokka Z. Oluvannyuma noonya obusenge obulaba akasenge ak'omu makkati n'ebiwaawaatiro byombi era obulimu Z. Mu nkola, ekiwaawaatiro ekimu kiri mu kasanduuko k'akasenge ak'omu makkati ate ekirala mu lunyiriri lwako oba kkolamu yaako, era obusenge obuggyibwamu bwe busenge obusigadde obw'akasanduuko ako mu lunyiriri oba kkolamu eyo.

steps: Akasenge ak'omu makkati {pivot} kalina abesimbyewo basatu: {x}, {y} ne {z}. Kalaba {wingA} akalina {x} ne {z}, ne {wingB} akalina {y} ne {z}.
{pivot} bwe kaba {z}, kiwedde. Bwe kaba {x}, {wingA} kalina okuba {z}. Bwe kaba {y}, {wingB} kalina okuba {z}. Buli ngeri, akamu ku busenge obusatu kaba {z}.
Akasenge akalaba obusatu bwonna tekasobola kuba {z}. Ggyawo {z} mu {elim}.

mistakes: Okuggyawo mu busenge obulaba ebiwaawaatiro byombi byokka. Okwawukana ku Y-Wing, akasenge ak'omu makkati kasobola okuba Z, n'olwekyo akasenge kalina okulaba n'akasenge ak'omu makkati.
Okukozesa ebiwaawaatiro ng'abesimbyewo baabyo si bonna nti bali mu basatu ab'akasenge ak'omu makkati.
Okukitabula ne Y-Wing: enjawulo ye mwesimbyewo ow'okusatu mu kasenge ak'omu makkati, era akyusa obusenge obuyinza okulongoosebwa.
faq: XYZ-Wing mu Sudoku kye ki?

Akasenge ak'omu makkati akalina abesimbyewo X, Y ne Z n'ebiwaawaatiro bibiri, ekimu nga kirina X ne Z ate ekirala Y ne Z, byombi nga biraba akasenge ak'omu makkati. Akamu ku busenge obusatu kaba Z, n'olwekyo Z eggyibwa mu busenge obulaba obusatu bwonna.
XYZ-Wing eyawukana etya ku Y-Wing?

Akasenge ak'omu makkati kalina abesimbyewo basatu mu kifo kya babiri, nga ne Z mwali. Ekyo kifuula akasenge ak'omu makkati ekifo Z w'eyinza okubeera, n'olwekyo obusenge bwokka obulaba akasenge ak'omu makkati n'ebiwaawaatiro byombi bwe buyinza okufiirwa Z.
XYZ-Wing erabika emirundi emeka?
Mirundi mitono nnyo. Mu Bare Sudoku ebizibu bya Mukugu byokka bye biyinza okugyetaaga, era ebisinga tebigyetaaga. Bare Sudoku egikebera esembayo, oluvannyuma lwa X-Wing, Y-Wing ne Swordfish.
Waliwo WXYZ-Wing?
Yee, n'akasenge ak'omu makkati ak'abesimbyewo bana, naye Bare Sudoku tegikozesa. Buli kizibu mu muzannyo kisobola okumalirizibwa n'enkola omwenda ez'endagiriro eno.

ak.learnText: Woyɛ foforo wɔ Sudoku mu, anaa asɛmmisa a ɛyɛ den bi asi wo kwan? Akwankyerɛ mmienu kyerɛkyerɛ mmara no ne ɔkwan biara a nkyerɛkyerɛmu no fa so mu, na emu biara wɔ nhwɛsoɔ ankasa.

howTo.title: Sɛnea Wodi Sudoku: Mmara, Pon no ne Anammɔn a Edi Kan
howTo.description: Sua sɛnea wodi Sudoku: mmara no, sɛnea nsantee, kɔlɔm ne adaka yɛ adwuma, nea enti asɛmmisa biara wɔ ano biako, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ne anammɔn a edi kan.
howTo.summary: Sudoku yɛ adwene asɛmmisa a ɛwɔ 9×9 grid so. Hyɛ dan hunu biara ma de nɔma fi 1 kosi 9 sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nsantee biara, kɔlɔm biara ne 3×3 adaka biara bɛkura nɔma biara pɛnkoro pɛ. Wɔde nɔma bi ma wɔ mfiase; wode adwene hwehwɛ nea aka no, dan biako a wunim no pɛpɛɛpɛ bere biara, na ɛnhia sɛ wususu da. Akwankyerɛ yi kyerɛkyerɛ pon no, mmara no, ano biako nnyinasoɔ no, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ne ɔkwan mmerɛw bi a wobɛfa so ayɛ wo anammɔn a edi kan mu. Wobɛtumi ayɛ ne nyinaa ho adwuma wɔ [Bare Sudoku](play) mu, a wontua hwee na ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu kyerɛkyerɛ adwene a ɛwɔ akyi no mu.

sections.h: Sudoku mmara ne dɛn?
p: Mmara mmiɛnsa pɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ, na ɛyɛ mmara biako a wohwɛ no fi afa mmiɛnsa: ɛsɛ sɛ nsantee biara kura nɔma 1 kosi 9, ɛsɛ sɛ kɔlɔm biara kura nɔma 1 kosi 9, na ɛsɛ sɛ 3×3 adaka biara kura nɔma 1 kosi 9. Enti nɔma biara ntumi mpue mprenu wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka koro mu da.

Nɔma a wɔde ama no, a wɔakyerɛw no duruduru no, ntumi nsesa. Wo adwuma ne sɛ wobɛhyɛ dan hunu no ma. Akontaabu biara nni mu, na nɔma no ntoatoaso nso nhia: nɔma no yɛ agyiraeɛ akron a ɛnsɛ kɛkɛ. Sɛ wode nkyerɛwde anaa nsɛsodeɛ di agorɔ no a, biribiara rensesa.

sections.h: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔahyehyɛ pon no?
p: Pon no wɔ dan 81 wɔ nsantee 9 ne kɔlɔm 9 mu. Nsensanee akɛse kyekyɛ mu yɛ no 3×3 adaka akron. Dan biara wɔ nsantee biako pɛ, kɔlɔm biako pɛ ne adaka biako pɛ mu, na saa akuw mmiɛnsa yi ne ne akuw. Dan 20 foforo a ɛne dan bi wɔ kuw koro mu no, wɔfrɛ wɔn ne mfɛfo; sɛ wode nɔma bi to dan bi mu a, ɛyi saa nɔma no fi ne mfɛfo 20 no nyinaa so.

Wɔkyerɛw dan te sɛ r3c7: nsantee 3, kɔlɔm 7. Wofi soro na ɛkan nsantee, wofi benkum na ɛkan kɔlɔm, na wofi benkum soro na ɛkan adaka 1 kosi 9, nsantee nsantee. Wɔde saa kyerɛwbea yi di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan biara ho akwankyerɛ mu, na ɛfata sɛ wusua: r5c5 ne pon no mfinimfini.

sections.h: Adɛn nti na Sudoku biara wɔ ano biako pɛ?
p: Sudoku pa wɔ ano biako, na ɛno na ɛma adwene yɛ adwuma. Bere biara a wobɛtumi akyerɛ sɛ nɔma bi ntumi nkɔ baabi foforo wɔ kuw bi mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ dan a aka no mu, efisɛ ano no wɔ hɔ na ɛyɛ biako pɛ. Sɛ asɛmmisa bi wɔ ano mmienu a, adwene biara rentumi nkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda wɔn ntam, na ɛbɛhyɛ wo ma woasusu bere bi.

Bare Sudoku yɛ asɛmmisa biara wɔ wo mfiri so, na ɛhwɛ sɛ ɛwɔ ano biako pɛ ne sɛ ne nea ɔde adwene di ho dwuma no betumi de agyinaeɛ a woapaw no akwan awie. Enti sɛ ɛsi wo kwan a, anammɔn a edi so bi wɔ hɔ bere biara a wobɛhwehwɛ, na nkyerɛkyerɛmu no kyerɛ.

sections.h: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wofi Sudoku asɛmmisa ase?
p: Fi baabi a akwan sua sen biara ase. Saa nhyehyɛe yi yɛ adwuma wɔ agyinaeɛ biara so:
list: Paw nɔma bi a apue mpɛn pii dedaw, te sɛ mprensia anaa mpɛn ason, na hwehwɛ adaka a ennya nnyaa no. Mpɛn pii no, dan biako pɛ na aka ama no wɔ adaka bi mu: ɛno ne [biako a ahintaw](hidden-single).

Hwehwɛ dan a nea atwa ho ahyia ayɛ ma. Dan a ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm ne n'adaka bom kura nɔma nwɔtwe a ɛnsɛ no, nea ɛfata biako pɛ na aka ama no: [biako a ɛda adi](naked-single). Dan a ɛwɔ nsantee anaa adaka a ayɛ kakra ama mu ne baabi pa a wobɛhwɛ.
Nɔma biara a wode to hɔ yi nea ɛfata biako fi ne mfɛfo 20 mu, enti hwɛ saa mfɛfo no ntɛm ara. Biako taa ba toatoa so.

Sɛ nɔma a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wode bɛto hɔ no sa a, kyerɛw nsɛm no: nea ɛfata ma dan hunu biara. Afei hwehwɛ nɔma bi a wɔde ato nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako mu wɔ adaka bi mu ([nea wɔato mu](locked-candidates)) anaa dan mmienu a wɔn nea ɛfata mmienu no yɛ pɛ ([mmienu a ɛda adi](naked-pairs)).
Woyi nea ɛfata biara a, san hwehwɛ biako. Mpo Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa no, biako na wɔde di dodow no ara ho dwuma; ɔkwan a ɛkɔ anim no bue nea edi so no kwan kɛkɛ.

sections.h: Dɛn ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, na bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wode di dwuma?
p: Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, a wɔsan frɛ no pɛnsere nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa nea ɛfata, ne nɔma nketewa a wokyerɛw wɔ dan hunu mu de kyerɛ nɔma a ebetumi akɔ hɔ. Wɔ nsɛmmisa a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu no, ɛntaa nhia wo; efi Ɛyɛ den kɔ soro no, ɛho hia yiye, efisɛ akwan te sɛ mmienu, X-Wing ne Y-Wing fa nea ɛfata ho, ɛnyɛ nɔma a wɔde ato hɔ.

Ma wo nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no nyɛ nokware: sɛ wode nɔma bi to hɔ a, yi fi ne mfɛfo 20 no nyinaa nsɛm mu. Wɔ Bare Sudoku mu no, eyi yɛ ne ho, na Hyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ma kyerɛw nea ɛfata biara gu dan hunu biara mu wɔ mia biako mu, enti wobɛtumi afi nea ɛfata a edi mu na ɛyɛ nokware ase. Asɛm a wɔakyerɛw yɛ nokwasɛm, ɛnyɛ nsusuwii: ɛkyerɛ sɛ biribiara nnya nyii saa nɔma yi mfii hɔ.

sections.h: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ ɛsi wo kwan a?
p: Di kan san hwɛ nneɛma titiriw no: nsantee, kɔlɔm ne adaka biara a ayɛ kakra ama no yɛ baabi a biako fi ba. Afei hwɛ sɛ wo nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no di mu, efisɛ nea ɛfata a ɛyera hintaw nhyehyɛe, na nea ɛfata a ɛnsɛ hɔ bio bɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ nokware. Afei fa [akwan](techniques) no so sɛnea wɔn den te: nea wɔato mu, mmienu ne mmiɛnsa, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ne XYZ-Wing. Emu biara wɔ ne krataafa a nhwɛsoɔ ankasa wɔ so.

Sɛ biribiara anyɛ yiye a, fa nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Wɔ Bare Sudoku mu no, nkyerɛkyerɛmu no di kan hwɛ sɛ nɔma bi a wode ato hɔ nyɛ nokware, afei ɛhwehwɛ dan a edi so a wobɛtumi de adwene ahyɛ ma na ɛbɔ ɔkwan no din, enti wusua biribi mpo bere a wode di dwuma. Mia nkyerɛkyerɛmu no bio na ɛde nɔma no ato hɔ.

sections.h: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wode nɔma hyɛ Bare Sudoku mu?
p: Mia dan bi, afei mia nɔma bi. Anaa di kan mia nɔma: ɛto mu, na dan biara a wobɛmia no nya no, na ɛno ne ɔkwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm sen biara a wode bɛto nɔma bi a ɛto so asia, ason ne awotwe no. Mia nɔma no bio na ɛbue. Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw bɔtɔm no dan kɔ pɛnsere nsɛnkyerɛnne so, Popa pepa dan bi, San kɔ sane anammɔn biara, na wɔde kɔkɔɔ kyerɛ mfomso gye sɛ wodum no wɔ menu no mu.

Wɔ keyboard so no, fa agyan nsafe no kɔ baabiara, 1 kosi 9 de hyɛ nɔma, Backspace de popa, N ma nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw, U ma san kɔ, H ma nkyerɛkyerɛmu, F de hyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ma, ne Escape ma menu no. Agodie no kora ne ho so, ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ, dawurubɔ biara nni mu, na ɛnhia sɛ wobue akawnt.

faq: Ɛho hia sɛ wususu wɔ Sudoku mu da?

Ɛnhia wɔ asɛmmisa pa mu. Bare Sudoku asɛmmisa biara wɔ ano biako pɛ, na wɔahwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi de adwene nko ara adi ho dwuma, de akɔsi n'agyinaeɛ akwan so. Sɛ wote nka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wususu a, nea ɛfata bi ayera wɔ wo nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw mu, anaa ɔkwan bi retwɛn sɛ wobɛhu no.
Nɔma bi betumi apue mprenu wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka mu?

Dabi. Ɛno ne mmara no nyinaa: nsantee akron, kɔlɔm akron ne adaka akron no mu biara kura nɔma biara fi 1 kosi 9 pɛnkoro pɛ. Sɛ nɔma mmienu a ɛsɛ wɔ kuw koro mu a, anyɛ yiye koraa no emu biako nyɛ nokware.
Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda Ɛyɛ mmerɛw, Mfinimfini, Ɛyɛ den ne Ɔbenfo ntam?

Akwan a asɛmmisa no hia na ɛkyerɛ n'agyinaeɛ. Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini de biako nko ara na wodi ho dwuma, na Ɛyɛ mmerɛw de nɔma 38 anaa nea ɛboro saa a wɔde ama na ɛfi ase. Ɛyɛ den hia nea wɔato mu anaa mmienu ne mmiɛnsa. Ɔbenfo hia X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish anaa XYZ-Wing.
Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wobɛhyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ama dan biara anaa ebi nko ara?

Wɔ Ɛyɛ den ne Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa mu no, hyɛ ne nyinaa ma: nhyehyɛe te sɛ mmienu, X-Wing ne Y-Wing da adi bere a wɔakyerɛw nea ɛfata biara nko ara. Wɔ Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini mu no, nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw yɛ wo pɛ, na agodifo dodow no ara hwehwɛ biako kɛkɛ.
Bere bɛn na Sudoku gye?

Ɛyɛ mmerɛw asɛmmisa gye simma kakraa bi; Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa betumi agye simma aduonu anaa nea ɛboro saa, ɛgyina sɛnea wuhu nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ anim no ntɛm so. Bare Sudoku kyerɛ dɔnhwerew, ɛgyina no bere a menu no abue, na ɛnkora akansifo din, enti di agorɔ no wɔ w'ankasa wo ahoɔhare so.
Sudoku hia akontaabu?
Dabi. Nɔma no yɛ din kɛkɛ; ɛnhia sɛ wobɔ ka anaa wokan biribi. Agyiraeɛ akron biara bɛyɛ adwuma, na ɛno nti na Sudoku yɛ adwene asɛmmisa sen nɔma asɛmmisa.

index.title: Akwan a Wɔfa so Di Sudoku Ho Dwuma ne Nhwɛsoɔ
index.description: Sudoku akwan akron nyinaa, efi biako a ɛda adi kosi Swordfish ne XYZ-Wing, sɛnea Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu fa so no, na emu biara wɔ nhwɛsoɔ ankasa.
index.h1: Akwan a wɔfa so di Sudoku ho dwuma
intro: Wobɛtumi de adwene akwan kakraa bi adi Sudoku biara ho dwuma. Saa krataafa yi bobɔ akwan akron a Bare Sudoku dwumayɛfo ne ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu de di dwuma no din, sɛnea dwumayɛfo no sɔ hwɛ no: biako di kan, afei nea wɔyi fi nea ɛfata mu wɔ kuw biako mu, afei nhyehyɛe a etrɛw nsantee ne kɔlɔm pii so. Ɔkwan biara wɔ ne krataafa a nkyerɛase, sɛnea wobehu no, nhwɛsoɔ ankasa a efi asɛmmisa a wɔayɛ mu ne mfomso a ɛtaa ba wɔ so.

Ɔkwan a ɛyɛ den sen biara a asɛmmisa bi hia na ɛkyerɛ n'agyinaeɛ. Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini nsɛmmisa hia biako nko ara, Ɛyɛ den nsɛmmisa hia nea wɔato mu anaa mmienu ne mmiɛnsa, na Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa hia apataa anaa ntaban biako anyɛ yiye koraa. Agyinaeɛ biara a ɛyɛ no, biako na ɛyɛ adwuma no dodow; ɔkwan a ɛkɔ anim no yi nea ɛfata biako anaa mmienu, na biako toa so fi hɔ.
faq: Nhyehyɛe bɛn so na ɛsɛ sɛ mesɔ Sudoku akwan no hwɛ?

Nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw di kan: biako a ɛda adi, biako a ahintaw, nea wɔato mu, mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi, mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ahintaw, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku sɔ hwɛ saa nhyehyɛe yi pɛpɛɛpɛ, na nkyerɛkyerɛmu bɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara a ɛde nkɔso ba no din daa.
Mehia saa akwan yi nyinaa ansa na matumi adi Sudoku ho dwuma?

Wɔ Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini nsɛmmisa mu no, biako dɔɔso. Ɛyɛ den nsɛmmisa de nea wɔato mu ne mmienu ne mmiɛnsa ka ho. Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa hia apataa anaa ntaban biako anyɛ yiye koraa, nanso mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ pɛnkoro anaa mprenu pɛ wɔ asɛmmisa biara mu.
Akwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ den sen XYZ-Wing?

Aane, te sɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn, ano biako ho sɔhwɛ ne nhama a ɛhyɛ (forcing nets). Bare Sudoku nyɛ nsɛmmisa a ɛhia saa akwan yi, enti asɛmmisa biara a ɛwɔ agodie no mu, wobɛtumi de akwan akron a ɛwɔ saa krataafa yi so no awie.
Dɛn ne nea ɛfata?

Nɔma a ebetumi akɔ dan hunu bi mu efisɛ biribiara a ɛwɔ ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm anaa n'adaka mu nnya nyii no mfii hɔ. Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw wɔ agodie no mu yɛ nea ɛfata. Ɔkwan biara a ɛboro biako so de adwene fa nea ɛfata ho, enti ma ɛnyɛ nea edi mu na ɛyɛ nokware.

naked-single.name: Biako a ɛda adi
naked-single.title: Biako a Ɛda Adi wɔ Sudoku mu: Dan a Nea Ɛfata Biako Wom
naked-single.description: Biako a ɛda adi yɛ dan hunu a nɔma biako pɛ na ebetumi akɔ mu. Sua sɛnea wobehu no ntɛm, nhwɛsoɔ ankasa anammɔn anammɔn ne mfomso a ɛtaa ba.
naked-single.summary: Biako a ɛda adi yɛ dan hunu a nea ɛfata biako pɛ wom: nɔma nwɔtwe foforo no wɔ ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm anaa n'adaka mu dedaw. Nɔma a aka no na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ hɔ. Ɛno ne Sudoku ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara, nea wode di dwuma pii sen biara, na Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho asɛm sɛ "Nea ɔfata biako pɛ wɔ ha".
when: Bere biara. Biako a ɛda adi pue fi anammɔn a edi kan kosi nea etwa to, wɔ agyinaeɛ biara so. Wɔ Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini nsɛmmisa mu no, ɛne biako a ahintaw ne akwan nko ara a wuhia. Wɔ nsɛmmisa a ɛyɛ den mu no, nea ɔkwan a ɛkɔ anim biara yi fi hɔ taa gyaw biako a ɛda adi, enti hwɛ ma no anammɔn biara akyi.
spot: Hwɛ dan a ne mfɛfo pii wɔ nɔma dedaw: dan a ɛwɔ nsantee a nɔma ason wom dedaw mu, anaa dan a ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm ne n'adaka bom kura nɔma nwɔtwe a ɛnsɛ. Sɛ wonni nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a, kan nɔma a wuhu fi dan no so. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a, biako a ɛda adi yɛ dan a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛfata biako pɛ, na ɛno nti na Hyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ma ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehu no.

steps: Hwɛ {cell}. Ɛyɛ hunu, enti kyerɛw nɔma biara a wɔde ato ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm ne n'adaka mu dedaw.
Nsantee {row} kura {rowDigits}. Kɔlɔm {col} kura {colDigits}. Adaka {box} kura {boxDigits}.
Wɔbom yi nɔma biara fi hɔ gye {d}, enti {d} ne nea ɛfata biako pɛ a aka wɔ {cell}.
Kyerɛw {d} wɔ {cell}. Afei hwɛ sɛ nɔma foforo no de biako foforo aba nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka koro no mu.

mistakes: Wobɛkan nsantee no nko ara anaa adaka no nko ara. Nɔma nwɔtwe a wɔyi fi hɔ no taa fi akuw mmiɛnsa no nyinaa mu.
Werɛ befi wo sɛ nɔma a wode too hɔ seesei ara nso yi nea ɛfata fi ne mfɛfo 20 mu; biako a ɛda adi foforo pue ntɛm ara wode nɔma biara to hɔ akyi.
Wobɛfra biako a ɛda adi ne biako a ahintaw: biako a ɛda adi wɔ nea ɛfata biako a aka wɔ dan no mu, biako a ahintaw wɔ dan biako a aka ma nɔma no wɔ kuw bi mu.
faq: Dɛn ne biako a ɛda adi wɔ Sudoku mu?
Dan hunu a nea ɛfata biako pɛ wom. Wɔde nɔma nwɔtwe a ɛnsɛ ato ne nsantee, ne kɔlɔm ne n'adaka mu dedaw, enti nɔma a ɛto so akron no nko ara na ɛfata.
Adɛn nti na wɔfrɛ no "a ɛda adi"?
Efisɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw nsɛm no wie a, nea ɛfata biako no da adi wɔ dan no mu tẽẽ; biribiara nhintaw no. Biako a ahintaw de, ɛtena nea ɛfata foforo ntam, na wohwɛ nɔma no na ɛnyɛ dan no na wohu no.
Wobɛtumi de biako a ɛda adi nko ara adi asɛmmisa bi ho dwuma?

Ɛyɛ mmerɛw nsɛmmisa pii de, aane, nanso dodow no ara hia biako a ahintaw nso. Bare Sudoku kyerɛ sɛ Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini nsɛmmisa yɛ nea wobɛtumi de biako ahorow mmienu no adi ho dwuma; Ɛyɛ den ne Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa hia ɔkwan foforo biako anyɛ yiye koraa.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu no kyerɛ biako a ɛda adi?
Aane. Sɛ nɔma a edi so a wode bɛto hɔ yɛ biako a ɛda adi a, nkyerɛkyerɛmu no paw dan no na ɛka sɛ "Nea ɔfata biako pɛ wɔ ha" ne nɔma no. Mia nkyerɛkyerɛmu no bio na ɛde ato hɔ.

hidden-single.name: Biako a ahintaw
hidden-single.title: Biako a Ahintaw wɔ Sudoku mu: Baabi Biako Pɛ ma Nɔma Bi
hidden-single.description: Biako a ahintaw ne dan biako pɛ a nɔma bi betumi akɔ wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka mu. Sua sɛnea wobehu no denam nɔma biako biako a wohwɛ so.
hidden-single.summary: Biako a ahintaw yɛ nɔma a dan biako pɛ na aka a ebetumi akɔ mu wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka bi mu, sɛ dan no kyerɛ nea ɛfata foforo mpo a. Esiane sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ kuw no kura nɔma no nti, ɛkɔ hɔ. Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho asɛm sɛ "Baabi biako pɛ a 5 bɛtumi akɔ wɔ saa nkyekyɛmu yi mu", anaa kɔlum anaa adaka.
when: Bere biara a nɔma bi akɔ anim yiye: sɛ nɔma bi apue mprenum anaa mprensia a, adaka a aka no akwan ayɛ teaa, na biako a ahintaw taa yɛ anammɔn a edi so. Biako a ahintaw ne Ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne Mfinimfini nsɛmmisa ɔkwan titiriw, na ɛkɔ so yɛ adwuma kɛse wɔ agyinaeɛ biara so.
spot: Hwɛ nɔma biako biako. Fa nɔma bi, hwehwɛ adaka a ɛnni hɔ, na twa dan biara a ɛwɔ saa adaka no mu a ɛne nɔma no bi a wɔde ato hɔ wɔ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm koro mu no so. Sɛ dan biako pɛ na aka a, woahu biako a ahintaw. Saa hwɛ koro yi ara yɛ adwuma wɔ nsantee ne kɔlɔm mu. Wɔ agodie no mu no, mia nɔma bi a wɔde ato hɔ: ne nyinaa hyerɛn, enti dan a ɛda hɔ kwa no da adi.

steps: Adaka {box} nnya nni {d}, enti ɛsɛ sɛ ne dan hunu no mu biako kura. Dan hunu no ne {empties}.
Wɔ emu biara mu gye {cell}, {d} a wɔde ato nsantee anaa kɔlɔm koro mu dedaw siw {d} kwan, enti {d} nyɛ nea ɛfata wɔ hɔ.
Ɛno gyaw {cell} sɛ baabi biako pɛ a {d} betumi akɔ wɔ adaka {box} mu. Kyerɛw {d} wɔ hɔ, sɛ {cell} da so kyerɛ nea ɛfata foforo mpo a.

mistakes: Wode nɔma no bɛto dan a ebia ɛyɛ nea ɛfata kɛkɛ mu: hwɛ dan hunu foforo biara a ɛwɔ kuw no mu, ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee no nko ara.
Wobɛpa biako a ahintaw efisɛ dan no kyerɛ nea ɛfata pii. Nea ɛfata foforo no nhia; nea ɛhia ne sɛ nɔma no nni baabi foforo wɔ kuw no mu.
Wobɛhwɛ adaka nko ara. Nsantee ne kɔlɔm nso ma biako a ahintaw pii saa ara, titiriw wɔ awiei.
faq: Dɛn ne biako a ahintaw wɔ Sudoku mu?
Nɔma a ebetumi akɔ dan biako pɛ mu wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka bi mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ kuw no kura nɔma no, enti dan no asɛm asi pi, sɛ nea ɛfata foforo da so wɔ mu mpo a.
Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda biako a ahintaw ne biako a ɛda adi ntam?
Biako a ɛda adi fa dan ho: nea ɛfata biako na aka. Biako a ahintaw fa nɔma ho: dan biako na aka wɔ kuw bi mu. Wɔn mmienu nyinaa de nɔma to hɔ a akyinnye biara nni ho.
Ɛhe na ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehu?

Sɛ wonni nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a, biako a ahintaw taa yɛ mmerɛw, efisɛ wobɛtumi ahwɛ pon no ama nɔma biako biako. Sɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no di mu a, biako a ɛda adi na ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara, efisɛ dan a nea ɛfata biako wom no da adi.
Ɔkwan bɛn so na nkyerɛkyerɛmu no ka biako a ahintaw ho asɛm?
Ɛka sɛ "Baabi biako pɛ a" nɔma no "bɛtumi akɔ" wɔ saa nkyekyɛmu, saa kɔlum anaa saa adaka yi mu, na wapaw dan no. Mia nkyerɛkyerɛmu no bio na ɛde ato hɔ.

locked-candidates.name: Nea wɔato mu
locked-candidates.title: Nea Wɔato Mu wɔ Sudoku mu: Ɛkyerɛ ne Ɛfa Ma Ne Ho
locked-candidates.description: Nea wɔato mu: sɛ nɔma bi nea ɛfata nyinaa wɔ adaka bi mu da nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako mu, anaa ne nea ɛbɔ abira, wɔyi nɔma no fi baabi foforo.
locked-candidates.summary: Nea wɔato mu ne ɔkwan a edi kan a ɛyi nea ɛfata fi hɔ mmom sen sɛ ɛde nɔma bɛto hɔ. Ɛwɔ ɔkwan mmienu. Ɛkyerɛ (pointing): wɔ adaka bi mu, nɔma bi nea ɛfata nyinaa da nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako mu, enti wɔyi nɔma no fi saa nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no nkae mu. Ɛfa ma ne ho (claiming): wɔ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm bi mu, nɔma bi nea ɛfata nyinaa da adaka biako mu, enti wɔyi nɔma no fi saa adaka no nkae mu. Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu de "Nea wɔato mu" kyerɛ nɔma a ɛma wotumi de to hɔ no.
when: Sɛ biako asa wɔ Ɛyɛ den asɛmmisa mu a, eyi ne nea edi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ wosɔ hwɛ. Ɛhia nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a edi mu, anyɛ yiye koraa ma nɔma a worehwɛ no. Nea wɔato mu taa ba: Ɛyɛ den nsɛmmisa dodow no ara hia, na Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa de di dwuma wɔ nhyehyɛe akɛse no ntam.
spot: Wɔ ɛkyerɛ mu no, hwɛ adaka biara ne nɔma biara a ɛnni mu: sɛ saa nɔma no dan a ɛfata no da nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako mu a, hwɛ sɛ nɔma koro no ara yɛ nea ɛfata wɔ saa nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no so wɔ adaka no akyi. Wɔ ɛfa ma ne ho mu no, hwɛ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm bi so: sɛ nɔma bi nea ɛfata nyinaa wɔ adaka biako mu a, wobɛtumi apopa no afi adaka no nkae mu. Wɔ agodie no mu no, mia nɔma nsafe bi na ne nea ɛfata nyinaa ahyerɛn; nsɛm mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa a ahyerɛn a ɛda nsensanee biako so wɔ adaka biako mu ne nhyehyɛe no.

steps: Wɔ adaka {box} mu, nɔma {d} wɔ dan a ɛfata yi nko ara: {cells}. Ne nyinaa da nsantee {row} mu.
Adaka {box} hia {d}, enti nsantee {row} {d} no wɔ adaka {box} mu, ɛmfa ho dan a ɛbɛtɔ mu.
Nsantee {row} ntumi nkura {d} a ɛto so mmienu, enti yi {d} fi nsantee {row} dan a ɛwɔ adaka no akyi no mu: {elim}.
Wɔ nsantee {row} mu, {d} betumi akɔ {cells} nko ara, na ne nyinaa wɔ adaka {box} mu.
Ɛsɛ sɛ nsantee {row} kura {d}, enti nsantee {row} fa adaka {box} {d} no ma ne ho. Adaka {box} dan foforo no ntumi nkura {d}.
Yi {d} fi {elim}.

mistakes: Wobɛyi nɔma no afi adaka no mu sen sɛ wobɛyi afi n'akyi wɔ ɛkyerɛ mu, anaa nea ɛbɔ abira wɔ ɛfa ma ne ho mu. Bere biara, nea wɔyi no kɔ dan a ɛwɔ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no mu nanso ɛnni adaka no mu, anaa dan a ɛwɔ adaka no mu nanso ɛnni nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no mu.
Wode mmara no bɛdi dwuma bere a nea ɛfata no trɛw adaka no nsantee mmienu so. Ɛsɛ sɛ nɔma no dan a ɛfata nyinaa wɔ adaka no mu da nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako mu.
Werɛ befi wo sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ biako a nea woyi no de ba. Nea wɔato mu ntaa mfa nɔma nto hɔ ankasa; ɛsiesie biako ma.
faq: Dɛn ne nea wɔato mu wɔ Sudoku mu?

Nɔma bi nea ɛfata a wɔato mu wɔ baabi a adaka ne nsantee anaa kɔlɔm hyia. Esiane sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ adaka no, anaa nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no, kura nɔma no wɔ saa hyiabea no nti, wobɛtumi ayi nɔma no afi nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no nkae mu, anaa adaka no nkae mu.
Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda ɛkyerɛ ne ɛfa ma ne ho ntam?

Ɛkyerɛ fi adaka ase: nɔma no nea ɛfata wɔ adaka no mu kyerɛ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm biako so, enti wɔyi nɔma no fi saa nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no nkae mu. Ɛfa ma ne ho fi nsantee anaa kɔlɔm ase: nea ɛfata ma nɔma no wɔ saa nsantee anaa kɔlɔm no mu nyinaa wɔ adaka biako mu, enti ɛfa nɔma no ma ne ho, na wɔyi no fi adaka no nkae mu.
Wɔsan frɛ nea wɔato mu sɛ nea wɔyi wɔ hyiabea (intersection removal)?

Aane. Din foforo ne adaka ne nsensanee so tew (box-line reduction) ma ɛfa ma ne ho, ne mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa a ɛkyerɛ (pointing pairs, pointing triples) ma ɛkyerɛ. Bare Sudoku de din biako ma ne mmienu nyinaa.
Agyinaeɛ bɛn na ɛhia nea wɔato mu?
Ɛyɛ den. Asɛmmisa a ɛhia nea wɔato mu anaa mmienu ne mmiɛnsa nanso ɛnhia biribi a ɛyɛ den sen saa no, wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ Ɛyɛ den; Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa hia apataa anaa ntaban nso.

naked-pairs.name: Mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi
naked-pairs.title: Mmienu ne Mmiɛnsa a Ɛda Adi wɔ Sudoku mu: Sɛnea Ɛyɛ Adwuma
naked-pairs.description: Mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi: dan mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa wɔ kuw bi mu a wɔkyɛ nea ɛfata koro. Sua sɛnea wobehu wɔn ne nea wobɛyi, nhwɛsoɔ ankasa.
naked-pairs.h1: Mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi (naked pair, naked triple)
naked-pairs.summary: Mmienu a ɛda adi yɛ dan mmienu a ɛwɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka koro mu a wɔn nea ɛfata mmienu no yɛ pɛ pɛɛ. Ɛsɛ sɛ nɔma mmienu no kɔ saa dan mmienu no mu, enti wobɛtumi ayi wɔn afi kuw no dan foforo biara mu. Mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi yɛ adwene koro no ara wɔ dan mmiɛnsa ne nɔma mmiɛnsa mu; dan biara betumi akyerɛ emu mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa no nyinaa. Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu de "Mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa" kyerɛ nɔma a efi mu ba no.
when: Bere a nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no adi mu na biako ne nea wɔato mu asa. Mmienu a ɛda adi taa ba wɔ Ɛyɛ den nsɛmmisa mu yiye, mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi nnɔɔso saa. Ɛfata sɛ wohwɛ wɔn mmienu nyinaa wɔ kuw biara a dan hunu anum anaa nea ɛboro saa da so wɔ mu.
spot: Hwehwɛ dan a nea ɛfata mmienu pɛ wom, na hwehwɛ dan foforo wɔ kuw koro no mu a nea ɛfata mmienu koro no ara wom. Wɔ mmiɛnsa mu no, hwɛ kuw a dan pii a nea ɛfata mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wom wɔ mu, na hwɛ sɛ emu mmiɛnsa bom de nɔma mmiɛnsa a ɛnsɛ nko ara di dwuma. Sɛ wɔakyerɛw nsɛm no a, ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehu dan a wɔn nea ɛfata yɛ pɛ pɛɛ; wɔ agodie no mu no, Hyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ma yɛ saa wɔ mia biako mu.

steps: {cellA} ne {cellB} a ɛwɔ {unit} mu no wɔ nea ɛfata mmienu koro pɛɛ: {d1} ne {d2}.
Ɛsɛ sɛ emu biako yɛ {d1} na biako no yɛ {d2}. Yennim nea ɛyɛ dea, nanso saa dan mmienu yi de nɔma mmienu no nyinaa adi dwuma.
Enti dan foforo biara a ɛwɔ {unit} mu ntumi nkura {d1} anaa {d2}. Yi {elim}.
Dan mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ {unit} mu nya wɔn nea ɛfata nyinaa fi nɔma mmiɛnsa koro, {digits}, mu: {cells}.

Ɛsɛ sɛ nɔma mmiɛnsa no hyɛ saa dan mmiɛnsa yi ma wɔ nhyehyɛe bi so. Ɛnhia sɛ dan biara kyerɛ nea ɛfata mmiɛnsa no nyinaa; nea ɛhia ne sɛ dan mmiɛnsa no mu biara nni nea ɛfata a ɛnka saa nɔma mmiɛnsa no ho.
Yi {digits} fi dan foforo biara a ɛwɔ {unit} mu: {elim}.

mistakes: Wobɛfa dan mmienu a wɔkyɛ nea ɛfata mmienu nanso nea ɛto so mmiɛnsa nso wom. Wɔ mmienu a ɛda adi mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ dan biara kura nea ɛfata mmienu no pɛɛ na biribi foforo nka ho.
Wobɛyi nɔma no afi mmienu no ankasa dan mu. Mmienu no kora ne nea ɛfata; nea wɔyi no kɔ kuw no dan foforo mu.
Wobɛhwehwɛ sɛ mmiɛnsa no dan biara kyerɛ nɔma mmiɛnsa no nyinaa. Dan a emu mmienu wom no yɛ, sɛ dan biara nni nea ɛfata a ɛnka nɔma mmiɛnsa no ho a.
faq: Dɛn ne mmienu a ɛda adi wɔ Sudoku mu?
Dan mmienu wɔ kuw biako mu a wɔn mmienu nyinaa wɔ nea ɛfata mmienu koro pɛɛ. Wɔato saa nɔma mmienu no mu wɔ saa dan mmienu no mu, enti wobɛtumi ayi wɔn afi kuw no nkae mu.
Dɛn ne mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi?

Dan mmiɛnsa wɔ kuw biako mu a wɔn nea ɛfata bom yɛ nɔma mmiɛnsa pɛ. Dan biara betumi akura emu mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa. Nɔma mmiɛnsa no hyɛ dan mmiɛnsa no ma, enti wobɛtumi ayi wɔn afi kuw no dan foforo mu.
Mmienu a ɛda adi de nɔma to hɔ?
Ɛnyɛ ɛno ankasa. Eyi nea ɛfata, na nea woyi no taa gyaw biako a ɛda adi anaa biako a ahintaw. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛwɔ Bare Sudoku mu kyerɛ saa biako no na ɛbɔ ɔkwan a ɛmaa ɛyɛɛ yiye no din.
Mmienu a ɛda adi betumi awɔ adaka ne nsantee mu bere koro mu?
Aane. Sɛ dan mmienu no wɔ nsantee koro ne adaka koro mu a, mmienu no yi nea ɛfata wɔ akuw mmienu no nyinaa mu. Bare Sudoku hwɛ wɔn kuw biako biako.

hidden-pairs.name: Mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ahintaw
hidden-pairs.title: Mmienu ne Mmiɛnsa a Ahintaw wɔ Sudoku mu: Sɛnea Wobehu
hidden-pairs.description: Mmienu a ahintaw yɛ nɔma mmienu a ebetumi akɔ dan mmienu koro mu wɔ kuw bi mu, enti wɔyi wɔn nea ɛfata foforo. Sua sɛnea wobehu wɔn anammɔn anammɔn.
hidden-pairs.h1: Mmienu ne mmiɛnsa a ahintaw (hidden pair, hidden triple)
hidden-pairs.summary: Mmienu a ahintaw yɛ nɔma mmienu a, wɔ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka biako mu, ɛyɛ nea ɛfata wɔ dan mmienu koro mu nko ara na ɛnni baabi foforo. Ɛsɛ sɛ saa dan mmienu no kura saa nɔma mmienu no, enti wobɛtumi ayi nea ɛfata foforo biara a ɛwɔ wɔn mu. Mmiɛnsa a ahintaw yɛ adwuma saa ara wɔ nɔma mmiɛnsa a wɔato mu wɔ dan mmiɛnsa mu. Woyi wie a, dan no kyerɛ mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa a ɛda adi. Bare Sudoku nkyerɛkyerɛmu de "Mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa" kyerɛ nɔma a efi mu ba no.
when: Bere a kuw bi wɔ dan a nea ɛfata pii wom na biako asa. Mmienu a ahintaw hintaw dan a ahyɛ ma mu, na ɛno nti na ɛfata sɛ wohwehwɛ wɔn wɔ baabi pɛɛ a mmienu a ɛda adi nni hɔ. Mmiɛnsa a ahintaw nnɔɔso; Bare Sudoku hwehwɛ wɔn, nanso wodi Ɛyɛ den nsɛmmisa dodow no ara ho dwuma a wonhia wɔn.
spot: Fa nɔma so, ɛnyɛ dan so. Wɔ kuw bi mu no, hyɛ dan a nɔma biara a ɛnni hɔ betumi akɔ mu no nsow. Sɛ nɔma mmienu mu biara wɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ebetumi akɔ mu, na ɛyɛ dan mmienu koro no ara a, woanya mmienu a ahintaw. Wɔ agodie no mu no, mia nɔma nsafe bi na ne nea ɛfata ahyerɛn; sɛ nɔma mmienu hyerɛn dan mmienu koro wɔ kuw bi mu na biribi foforo nhyerɛn wɔ mu a, ɛno ne nhyehyɛe no.

steps: Wɔ {unit} mu, nɔma {d1} ne {d2} mu biara wɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ebetumi akɔ mu, na ɛyɛ dan mmienu koro no ara: {cells}.
Ɛsɛ sɛ saa dan mmienu no kura {d1} ne {d2}, enti wɔn nea ɛfata foforo ntumi nyɛ yiye.
Yi {elim}. Seesei dan mmienu no kyerɛ mmienu a ɛda adi, na ebetumi abue akwan foforo.

mistakes: Wobɛyi nɔma mmienu no afi mmienu no dan mu. Saa dan no nea ɛfata foforo no na wɔyi; mmienu no nɔma tena hɔ.
Wobɛgye nɔma bi a ɛwɔ dan a ɛto so mmiɛnsa a ebetumi akɔ mu wɔ kuw no mu atom. Ɛsɛ sɛ nɔma mmienu no nyinaa ka dan mmienu no pɛɛ ho.
Wobɛhwɛ adaka mu nko ara. Mmienu a ahintaw pue wɔ nsantee ne kɔlɔm mu pii saa ara.
faq: Dɛn ne mmienu a ahintaw wɔ Sudoku mu?
Nɔma mmienu a ebetumi akɔ dan mmienu koro pɛ mu wɔ kuw bi mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ saa dan no gye saa nɔma no, enti wɔyi wɔn nea ɛfata foforo.
Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmienu a ahintaw ne mmienu a ɛda adi sono?

Mmienu a ɛda adi de, wotumi hu no: dan mmienu a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛfata mmienu koro pɛ. Mmienu a ahintaw de, nea ɛfata foforo a ɛwɔ dan mmienu no mu akata so. Sɛ woyi saa nea ɛfata foforo no a, mmienu a ahintaw dan yɛ mmienu a ɛda adi.
Dɛn ne mmiɛnsa a ahintaw?
Nɔma mmiɛnsa a wɔato mu wɔ dan mmiɛnsa mu wɔ kuw bi mu. Ɛnhia sɛ nɔma biara pue wɔ dan mmiɛnsa no nyinaa mu; nea ɛhia ne sɛ nɔma mmiɛnsa no mu biara nni nea ɛfata wɔ saa dan no akyi.
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu no kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda mmienu a ahintaw ne nea ɛda adi ntam?
Dabi. Bare Sudoku hu wɔn mmienu nyinaa na ɛde "Mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa" kyerɛ nɔma a efi mu ba no. Krataafa a ɛwɔ ha no tetew wɔn mu efisɛ wohu wɔn wɔ akwan ahorow so.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing wɔ Sudoku mu: Sɛnea Ɔkwan no Yɛ Adwuma
x-wing.description: X-Wing: nɔma bi a ɛwɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ɛfata wɔ nsantee mmienu mu, a ɛda kɔlɔm mmienu koro mu, wɔyi no fi saa kɔlɔm no nkae mu. Nhwɛsoɔ ankasa.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ nɔma biako ne dan anan a ɛwɔ ahinanan bi kɔna so. Sɛ nɔma no wɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ɛfata wɔ nsantee mmienu mu biara mu, na saa dan no da kɔlɔm mmienu koro mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ nɔma no tena ahinanan no kɔna mmienu a ɛhwɛ wɔn ho anim. Enti wobɛtumi ayi no afi saa kɔlɔm mmienu no dan foforo biara mu. Sɛ wosesa nsantee ne kɔlɔm a, ɛyɛ adwuma saa ara. Ɛno ne Ɔbenfo ɔkwan a edi kan wɔ Bare Sudoku mu.
when: Bere a biako, nea wɔato mu ne mmienu ne mmiɛnsa nyinaa asa. X-Wing ne Ɔbenfo nhyehyɛe a ɛtaa ba sen biara, na ɛtaa pue bere a nɔma bi nea ɛfata kakraa bi na aka, mpɛn pii no bere a wɔde emu anan kosi asia ato hɔ dedaw. Ɛhia nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a edi mu ma nɔma a worehwɛ no.
spot: Paw nɔma bi na hwehwɛ nsantee a ɛwɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ɛfata ma no. Sɛ saa nsantee mmienu kyɛ kɔlɔm mmienu koro a, hwɛ sɛ nɔma no wɔ nea ɛfata foforo wɔ saa kɔlɔm no mu: ɛno ne nea wobɛyi. Afei yɛ saa ara bio de kɔlɔm yɛ fapem. Wɔ agodie no mu no, mia nɔma no nsafe: ne nea ɛfata nyinaa hyerɛn, na ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobehu ahinanan a nsɛm anan a ahyerɛn wom.

steps: Nɔma {d} wɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ɛfata wɔ nsantee {r1} mu ne mmienu pɛ wɔ nsantee {r2} mu, na ɛda kɔlɔm mmienu koro, {c1} ne {c2}, mu: {cells}.
Nsantee {r1} de ne {d} to kɔlɔm {c1} anaa {c2} mu, na nsantee {r2} de ne {d} to biako a aka no mu. Ɛmfa ho nea ɛbɛyɛ, kɔlɔm {c1} ne {c2} mu biara nya {d} fi saa nsantee mmienu yi mu.
Enti {d} ntumi mpue baabi foforo wɔ kɔlɔm {c1} ne {c2} mu. Yi {d} fi {elim}.

mistakes: Wode nsantee a ɛwɔ dan mmiɛnsa a ɛfata ma nɔma no bedi dwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ fapem nsantee biara wɔ mmienu pɛ, na ɛsɛ sɛ ne mmienu nyinaa wɔ kɔlɔm mmienu a wɔkyɛ no mu.
Wobɛyi nɔma no afi nsantee no mu sen sɛ wobɛyi afi kɔlɔm no mu. Sɛ nsantee ne fapem a, nea wɔyi no wɔ kɔlɔm no mu, na nea ɛbɔ abira nso saa ara.
Werɛ befi wo nea wɔasesa no. X-Wing a wɔde kɔlɔm ayɛ fapem yi nea ɛfata wɔ nsantee mu.
faq: Dɛn ne X-Wing wɔ Sudoku mu?

Nɔma bi a ɛwɔ dan mmienu pɛ a ɛfata wɔ nsantee mmienu mu biara mu, wɔ kɔlɔm mmienu koro mu. Nɔma no tena saa ahinanan no kɔna mmienu a ɛhwɛ wɔn ho anim, enti wɔyi no fi kɔlɔm mmienu no nkae mu. Wobɛtumi asesa nsantee ne kɔlɔm.
Adɛn nti na X-Wing yɛ adwuma?

Ɛsɛ sɛ nsantee mmienu no mu biara de nɔma no to kɔlɔm mmienu no mu biako mu, na nsantee mmienu no ntumi mfa kɔlɔm koro. Enti kɔlɔm mmienu no mu biara nya ne nɔma no fi saa nsantee yi mu, na nea ɛfata foforo biara a ɛwɔ saa kɔlɔm no mu ntumi nyɛ yiye.
X-Wing yɛ apataa?
Aane. X-Wing ne apataa a ne kɛse yɛ mmienu; Swordfish ne apataa a ne kɛse yɛ mmiɛnsa. Bare Sudoku hu wɔn mmienu nyinaa.
Agyinaeɛ bɛn na X-Wing wɔ?
Ɔbenfo. Asɛmmisa a ɛhia X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish anaa XYZ-Wing no, wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ Ɔbenfo.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing wɔ Sudoku mu: Sɛnea Ɔkwan no Yɛ Adwuma
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): dan titiriw a nea ɛfata mmienu wom ne ntaban mmienu a emu biara kyɛ emu biako yi nɔma bi fi dan biara a ehu ntaban mmienu no mu.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, a wɔsan frɛ no XY-Wing, de dan mmiɛnsa a emu biara wɔ nea ɛfata mmienu di dwuma. Dan titiriw no wɔ nea ɛfata X ne Y. Ntaban biako hu dan titiriw no na ɛwɔ X ne Z; ntaban foforo no hu dan titiriw no na ɛwɔ Y ne Z. Biribiara a dan titiriw no bɛyɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ ntaban no mu biako yɛ Z, enti wobɛtumi ayi Z afi dan biara a ehu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa mu. Ɛyɛ Ɔbenfo ɔkwan wɔ Bare Sudoku mu.
when: Bere a asɛmmisa bi wɔ dan pii a nea ɛfata mmienu pɛ wom na apataa biara nni hɔ. Y-Wing taa ba wɔ Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa mu, na wohu no denam dan a nea ɛfata mmienu wom a wodi akyi so: emu biara betumi ayɛ dan titiriw anaa ntaban.
spot: Kyerɛw dan a nea ɛfata mmienu pɛ wom. Emu biara, fa no sɛ dan titiriw a ne nea ɛfata yɛ X ne Y, na hwehwɛ ne mfɛfo mu dan a X ne nɔma foforo Z wom, ne dan a Y ne Z koro no ara wom. Saa mmienu no ne ntaban no. Afei hwehwɛ dan a ehu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa na Z wom. Hyɛ no nsow sɛ ɛnhia sɛ ntaban no hu wɔn ho wɔn ho.

steps: Dan titiriw {pivot} wɔ nea ɛfata {x} ne {y}. Ehu {wingA}, a {x} ne {z} wom, ne {wingB}, a {y} ne {z} wom.
Sɛ {pivot} yɛ {x} a, {wingA} hwere {x} na ɛyɛ {z}. Sɛ {pivot} yɛ {y} a, {wingB} yɛ {z}. Biribiara a ɛbɛba no, ntaban mmienu no mu biako yɛ {z}.
Dan a ehu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa ntumi nyɛ {z} da. Yi {z} fi {elim}.

mistakes: Wobɛpaw ntaban a wɔn mmienu nyinaa nhu dan titiriw no. Ɛsɛ sɛ ntaban biara ne dan titiriw no kyɛ nsantee, kɔlɔm anaa adaka.
Wobɛyi Z afi dan a ehu ntaban biako pɛ mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ dan a woyi fi mu no hu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa.
Wobɛyi Z afi dan titiriw no mu. Wɔ Y-Wing mu no, Z nni dan titiriw no mu; sɛ ɛwɔ mu a, nhyehyɛe no yɛ XYZ-Wing a ne mmara yɛ soronko.
faq: Dɛn ne Y-Wing wɔ Sudoku mu?

Dan mmiɛnsa a nea ɛfata mmienu wɔ emu biara mu: dan titiriw a X ne Y wom, ntaban a X ne Z wom a ehu dan titiriw no, ne ntaban a Y ne Z wom a ehu dan titiriw no. Ntaban biako yɛ Z bere biara, enti wɔyi Z fi dan a ehu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa mu.
Y-Wing ne XY-Wing yɛ biako?
Aane. Din mmienu no ka nhyehyɛe koro ho asɛm. Bare Sudoku frɛ no Y-Wing.
Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ntaban biako yɛ Z?
Sɛ dan titiriw no yɛ X a, ntaban a edi kan no hwere X na ɛyɛ Z. Sɛ dan titiriw no yɛ Y a, ntaban a ɛto so mmienu no yɛ Z. Dan titiriw no yɛ emu biako, enti ntaban biako yɛ Z.
Dan ahe na Y-Wing yi nea ɛfata fi mu?
Mpɛn pii no biako anaa mmienu: dan a ehu ntaban mmienu no nyinaa na Z da so wom nko ara. Ɛno dɔɔso sɛ ɛde biako bɛba.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish wɔ Sudoku mu: Sɛnea Ɔkwan no Yɛ Adwuma
swordfish.description: Swordfish: nɔma bi a wɔato mu wɔ kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa mu wɔ nsantee mmiɛnsa so, wɔyi no fi saa kɔlɔm no nkae mu. Apataa a ne kɛse yɛ mmiɛnsa ne nhwɛsoɔ ankasa.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish yɛ X-Wing a ɛwɔ nsantee mmiɛnsa ne kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa. Sɛ nɔma bi wɔ dan mmiɛnsa a ɛfata anaa nea ɛnnɔɔso saa wɔ nsantee mmiɛnsa mu biara mu, na saa dan no nyinaa wɔ kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa koro mu a, nsantee mmiɛnsa no de saa kɔlɔm no nɔma no nyinaa di dwuma, na wobɛtumi ayi nɔma no afi kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no dan foforo biara mu. Wobɛtumi asesa nsantee ne kɔlɔm. Bare Sudoku hwehwɛ Swordfish wɔ Y-Wing akyi, wɔ Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa mu.
when: Bere a X-Wing ne Y-Wing nhu hwee. Swordfish ntaa mma sɛ X-Wing, na ɛhia nɔma bi a ne nea ɛfata apete kakraa bi wɔ nsantee anaa kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa so. Ɛhia nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a edi mu na ɛyɛ nokware ma saa nɔma no.
spot: Paw nɔma bi na hwehwɛ nsantee a ɛwɔ dan mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa a ɛfata ma no. Sɛ saa nsantee mmiɛnsa bi kata kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa pɛ so nyinaa a, hwɛ sɛ nɔma no wɔ nea ɛfata foforo wɔ saa kɔlɔm no mu. Ɛnhia sɛ nsantee biara wɔ nea ɛfata wɔ kɔlɔm biara mu: Swordfish betumi awɔ dan asia, ason, nwɔtwe anaa akron. Wɔ agodie no mu no, fa nɔma no nsafe ma ɛnhyerɛn, na hwehwɛ nsantee mmiɛnsa a wɔn nea ɛfata da kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa mu.

steps: Nɔma {d} wɔ dan mmiɛnsa a ɛfata anaa nea ɛnnɔɔso saa wɔ nsantee {rows} mu biara mu, na saa dan no nyinaa wɔ kɔlɔm {cols} mu: {cells}.
Ɛsɛ sɛ nsantee mmiɛnsa no mu biara de ne {d} to kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no mu biako mu, na nsantee mmienu biara ntumi mfa kɔlɔm koro. Enti kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no nya wɔn {d} fi saa nsantee mmiɛnsa yi mu.
{d} biara a ɛfata foforo wɔ kɔlɔm {cols} mu ntumi nyɛ yiye. Yi {d} fi {elim}.

mistakes: Wobɛhwehwɛ dan akron no nyinaa. Swordfish a nea ɛfata mmienu pɛ wɔ nsantee bi mu no da so yɛ adwuma, sɛ nsantee mmiɛnsa no kata kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa pɛ so a.
Wode nsantee a ɛwɔ dan anan a ɛfata bɛka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ fapem nsantee biara wɔ mmiɛnsa anaa nea ɛnnɔɔso saa, na ne nyinaa wɔ kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no mu.
Wobɛyi nea ɛfata afi fapem nsantee no mu. Sɛ nsantee ne fapem a, nea wɔyi no wɔ kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no mu, fapem nsantee no akyi.
faq: Dɛn ne Swordfish wɔ Sudoku mu?

Nɔma bi a ne nea ɛfata wɔ nsantee mmiɛnsa mu wɔ kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa mu nko ara. Ɛsɛ sɛ nsantee mmiɛnsa no de nɔma no to saa kɔlɔm mmiɛnsa no mu, biako biako, enti wɔyi nɔma no fi saa kɔlɔm no dan foforo mu.
Ɔkwan bɛn so na Swordfish ne X-Wing sono?
Ne kɛse nko ara: X-Wing de nsantee mmienu ne kɔlɔm mmienu di dwuma, Swordfish de mmiɛnsa ne mmiɛnsa. Adwene a ɛwɔ akyi no yɛ pɛ.
Swordfish hia dan akron pɛpɛɛpɛ?
Dabi. Nsantee biara betumi awɔ nea ɛfata mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa; nea nhyehyɛe no hia ara ne sɛ nsantee mmiɛnsa no bom mfa kɔlɔm a ɛboro mmiɛnsa.
Apataa a ne kɛse yɛ anan wɔ hɔ?
Aane, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku mfa nni dwuma, efisɛ ne nsɛmmisa nhia bi da.

Wobɛfra no ne Y-Wing: nsonsonoe no ne nea ɛfata a ɛto so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ dan titiriw no mu, na ɛsesa dan a wobɛtumi apopa.
faq: Dɛn ne XYZ-Wing wɔ Sudoku mu?

Dan titiriw a nea ɛfata X, Y ne Z wom ne ntaban mmienu, biako a X ne Z wom ne biako a Y ne Z wom, a wɔn mmienu nyinaa hu dan titiriw no. Dan mmiɛnsa no mu biako yɛ Z, enti wɔyi Z fi dan a ehu mmiɛnsa no nyinaa mu.
Ɔkwan bɛn so na XYZ-Wing ne Y-Wing sono?
Dan titiriw no wɔ nea ɛfata mmiɛnsa mmom sen mmienu, na Z ka ho. Ɛno ma dan titiriw no yɛ baabi a Z betumi akɔ, enti dan a ehu dan titiriw no ne ntaban mmienu no nyinaa nko ara na ebetumi ahwere Z.
Mpɛn ahe na XYZ-Wing pue?
Ɛnnɔɔso. Wɔ Bare Sudoku mu no, Ɔbenfo nsɛmmisa nko ara na ebetumi ahia bi, na dodow no ara nhia. Bare Sudoku hwɛ no akyiri koraa, X-Wing, Y-Wing ne Swordfish akyi.
WXYZ-Wing wɔ hɔ?
Aane, a ne dan titiriw wɔ nea ɛfata anan, nanso Bare Sudoku mfa nni dwuma. Asɛmmisa biara a ɛwɔ agodie no mu, wobɛtumi de akwan akron a ɛwɔ saa akwankyerɛ yi mu awie.

ee.learnText: Èle Sudoku dzem gɔme, alo nyabiase sesẽ aɖe te ɖe ŋuwò? Mɔfiame eve ɖe sewo kple gbɔkpɔmɔnu ɖe sia ɖe si fiafiawo zãna la me, eye kpɔɖeŋu vavã le wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me.
