hidden-pairs.title: Ɗiɗi e tati suuɗiiɗi e sudoku: no yiytirtee ɗi
hidden-pairs.description: Ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ko limooje ɗiɗi waawooje yahde e kaaseeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi tan e fedde, ndeen kandidaaji goɗɗi ina ittee. Ekkito yiytude ɗi seɗɗa seɗɗa.
hidden-pairs.h1: Ɗiɗi e tati suuɗiiɗi (hidden pair, hidden triple)
hidden-pairs.summary: Ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ko limooje ɗiɗi, nder saakre, tiinde walla bakkere wootere, ɗe ngoni kandidaaji e kaaseeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi tan, alaa nokku goɗɗo. Ɗeen kaaseeji ɗiɗi ina waɗɗii jogaade ɗeen limooje ɗiɗi, ndeen kala kandidaa goɗɗo e majji ina waawi itteede. Tati suuɗiiɗi ina golla no ɗum ni e limooje tati haɓaaɗe e kaaseeji tati. Caggal ittugol, kaaseeji ɗii ina holla ɗiɗi walla tati feeñɗi. Tinndinol Bare Sudoku ina maalda waɗgol iwngol e mum «Ɗiɗi walla tati».
when: Nde fedde jogii kaaseeji keewɗi kandidaaji, peeje gooto kadi timmii. Ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ina suuɗoo nder kaaseeji heewɗi, ɗum ko waɗi ina moƴƴi yiylaade ɗi tigi ɗo ɗiɗi feeñɗi yi'ataake. Tati suuɗiiɗi ina seeɗa; Bare Sudoku ina ƴeewa ɗi, kono ko ɓuri heewde e tiitoli Saɗtiɗum ina ɓoltee ɓaawo majji.
spot: Golla limoore e limoore, wonaa kaasel e kaasel. E fedde, winndu kaaseeji ɗo kala limoore majjunde waawi yahde. Si limooje ɗiɗi, kala e majje jogii kaaseeji ɗiɗi tan, ɗeen kaaseeji kadi ko ɗi gootuɗi, a yiytii ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi. E fijo ngoo, ɗoɓɓu butoŋ limoore ngam jalbinde kandidaaji mayre; si limooje ɗiɗi ina jalbina kaaseeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi e fedde, hay huunde goɗɗum e mayre, ɗum ko mbaadi ndii.

steps: E {unit}, limooje {d1} e {d2} ina jogii kala e majje kaaseeji ɗiɗi tan, ɗeen kadi ko kaaseeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi: {cells}.
Ɗeen kaaseeji ɗiɗi ina waɗɗii jogaade {d1} e {d2}, ndeen kandidaaji majji goɗɗi waawaa wonde goonga.
Itt {elim}. Jooni kaaseeji ɗiɗi ɗii ina holla ɗiɗi feeñɗi, ɗum ina waawi udditde goɗɗum kadi.

mistakes: Ittude limooje ɗiɗi ɗee e kaaseeji ɗiɗi ɗii. Ko kandidaaji goɗɗi ɗeen kaaseeji ittetee; limooje ɗiɗi ɗee ina heddoo.
Jaɓde limoore jogiinde kaasel tataɓel e fedde ndee. Limooje ɗiɗi ɗee fof ina waɗɗii haɓeede e ɗeen kaaseeji ɗiɗi tigi.
Ƴeewde bakkereeji tan. Ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ina feeñoo e saakreeji e tiindeeji no bakkereeji ni.
faq: Hol ko woni ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi e sudoku?
Limooje ɗiɗi waawooje yahde e kaaseeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi tan e fedde. Ɗeen kaaseeji ina waɗɗii ƴettude ɗeen limooje, ndeen kandidaaji majji goɗɗi ina ittee.
Hol ko seerndi ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi e ɗiɗi feeñɗi?

Ɗiɗi feeñɗi ina yi'oo: kaaseeji ɗiɗi hollooɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi nanndooji tan. Ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ina suuɗaa e kandidaaji ɓeydaaɗi e kaaseeji ɗiɗi ɗii. Ittude ɗeen ɓeydaaɗi ina wayla ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi ɗiɗi feeñɗi.
Hol ko woni tati suuɗiiɗi?
Limooje tati haɓaaɗe e kaaseeji tati e fedde. Kala limoore hatojinaa feeñde e kaaseeji tati ɗii fof; ko woni nafa ko alaa limoore e tati ɗee jogiinde kandidaa yaasi ɗeen kaaseeji.
Mbela tinndinol ina senndira ɗiɗi suuɗiiɗi e ɗiɗi feeñɗi?
Alaa. Bare Sudoku ina yiyta ɗi fof, ina maalda waɗgol iwngol e mum «Ɗiɗi walla tati». Hello ɗee ina senndira ɗi sabu ina yiytiree laabi ceertuɗi.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing e sudoku: no feere ndee gollirta
x-wing.description: X-Wing: limoore jogiinde kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi e saakreeji ɗiɗi, e tiindeeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi, ina ittee e heddiiɗe ɗeen tiindeeji. Yeru goonga.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing ko mbaadi limoore wootere e kaaseeji nay ɗo saakreeji ɗiɗi e tiindeeji ɗiɗi kawrata. Si limoore ndee ina jogii kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi e kala e saakreeji ɗiɗi, ɗeen kaaseeji kadi ina e tiindeeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi, limoore ndee ina waɗɗii wonde e kaaseeji ɗiɗi e nay ɗii ɗi ngonaa e saakre wootere walla tiinde wootere. Ndeen ina waawi itteede e kala kaasel goɗngel e ɗeen tiindeeji ɗiɗi. Ko wano non kadi so saakreeji e tiindeeji ina lornaa. Ko feere Ganndo adannde e Bare Sudoku.
when: Nde peeje gooto, kandidaaji sokaaɗi e ɗiɗi e tati timmi. X-Wing ko mbaadi Ganndo ɓurndi heewde, ina feeñoo ko heewi nde limoore heddii kandidaaji seeɗa, ko heewi tuma nde limoore ndee waɗaa laabi nay haa jeegom tawo. Ina hatojini winndanɗe timmuɗe wonande limoore nde ƴeewataa.
spot: Suɓo limoore, yiylo saakreeji ɗo nde jogii kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi. Si saakreeji ɗiɗi nii ina renndi tiindeeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi, ƴeew ɗeen tiindeeji ngam kandidaaji ndee limoore goɗɗi: ɗeen ko ittuɗe ɗee. Refti waɗ ɗum kadi tawa feere ndee tuugii e tiindeeji. E fijo ngoo, ɗoɓɓu butoŋ limoore ndee: kala kandidaa mayre ina jalbinee, winndanɗe nay jalbinaaɗe e saakreeji ɗiɗi e tiindeeji ɗiɗi ina newi yiyteede.

steps: Limoore {d} ina jogii kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi e saakre {r1}, ɗiɗi tigi kadi e saakre {r2}, ɗi ina potti e tiindeeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi, {c1} e {c2}: {cells}.

Saakre {r1} ina waɗa {d} mayre e tiinde {c1} walla {c2}, saakre {r2} kadi ina waɗa {d} mayre e tiinde nde heddii. Hay ko hol no wa'i, tiinde {c1} e tiinde {c2} ina heɓa kala {d} wootere iwde e ɗeen saakreeji ɗiɗi.
Ndeen {d} waawaa feeñde nokku goɗɗo e tiindeeji {c1} e {c2}. Itt {d} e {elim}.

mistakes: Huutorde saakre jogiinde kaaseeji kandidaaji tati wonande limoore ndee. Kala saakre tuugorde ina waɗɗii jogaade ɗiɗi tigi, ɗi fof e tiindeeji ɗiɗi renndaaɗi.
Ittude limoore ndee e saakreeji e nokku tiindeeji. So feere ndee tuugii e saakreeji, ittuɗe ɗee ina e tiindeeji, ko lornii kadi.
Yejjitde mbaadi lornaandi ndii. X-Wing tuugiiɗo e tiindeeji ina itta e saakreeji.
faq: Hol ko woni X-Wing e sudoku?

Limoore jogiinde kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi e kala e saakreeji ɗiɗi, e tiindeeji ɗiɗi gootuɗi. Limoore ndee ina wona e kaaseeji ɗiɗi e nay ɗii ɗi ngonaa e saakre wootere walla tiinde wootere, ndeen ina ittee e heddiiɗe tiindeeji ɗiɗi ɗee. Saakreeji e tiindeeji ina waawi lornaade.
Ko waɗi X-Wing ina golla?

Kala e saakreeji ɗiɗi ɗii ina waɗɗii waɗde limoore ndee e wootere e tiindeeji ɗiɗi ɗii, saakreeji ɗiɗi ɗii kadi waawaa huutorde tiinde wootere. Ndeen kala e tiindeeji ɗiɗi ɗii ina heɓa limoore mayre iwde e ɗeen saakreeji, kala kandidaa goɗɗo e ɗeen tiindeeji waawaa wonde goonga.
Mbela X-Wing ko liingu?
Eey. X-Wing ko liingu ngu ɓeto mum ko ɗiɗi; Swordfish ko liingu ngu ɓeto mum ko tati. Bare Sudoku ina yiyta ɗi fof.
Hol tolno jogiingo X-Wing?
Ganndo. Tiitol hatojinngol X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish walla XYZ-Wing ina tolnee Ganndo.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing e sudoku: no feere ndee gollirta
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): jokkorde jogiinde kandidaaji ɗiɗi e wiɗife ɗiɗi renndooɗe gootel e majji ina itta limoore e kala kaasel yi'oowngel wiɗife ɗee fof.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, mo noddirtee kadi XY-Wing, ina huutora kaaseeji tati jogiiɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi kala. Jokkorde ndee ina jogii kandidaaji X e Y. Wiɗifere wootere ina yi'a jokkorde ndee, ina jogii X e Z; wiɗifere goɗnde ina yi'a jokkorde ndee, ina jogii Y e Z. Hay ko hol ko jokkorde ndee wonata, wootere e wiɗife ɗee ina waɗɗii wonde Z, ndeen Z ina waawi itteede e kala kaasel yi'oowngel wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof. Ko feere Ganndo e Bare Sudoku.
when: Nde tiitol jogii kaaseeji keewɗi ɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi, alaa liingu yi'aaka. Y-Wing ina heewi e tiitoli Ganndo, ina yiytee e jokkude kaaseeji kandidaaji ɗiɗi: kala e majji ina waawi wonde jokkorde walla wiɗifere.
spot: Winndu kaaseeji jogiiɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi tigi. Kala e majji, sikku ko jokkorde jogiinde X e Y, yiylo e ɓadiiɓe mum kaasel jogiingel X e limoore goɗnde Z, e kaasel jogiingel Y e ndeen Z. Ɗeen ɗiɗi ko wiɗife ɗee. Refti yiytu kaaseeji yi'ooɗi wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof, jogii Z. Anndu wonde wiɗife ɗee hatojinaa yiyondirde.

Si {pivot} ko {x}, {wingA} ina waasa {x}, ina wona {z}. Si {pivot} ko {y}, {wingB} ina wona {z}. Wootere e wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee ko {z} e kala laawol.
Kaasel yi'oowngel wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof waawaa wonde {z} abadaa. Itt {z} e {elim}.

mistakes: Suɓaade wiɗife ɗe ngonaa ɗe fof yi'ooɗe jokkorde ndee. Kala wiɗifere ina waɗɗii renndude saakre, tiinde walla bakkere e jokkorde ndee.
Ittude Z e kaaseeji yi'ooɗi wiɗifere wootere tan. Kaasel ittetee ngel ina waɗɗii yiyde wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof.
Ittude Z e jokkorde ndee. Jokkorde ndee jogaaki Z e Y-Wing; si ina jogii, mbaadi ndii ko XYZ-Wing jogiiɗo sarɗiiji goɗɗi.
faq: Hol ko woni Y-Wing e sudoku?

Kaaseeji tati jogiiɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi: jokkorde jogiinde X e Y, wiɗifere jogiinde X e Z yi'oonde jokkorde ndee, e wiɗifere jogiinde Y e Z yi'oonde jokkorde ndee. Wiɗifere wootere ko Z tuma kala, ndeen Z ina ittee e kaaseeji yi'ooɗi wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof.
Mbela Y-Wing e XY-Wing ko gootum?
Eey. Innde ɗiɗi ɗee ina sifa mbaadi wootere. Bare Sudoku ina noddira ndi Y-Wing.
Ko waɗi wiɗifere wootere ina waɗɗii wonde Z?
Si jokkorde ndee ko X, wiɗifere adannde ndee ina waasa X, ina wona Z. Si jokkorde ndee ko Y, wiɗifere ɗiɗaɓere ndee ina wona Z. Jokkorde ndee ko gootum e ɗiɗi ɗii, ndeen wiɗifere wootere ko Z.
Kaaseeji no foti Y-Wing ittata?
Ko heewi gootel walla ɗiɗi: kaaseeji yi'ooɗi wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof tan, jogii Z tawo. Ɗum ina yonii ngam tagde gooto.

Hol ko seerndi Swordfish e X-Wing?
Ɓeto tan: X-Wing ina huutora saakreeji ɗiɗi e tiindeeji ɗiɗi, Swordfish tati e tati. Miijo ngoo ko gootum.

Mbela liingu ngu ɓeto mum ko nay ina woodi?

Sabu jokkorde ndee e hoore mayre ina waawi wonde Z, kaasel ittetee ngel ina waɗɗii yiyde jokkorde ndee e wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof, ɗum ina haɓa ngel e bakkere walla diidol ngol kaaseeji ɗii renndi. Ko feere ɓurnde saɗtude e ɗe Bare Sudoku huutortoo.
when: Si hay huunde goɗɗum golliraani tan. XYZ-Wing ko mbaadi ɓurndi seeɗude e Bare Sudoku, ina feeñoo e tiitoli Ganndo tan. Yiylo ɗum nde kaasel kandidaaji tati ina e bakkere wootere e kaasel kandidaaji ɗiɗi renndoowngel ɗiɗi e limooje mum.
spot: Fuɗɗo e kaaseeji jogiiɗi kandidaaji tati tigi; kala e majji ina waawi wonde jokkorde. E ɓadiiɓe mum, yiylo kaaseeji ɗiɗi jogiiɗi kandidaaji ɗiɗi kala, iwɗi fof e tati jokkorde ndee, renndooɗi limoore wootere tigi Z. Refti yiylo kaaseeji yi'ooɗi jokkorde ndee e wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee, jogii Z. E kuugal, wiɗifere wootere ina e bakkere jokkorde ndee, goɗnde ndee e saakre mayre walla tiinde mayre, kaaseeji ittetee ɗii ko kaaseeji heddiiɗi ndeen bakkere e ndeen saakre walla tiinde.

steps: Jokkorde {pivot} ina jogii kandidaaji tati: {x}, {y} e {z}. Ina yi'a {wingA} jogiingel {x} e {z}, e {wingB} jogiingel {y} e {z}.
Si {pivot} ko {z}, ɗum timmii. Si ko {x}, {wingA} ina waɗɗii wonde {z}. Si ko {y}, {wingB} ina waɗɗii wonde {z}. E kala laawol gootel e kaaseeji tati ɗii ko {z}.
Kaasel yi'oowngel tati ɗii fof waawaa wonde {z}. Itt {z} e {elim}.

mistakes: Ittude e kaaseeji yi'ooɗi wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee tan. Wonaa no Y-Wing nii, jokkorde ndee ina waawi wonde Z, ndeen kaasel ngel ina waɗɗii yiyde jokkorde ndee kadi.
Huutorde wiɗife ɗe kandidaaji mum ngonaa fof nder kandidaaji tati jokkorde ndee.
Jillondirde ɗum e Y-Wing: ceerndugol ngol ko kandidaa tataɓo e jokkorde ndee, ina wayla kaaseeji ɗi laɓɓinetee.
faq: Hol ko woni XYZ-Wing e sudoku?

Jokkorde jogiinde kandidaaji X, Y e Z e wiɗife ɗiɗi, wootere jogii X e Z, goɗnde jogii Y e Z, ɗe fof ina yi'a jokkorde ndee. Gootel e kaaseeji tati ɗii ko Z, ndeen Z ina ittee e kaaseeji yi'ooɗi tati ɗii fof.
Hol ko seerndi XYZ-Wing e Y-Wing?

Jokkorde ndee ina jogii kandidaaji tati e nokku ɗiɗi, Z ina e majji. Ɗum ina waɗa jokkorde ndee nokku ɗo Z waawi wonde, ndeen kaaseeji yi'ooɗi jokkorde ndee e wiɗife ɗiɗi ɗee fof tan ina waawi waasde Z.
XYZ-Wing ina feeñoo laabi no foti?
Seeɗa. E Bare Sudoku, tiitoli Ganndo tan ina waawi hatojinde ɗum, ko ɓuri heewde e majji kadi hatojinaa ɗum. Bare Sudoku ina ƴeewa ɗum sakkitorde, caggal X-Wing, Y-Wing e Swordfish.
Mbela WXYZ-Wing ina woodi?
Eey, e jokkorde jogiinde kandidaaji nay, kono Bare Sudoku huutortaa ɗum. Kala tiitol e fijo ngoo ina waawi timmineede e peeje jeenay ɗe ndee kollirde.

bm.learnText: I bɛ ka sudoku daminɛ wa, walima i jɔlen bɛ ɲininkali gɛlɛn dɔ la wa? Ɲɛfɔlisɛbɛn fila bɛ sariyaw ɲɛfɔ ani ɲɛnabɔ fɛɛrɛ bɛɛ min ladilikanw bɛ kɛ, kelen-kelen bɛɛ ni misali lakika ye.

howTo.title: Sudoku tulon cogo: sariyaw, kɛnɛba ani taama fɔlɔw
howTo.description: Sudoku tulon cogo kalan: sariyaw, layiniw, kolɔnw ani kɛsuw, mun na ɲininkali bɛɛ ɲɛnabɔcogo ye kelen ye, sɛbɛnw kɛcogo ani taama fɔlɔw.
howTo.summary: Sudoku ye hakili ɲininkali ye kɛnɛba 9×9 kan. Kɛnɛ lankolon bɛɛ fa ni jate ye ka bɔ 1 fo 9 walasa layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ, kolɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ani kɛsu 3×3 kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka jate bɛɛ sɔrɔ siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn. Jate dɔw bɛ di daminɛ na; i bɛ tɔw sɔrɔ ni hakili ye, kɛnɛ kelen-kelen, ni dannaya ye, i man kan ka fɛn bila kunfɛ abada. Nin ɲɛfɔli bɛ kɛnɛba, sariyaw, ɲɛnabɔcogo kelen sariya, sɛbɛnw ani fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔman dɔ ɲɛfɔ taama fɔlɔw kama. I bɛ se ka o bɛɛ kalan [Bare Sudoku](play) la, min ye fu ye, ani a ladilikanw bɛ hakilina ɲɛfɔ.

sections.h: Sudoku sariyaw ye mun ye?
p: Sariya saba dɔrɔn de bɛ yen, u bɛɛ ye sariya kelen ye min bɛ filɛ ka bɔ fan saba fɛ: layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka jate 1 fo 9 sɔrɔ, kolɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka jate 1 fo 9 sɔrɔ, kɛsu 3×3 kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka jate 1 fo 9 sɔrɔ. O la, jate tɛ se ka bɔ siɲɛ fila layini kelen, kolɔn kelen walima kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ abada.

Jate dilenw, minnu sɛbɛnnen bɛ ni girinya ye, olu tɛ yɛlɛma. I ka baara ye ka kɛnɛ lankolonw fa. Jatekalan si tɛ, jate si ma bonya ni tɔ ye: jatew ye taamasiyɛn kɔnɔntɔn danfaralenw dɔrɔn ye. I tun bɛ se ka tulon kɛ ni lɛtiriw walima jaaw ye, foyi tun tɛna yɛlɛma.

sections.h: Kɛnɛba labɛnnen bɛ cogo di?
p: Kɛnɛba kɔnɔ kɛnɛ 81 bɛ yen, layini 9 ani kolɔn 9 la. Sira bɛlɛbɛlɛw b'a tila kɛsu 3×3 kɔnɔntɔn ye. Kɛnɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye layini kelen, kolɔn kelen ani kɛsu kelen dɔrɔn ta ye, o kulu saba ye a ka kuluw ye. Kɛnɛ 20 tɔ minnu ni kɛnɛ bɛ kulu kelen na, olu bɛ wele a sigiɲɔgɔnw; jate min bilalen bɛ kɛnɛ dɔ la, o jate bɛ bɔ a sigiɲɔgɔn 20 bɛɛ la.

Kɛnɛw bɛ sɛbɛn i n'a fɔ r3c7: layini 3, kolɔn 7. Layiniw bɛ jate ka bɔ sanfɛ, kolɔnw ka bɔ numanyanfan fɛ, kɛsuw 1 fo 9 ka bɔ sanfɛ numanyanfan fɛ, layini ni layini. Nin sɛbɛncogo bɛ kɛ fɛɛrɛ ɲɛfɔli bɛɛ la, a ka ɲi k'a kalan: r5c5 ye kɛnɛba cɛmancɛ ye.

sections.h: Mun na sudoku bɛɛ ɲɛnabɔcogo ye kelen dɔrɔn ye?
p: Sudoku ɲuman ɲɛnabɔcogo ye kelen ye, o de bɛ hakili baara kɛ. Ni i y'a jira ko jate tɛ se ka don yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la kulu dɔ kɔnɔ, a ka kan ka don kɛnɛ tɔ la, katuguni ɲɛnabɔcogo bɛ yen, a ye kelen ye. Ni ɲininkali tun ɲɛnabɔcogo ye fila ye, miiriya si tun tɛna se k'u danfara, i tun bɛna wajibiya ka fɛn bila kunfɛ waati dɔ la.

Bare Sudoku bɛ ɲininkali bɛɛ dilan i ka minɛn kan, k'a lajɛ ko a ɲɛnabɔcogo ye kelen dɔrɔn ye, ani ko a ka hakili ɲɛnabɔlan bɛ se k'a ban ni hakɛ sugandilen fɛɛrɛw ye. O la, ni i jɔlen don, sen nata dɔ bɛ yen tuma bɛɛ, ladilikan b'o jira.

sections.h: Sudoku ɲininkali bɛ daminɛ cogo di?
p: A daminɛ ni min dancɛlen don ka tɛmɛ. Nin cogoya bɛ baara kɛ hakɛ bɛɛ la:
list: Jate dɔ sugandi min bɛ yen siɲɛ caman kaban, i n'a fɔ siɲɛ wɔɔrɔ walima wolonwula, ka kɛsuw ɲini minnu m'o sɔrɔ fɔlɔ. Tuma caman na, kɛnɛ kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ to a ye kɛsu kɔnɔ: o ye [kelen dogolen](hidden-single) ye.

Kɛnɛ minnu lamini fara, olu filɛ. Kɛnɛ min ka layini, a ka kolɔn ani a ka kɛsu bɛ jate seegin danfaralenw sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, sugandita kelen dɔrɔn de bɛ to o la: [kelen jiralen](naked-single). Kɛnɛ minnu bɛ layiniw walima kɛsuw la minnu fara ka surun, olu de ka ɲi ka filɛ ka tɛmɛ.
Jate o jate i bɛ bila, o bɛ sugandita kelen bɔ sigiɲɔgɔn 20 la, o la o sigiɲɔgɔnw lajɛ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ. Kelenw bɛ tugu ɲɔgɔn na tuma caman.

Ni bilali nɔgɔnw banna, sɛbɛnw sɛbɛn: kɛnɛ lankolon kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka suganditaw. O kɔfɛ, jate ɲini min datugulen bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen na kɛsu kɔnɔ ([sugandita datugulenw](locked-candidates)) walima kɛnɛ fila minnu bɛ sugandita fila kelenw sɔrɔ ([fila jiralen](naked-pairs)).
Bɔli o bɔli kɔfɛ, i segin kelenw ma. Hali Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw fana bɛ ɲɛnabɔ kelenw de fɛ tuma caman; fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛn bɛ kelen nata dɔrɔn de da yɛlɛ.

sections.h: Sɛbɛnw ye mun ye, u bɛ kɛ tuma jumɛn?
p: Sɛbɛnw, minnu bɛ wele fana ko kalamu taamasiyɛnw walima suganditaw, olu ye jate fitininw ye minnu bɛ sɛbɛn kɛnɛ lankolon kɔnɔ walasa ka jate minnu bɛ se ka don yen hali bi, olu mara. Ɲininkali nɔgɔnw na, u tɛ wajibi tuma caman; ka bɔ Gɛlɛn na ka taa a sanfɛ, u ka kan kosɛbɛ, katuguni fɛɛrɛw i n'a fɔ filaw, X-Wing ani Y-Wing bɛ suganditaw de lajɛ, jate bilalenw tɛ.

Sɛbɛnw labɛn ka ɲɛ: ni i ye jate bila, a jɔsi sigiɲɔgɔn 20 bɛɛ ka sɛbɛnw na. Bare Sudoku la o bɛ kɛ a yɛrɛ ma, Sɛbɛnw fa bɛ sugandita bɛɛ sɛbɛn kɛnɛ lankolon bɛɛ la digi kelen na, o la i bɛ se ka daminɛ ni suganditaw dafalenw, bɛnnenw ye. Sɛbɛn ye tiɲɛ ye, a tɛ kunfɛ sugandili ye: a kɔrɔ ye ko foyi ma nin jate bali fɔlɔ.

sections.h: Ni i jɔlen don, i ka kan ka mun kɛ?
p: Fɔlɔ, fɛn nɔgɔnw lajɛ tugun: layini, kolɔn ani kɛsu o kɛsu min fara ka surun, o ye kelenw sɔrɔyɔrɔ ye. O kɔfɛ, a lajɛ ko sɛbɛnw dafalen don, katuguni sugandita min dɛsɛra bɛ cogoyaw dogo, sugandita kɔrɔ min tun ka kan ka bɔ, o bɛ cogoya nkalonmaw dilan. O kɔfɛ, [fɛɛrɛw](techniques) lajɛ u gɛlɛya ɲɔgɔn kɔ: sugandita datugulenw, filaw ani sabaw, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ani XYZ-Wing. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka ɲɛ b'a yɛrɛ ye ni misali lakika ye.

Ni foyi ma baara kɛ, ladilikan ta. Bare Sudoku la, ladilikan b'a lajɛ fɔlɔ ni jate bilalen dɔ filila, o kɔfɛ a bɛ kɛnɛ nata ɲini min bɛ se ka fa ni hakili ye, ka fɛɛrɛ tɔgɔ fɔ, o la i bɛ fɛn dɔ kalan hali ni i b'a kɛ. Ladilikan digi tugun walasa ka jate bila.

sections.h: Jatew bɛ don Bare Sudoku la cogo di?
p: Kɛnɛ digi, ka sɔrɔ ka jate digi. Walima jate digi fɔlɔ: a bɛ datugu, kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ i bɛ digi, o b'a sɔrɔ; o ye sira teliman ye ka jate dɔ wɔɔrɔnan, wolonwulanan ani seeginnan bila. Jate digi tugun walasa k'a dayɛlɛ. Sɛbɛnw butɔn bɛ i yɛlɛma ka taa kalamu taamasiyɛnw na, Jɔsi bɛ kɛnɛ jɔsi, Kɔsegin bɛ taama o taama segin kɔ, filiw bɛ jira ni bilen ye ni i m'o dabila menu kɔnɔ.

Walanba kan, biɲɛ butɔnw kɛ ka lamaga, 1 fo 9 ka jate don, Backspace ka jɔsi, N sɛbɛnw kama, U kɔsegin kama, H ladilikan kama, F sɛbɛnw fali kama ani Escape menu kama. Tulon b'a yɛrɛ mara, a bɛ baara kɛ ɛntɛrinɛti kɔ, kanjɛrɛ tɛ, jatebɔ tɛ.

faq: Yala kunfɛ sugandili ka kan sudoku la wa?

Ɲininkali ɲuman na, ayi. Bare Sudoku ɲininkali bɛɛ ɲɛnabɔcogo ye kelen dɔrɔn ye, a lajɛlen don ko a bɛ se ka ɲɛnabɔ ni hakili dɔrɔn ye, ka se a hakɛ fɛɛrɛw ma. Ni a b'i la ko i ka kan ka fɛn bila kunfɛ, sugandita dɔ dɛsɛlen bɛ i ka sɛbɛnw na walima fɛɛrɛ dɔ bɛ makɔnɔ ka sɔrɔ.
Yala jate bɛ se ka bɔ siɲɛ fila layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kɔnɔ wa?

Ayi. Sariya bɛɛ ye o ye: layini kɔnɔntɔn, kolɔn kɔnɔntɔn ani kɛsu kɔnɔntɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ jate bɛɛ sɔrɔ ka bɔ 1 fo 9 siɲɛ kelen dɔrɔn. Ni jate fila kelenw bɛ kulu kelen kɔnɔ, u la kelen kɔni filila.
Danfara jumɛn bɛ Nɔgɔn, Cɛmancɛ, Gɛlɛn ani Dɔnnikɛla cɛ?

Hakɛ bɛ latigɛ ni fɛɛrɛ minnu ka kan ɲininkali ma. Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ bɛ ɲɛnabɔ kelenw dɔrɔn de fɛ, Nɔgɔn bɛ daminɛ ni jate dilen 38 ye walima ka tɛmɛ o kan. Gɛlɛn ka kan ni sugandita datugulenw walima filaw ani sabaw ye. Dɔnnikɛla ka kan ni X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish walima XYZ-Wing ye.
Yala a ka fisa ka sɛbɛnw fa kɛnɛ bɛɛ la walima dɔw dɔrɔn la?

Gɛlɛn ani Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw la, u bɛɛ fa: cogoyaw i n'a fɔ filaw, X-Wing ani Y-Wing tɛ ye fo ni sugandita bɛɛ sɛbɛnnen don. Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ la, sɛbɛnw ye i sago ye, tulonkɛla caman bɛ kelenw dɔrɔn ɲini.
Sudoku bɛ waati hakɛ jumɛn ta?

Nɔgɔn ɲininkali bɛ miniti damadɔ ta; Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw bɛ se ka miniti mugan ta walima ka tɛmɛ o kan, i bɛ cogoya gɛlɛn ye ka teli cogo min na. Bare Sudoku bɛ waatijatelan jira, a b'a jɔ ni menu dayɛlɛlen don, a tɛ se sɔrɔbagaw lisi mara, o la tulon kɛ i yɛrɛ ka teliya la.
Yala sudoku ka kan ni jatekalan ye wa?
Ayi. Jatew ye tɔgɔw dɔrɔn de ye; farali walima jateli si tɛ yen. Taamasiyɛn kɔnɔntɔn o kɔnɔntɔn bɛ se ka baara kɛ, o de kosɔn sudoku ye hakili ɲininkali ye, a tɛ jate ɲininkali ye.

index.title: Sudoku ɲɛnabɔ fɛɛrɛw ɲɛfɔlen ni misaliw ye
index.description: Sudoku ɲɛnabɔ fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn bɛɛ, ka bɔ kelen jiralen na fo Swordfish ani XYZ-Wing, Bare Sudoku ladilikanw ka ɲɔgɔn kɔ la, kelen-kelen bɛɛ ni misali ye.
intro: Sudoku bɛɛ bɛ se ka ɲɛnabɔ ni hakili fɛɛrɛ damadɔ ye. Nin lisi bɛ fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn jira minnu Bare Sudoku ɲɛnabɔlan ani a ladilikanw bɛ kɛ, ɲɛnabɔlan b'u lajɛ ɲɔgɔn kɔ min na: kelenw fɔlɔ, o kɔfɛ bɔliw kulu kelen kɔnɔ, o kɔfɛ cogoyaw minnu bɛ layini ani kolɔn caman minɛ. Fɛɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka ɲɛ b'a yɛrɛ ye, a kɔrɔ, a yecogo, misali lakika ka bɔ ɲininkali dilannen dɔ la ani fili minnu bɛ kɛ tuma caman.

Ɲininkali hakɛ bɛ latigɛ ni fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛnba ye min ka kan a ma. Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ ɲininkaliw ka kan ni kelenw dɔrɔn ye, Gɛlɛn ɲininkaliw ka kan ni sugandita datugulenw walima filaw ani sabaw ye, Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw ka kan ni jɛgɛ walima kaman kelen ye a dɔgɔyalenba. Hakɛ mana kɛ min o min ye, kelenw de bɛ baara caman kɛ; fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛn bɛ sugandita kelen walima fila bɔ, kelenw bɛ taa a fɛ ka bɔ yen.
faq: Ne ka kan ka sudoku fɛɛrɛw lajɛ ɲɔgɔn kɔ jumɛn na?

Nɔgɔnman fɔlɔ: kelen jiralen, kelen dogolen, sugandita datugulenw, fila ani saba jiralenw, fila ani saba dogolenw, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku b'u lajɛ o ɲɔgɔn kɔ yɛrɛ la, ladilikan bɛ fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔnba tɔgɔ fɔ tuma bɛɛ min bɛ baara taa ɲɛ.
Yala ne mago bɛ nin fɛɛrɛw bɛɛ la walasa ka sudoku ɲɛnabɔ wa?

Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ ɲininkaliw kama, kelenw bɛ se. Gɛlɛn ɲininkaliw bɛ sugandita datugulenw ani filaw ni sabaw fara a kan. Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw ka kan ni jɛgɛ walima kaman kelen ye a dɔgɔyalenba, nka siɲɛ kelen walima fila dɔrɔn tuma caman ɲininkali kelen kɔnɔ.
Yala fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛnw bɛ yen ka tɛmɛ XYZ-Wing kan wa?
Ɔwɔ, i n'a fɔ cɛnɛw, kelenya kɔrɔbɔliw ani wajibiya jɔw. Bare Sudoku tɛ ɲininkali dilan minnu mago b'olu la, o la tulon kɔnɔ ɲininkali bɛɛ bɛ se ka ban ni nin ɲɛ in fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn ye.
Sugandita ye mun ye?

Jate min bɛ se ka don kɛnɛ lankolon dɔ la hali bi, katuguni foyi m'a bali fɔlɔ a ka layini, a ka kolɔn walima a ka kɛsu kɔnɔ. Tulon kɔnɔ sɛbɛnw ye suganditaw ye. Fɛɛrɛ o fɛɛrɛ min bɛ tɛmɛ kelenw kan, o bɛ miiri suganditaw de kan, o la u mara ka dafa ani ka bɛn.

naked-single.name: Kelen jiralen
naked-single.title: Kelen jiralen sudoku la: kɛnɛ min sugandita ye kelen ye
naked-single.description: Kelen jiralen ye kɛnɛ lankolon ye min na jate kelen dɔrɔn bɛ se ka don. A sɔrɔcogo teliman kalan, ni misali lakika ye dɔɔnin-dɔɔnin ani fili caman.
naked-single.summary: Kelen jiralen ye kɛnɛ lankolon ye min sugandita ye kelen dɔrɔn ye: jate seegin tɔw bɛ a ka layini, a ka kolɔn walima a ka kɛsu kɔnɔ kaban. Jate tɔ ka kan ka don yen. O ye sudoku fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔnba ye, i bɛ min kɛ ka caya, Bare Sudoku ladilikan b'a jira ko «Sugandita kelen dɔrɔn bɛ yan».
when: Tuma bɛɛ. Kelen jiralenw bɛ ye ka bɔ taama fɔlɔ la fo a laban, hakɛ bɛɛ la. Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ ɲininkaliw la, olu ni kelen dogolenw dɔrɔn de ye fɛɛrɛ ye i mago bɛ min na. Ɲininkali gɛlɛnw na, fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛn bɛ bɔli o bɔli kɛ, o bɛ kelen jiralen dɔ to a kɔfɛ tuma caman, o la u ɲini sen o sen kɔfɛ.
spot: Kɛnɛw filɛ minnu sigiɲɔgɔnw la jate caman bilalen bɛ: kɛnɛ min bɛ layini dɔ la jate wolonwula bɛ min kɔnɔ kaban, walima kɛnɛ min ka layini, kolɔn ani kɛsu bɛ jate seegin danfaralenw minɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ. Ni sɛbɛnw tɛ, i bɛ se ka jate minnu ye ka bɔ kɛnɛ in na, olu jate. Ni sɛbɛnw bɛ, kelen jiralen ye kɛnɛ dɔrɔn ye min bɛ sugandita kelen jira, o de kosɔn Sɛbɛnw fa b'a nɔgɔya k'u sɔrɔ.

steps: {cell} filɛ. A lankolon don, o la jate o jate bilalen bɛ a ka layini, a ka kolɔn ani a ka kɛsu kɔnɔ, olu sɛbɛn.
Layini {row} bɛ {rowDigits} sɔrɔ. Kolɔn {col} bɛ {colDigits} sɔrɔ. Kɛsu {box} bɛ {boxDigits} sɔrɔ.
U bɛɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, u bɛ jate bɛɛ bali fo {d}, o la {d} ye sugandita kelen ye min tora {cell} la.
{d} sɛbɛn {cell} la. O kɔfɛ, a lajɛ ni jate kura ye kelen wɛrɛ dilan o layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kelen in kɔnɔ.

mistakes: Layini dɔrɔn walima kɛsu dɔrɔn jateli. Jate seegin balilenw bɛ bɔ kulu saba bɛɛ de la ɲɔgɔn fɛ tuma caman.
Ka ɲinɛ ko jate min i ye bila sisan, o fana bɛ suganditaw bɔ a sigiɲɔgɔn 20 la; kelen jiralen kuraw bɛ bɔ yen bilali o bilali kɔfɛ yɔrɔnin kelen.
Kelen jiralen ni kelen dogolen ɲagami: kelen jiralen ye sugandita kelen ye min tora kɛnɛ kɔnɔ, kelen dogolen ye kɛnɛ kelen ye min tora jate ye kulu kɔnɔ.
faq: Kelen jiralen ye mun ye sudoku la?
Kɛnɛ lankolon min sugandita ye kelen dɔrɔn ye. Jate seegin danfaralenw bilalen bɛ a ka layini, a ka kolɔn ani a ka kɛsu kɔnɔ kaban, o la jate kɔnɔntɔnnan dɔrɔn de bɛ bɛn.
Mun na a bɛ wele ko jiralen?
Katuguni ni sɛbɛnw sɛbɛnna, sugandita kelen in bɛ ye kɛnɛ kɔnɔ yɛrɛ; foyi t'a dogo. Kelen dogolen kɔni, o bɛ sugandita wɛrɛw cɛ, a bɛ sɔrɔ ni i ye jate filɛ, kɛnɛ tɛ.
Yala ɲininkali bɛ se ka ɲɛnabɔ ni kelen jiralenw dɔrɔn ye wa?

Nɔgɔn ɲininkali caman bɛ se, nka u caman mago bɛ kelen dogolenw fana na. Bare Sudoku bɛ Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ ɲininkaliw jate ko u bɛ ɲɛnabɔ ni kelen suguya fila ye; Gɛlɛn ani Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw ka kan ni fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛ kelen ye a dɔgɔyalenba.
Yala ladilikan bɛ kelen jiralenw jira wa?
Ɔwɔ. Ni bilali nata ye kelen jiralen ye, ladilikan bɛ kɛnɛ sugandi k'a fɔ ko «Sugandita kelen dɔrɔn bɛ yan» ni jate ye. Ladilikan digi tugun walasa k'a bila.

hidden-single.name: Kelen dogolen
hidden-single.title: Kelen dogolen sudoku la: jate ka yɔrɔ kelen dɔrɔn
hidden-single.description: Kelen dogolen ye kɛnɛ kelen dɔrɔn ye layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kɔnɔ jate bɛ se ka don yɔrɔ min na. A sɔrɔcogo kalan ni jate kelen-kelen lajɛli ye.
hidden-single.summary: Kelen dogolen ye jate ye min ka kɛnɛ kelen dɔrɔn de tora a ye layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kɔnɔ, hali ni o kɛnɛ bɛ sugandita wɛrɛw jira. Katuguni kulu ka kan ka o jate sɔrɔ, a bɛ don yen. Bare Sudoku ladilikan b'a jira ko «Yɔrɔ kelen dɔrɔn bɛ 5 ye nin layini in na», walima nin kolɔn in walima nin kɛsu in.
when: Tuma o tuma jate dɔ taara ɲɛ kosɛbɛ: ni jate dɔ bɛ yen siɲɛ duuru walima wɔɔrɔ, kɛsu tɔw dancɛlen don kosɛbɛ, sen nata ye kelen dogolen ye tuma caman. Kelen dogolenw ye Nɔgɔn ani Cɛmancɛ ɲininkaliw fɛɛrɛ kunba ye, u bɛ to baarakɛminɛn kunba ye hakɛ bɛɛ la.
spot: Jate kelen-kelen lajɛ. Jate dɔ ta, kɛsu dɔ ɲini min t'a sɔrɔ, ka o kɛsu kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ bɔ a la min ni o jate bilalen dɔ bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen na. Ni kɛnɛ kelen dɔrɔn tora, i ye kelen dogolen sɔrɔ. Lajɛli kelen in bɛ baara kɛ layiniw ni kolɔnw fana la. Tulon kɔnɔ, jate bilalen dɔ digi: a ɲɔgɔn bɛɛ bɛ manamana, o la kɛnɛ lankolonw bɛ jɛya.

steps: Kɛsu {box} ma {d} sɔrɔ fɔlɔ, o la a ka kɛnɛ lankolonw dɔ ka kan k'a sɔrɔ. Kɛnɛ lankolonw ye {empties} ye.
U bɛɛ la fo {cell}, {d} balilen don {d} fɛ min bilalen bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen na, o la {d} tɛ sugandita ye yen.
O la {cell} dɔrɔn de tora {d} ye kɛsu {box} kɔnɔ. {d} sɛbɛn yen, hali ni {cell} bɛ sugandita wɛrɛw jira hali bi.

mistakes: Jate bilali kɛnɛ dɔ la min bɛ iko a ka ɲi: kulu kɔnɔ kɛnɛ lankolon tɔw bɛɛ lajɛ, a tɛ minnu bɛ ye dɔrɔn.
Kelen dogolen tɛmɛni katuguni kɛnɛ bɛ sugandita caman jira. Sugandita wɛrɛw nafa tɛ; min nafa ka bon, o ye ko jate tɛ yɔrɔ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ kulu kɔnɔ.
Kɛsuw dɔrɔn lajɛli. Layiniw ni kolɔnw fana bɛ kelen dogolenw di tuma caman, kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenya la laban fɛ.
faq: Kelen dogolen ye mun ye sudoku la?
Jate min bɛ se ka don layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu ka kɛnɛ kelen dɔrɔn de la. Kulu ka kan ka o jate sɔrɔ, o la kɛnɛ latigɛlen don hali ni sugandita wɛrɛw b'a la.
Danfara jumɛn bɛ kelen dogolen ni kelen jiralen cɛ?
Kelen jiralen bɛ kɛnɛ dɔ ko de la: sugandita kelen tora. Kelen dogolen bɛ jate dɔ ko de la: kɛnɛ kelen tora kulu kɔnɔ. U fila bɛɛ bɛ jate bila ni dannaya ye.
Jumɛn sɔrɔli ka nɔgɔn?

Ni sɛbɛnw tɛ, kelen dogolenw sɔrɔli ka nɔgɔn tuma caman katuguni i bɛ se ka kɛnɛba lajɛ jate kelen-kelen. Ni sɛbɛnw dafalen don, kelen jiralenw de ka nɔgɔn ka tɛmɛ, katuguni kɛnɛ min sugandita ye kelen ye, o bɛ ye joona.
Ladilikan bɛ kelen dogolen ɲɛfɔ cogo di?
A b'a fɔ ko «Yɔrɔ kelen dɔrɔn bɛ» jate ye nin layini in, nin kolɔn in walima nin kɛsu in na, kɛnɛ sugandilen don. Ladilikan digi tugun walasa k'a bila.

locked-candidates.name: Sugandita datugulenw
locked-candidates.title: Sugandita datugulenw sudoku la: jirali ani minɛli
locked-candidates.description: Sugandita datugulenw: ni jate dɔ ka suganditaw bɛɛ bɛ kɛsu kɔnɔ layini walima kolɔn kelen na, walima a ɲɔgɔn, jate bɛ bɔ yɔrɔ wɛrɛw la. Misali fila.
locked-candidates.summary: Sugandita datugulenw ye fɛɛrɛ fɔlɔ ye min tɛ jate bila, nka a bɛ suganditaw bɔ. Cogo fila b'a la. Jirali: kɛsu dɔ kɔnɔ, jate dɔ ka suganditaw bɛɛ bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen na, o la jate bɛ bɔ o layini walima kolɔn tɔ la. Minɛli: layini walima kolɔn dɔ kɔnɔ, jate dɔ ka suganditaw bɛɛ bɛ kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ, o la jate bɛ bɔ o kɛsu tɔ la. Bare Sudoku ladilikan bɛ bilali min da a bɛ yɛlɛ, o tɔgɔ da ko «Sugandita datugulenw».
when: Ni kelenw banna Gɛlɛn ɲininkali dɔ la, i ka kan k'a lajɛ fɔlɔ. A ka kan ni sɛbɛnw dafalenw ye, a dɔgɔyalenba i bɛ jate min lajɛ, o kama. Sugandita datugulenw ka ca: Gɛlɛn ɲininkali caman mago b'u la, Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw b'u kɛ cogoya belebelebaw cɛ.
spot: Jirali kama, kɛsu kelen-kelen bɛɛ ani jate o jate tɛ a kɔnɔ, olu filɛ: ni o jate ka sugandita kɛnɛw bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen na, a lajɛ ni o jate bɛ sugandita ye o layini walima kolɔn kan kɛsu kɔfɛ. Minɛli kama, layini walima kolɔn dɔ filɛ: ni jate dɔ ka suganditaw bɛɛ bɛ kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ, o kɛsu tɔ bɛ se ka saniya. Tulon kɔnɔ, jate butɔn digi walasa a ka sugandita bɛɛ ka manamana; sɛbɛn fila walima saba manamanalenw minnu bɛ sira kelen kan kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ, o ye cogoya ye.

steps: Kɛsu {box} kɔnɔ, jate {d} ka sugandita kɛnɛw ye nin dɔrɔn ye: {cells}. U bɛɛ bɛ layini {row} la.
Kɛsu {box} ka kan ka {d} sɔrɔ, o la layini {row} ka {d} bɛ kɛsu {box} kɔnɔ, a mana don o kɛnɛw la kelen o kelen na.
Layini {row} tɛ se ka {d} filanan sɔrɔ, o la {d} bɔ layini {row} kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ kɛsu kɔfɛ: {elim}.
Layini {row} kɔnɔ, jate {d} bɛ se ka don {cells} dɔrɔn de la, u bɛɛ bɛ kɛsu {box} kɔnɔ.
Layini {row} ka kan ka {d} sɔrɔ, o la kɛsu {box} ka {d} minɛna layini {row} fɛ. Kɛsu {box} kɛnɛ tɔw tɛ se ka {d} sɔrɔ.
{d} bɔ {elim} la.

mistakes: Jate bɔli kɛsu kɔnɔ, o nɔ na k'a bɔ kɛsu kɔfɛ jirali la, walima a ɲɔgɔn minɛli la. Bɔliw bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ layini walima kolɔn kan nka u tɛ kɛsu kɔnɔ, walima minnu bɛ kɛsu kɔnɔ nka u tɛ layini walima kolɔn kan.
Sariya kɛli ni suganditaw jɛnsɛnnen bɛ kɛsu ka layini fila la. Jate ka sugandita kɛnɛ bɛɛ kɛsu kɔnɔ ka kan ka kɛ sira kelen kan.
Ka ɲinɛ ka kelen ɲini min bɔli ye dilan. Sugandita datugulenw yɛrɛ tɛ jate bila tuma caman; u bɛ kelen labɛn.
faq: Sugandita datugulenw ye mun ye sudoku la?

Jate dɔ ka suganditaw minnu datugulen bɛ kɛsu ni layini walima kolɔn dɔ ɲɔgɔn kunbɛnyɔrɔ la. Katuguni kɛsu, walima layini, ka kan ka jate sɔrɔ o yɔrɔ la, jate bɛ se ka bɔ layini tɔ la, walima kɛsu tɔ la.
Danfara jumɛn bɛ jirali ni minɛli cɛ?

Jirali bɛ daminɛ kɛsu la: jate ka suganditaw kɛsu kɔnɔ bɛ layini walima kolɔn kelen jira, o la jate bɛ bɔ o sira tɔ la. Minɛli bɛ daminɛ layini walima kolɔn na: o sira ka suganditaw jate in kama bɛɛ bɛ kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ, o la sira bɛ jate minɛ, a bɛ bɔ kɛsu tɔ la.
Yala sugandita datugulenw bɛ wele fana ko ɲɔgɔn kunbɛnyɔrɔ bɔli (intersection removal) wa?

Ɔwɔ. Tɔgɔ wɛrɛw ye kɛsu ni sira dɔgɔyali (box-line reduction) ye minɛli cogo kama, ani fila walima saba jirabagaw (pointing pairs, pointing triples) jirali cogo kama. Bare Sudoku bɛ tɔgɔ kelen dɔrɔn kɛ u fila bɛɛ ye.
Hakɛ jumɛn mago bɛ sugandita datugulenw na?
Gɛlɛn. Ɲininkali min mago bɛ sugandita datugulenw walima filaw ani sabaw la, nka a mago tɛ fɛn gɛlɛn wɛrɛ la, o bɛ jate Gɛlɛn ye; Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw mago bɛ jɛgɛ walima kaman na fana.

naked-pairs.name: Fila ani saba jiralenw
naked-pairs.title: Fila ani saba jiralenw sudoku la: u bɛ baara kɛ cogo min
naked-pairs.description: Fila ani saba jiralenw: kɛnɛ fila walima saba kulu kelen kɔnɔ minnu bɛ sugandita fila walima saba kelenw sɔrɔ. U sɔrɔcogo ani min bɛ bɔ, misali la.
naked-pairs.h1: Fila ani saba jiralenw (naked pair, naked triple)
naked-pairs.summary: Fila jiralen ye kɛnɛ fila ye layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ minnu sugandita fila ye kelen ye pewu. O jate fila ka kan ka don o kɛnɛ fila la, o la u bɛ se ka bɔ kulu kɛnɛ tɔ bɛɛ la. Saba jiralen ye hakilina kelen in ye kɛnɛ saba ni jate saba la; kɛnɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka u la fila walima u saba bɛɛ jira. Bare Sudoku ladilikan bɛ bilali min bɔra o la, o tɔgɔ da ko «Fila walima saba».
when: Ni sɛbɛnw dafalen don, ni kelenw ani sugandita datugulenw banna. Fila jiralenw ka ca kosɛbɛ Gɛlɛn ɲininkaliw la, saba jiralenw man ca ten. A ka ɲi k'u bɛɛ ɲini kulu o kulu la kɛnɛ lankolon duuru walima ka tɛmɛ o kan tora min kɔnɔ.
spot: Kɛnɛw ɲini minnu sugandita ye fila dɔrɔn ye, ka kɛnɛ wɛrɛ ɲini o kulu kelen kɔnɔ min bɛ o fila kelenw sɔrɔ. Saba kama, kuluw filɛ kɛnɛ caman bɛ minnu kɔnɔ sugandita fila ni saba bɛ minnu na, k'a lajɛ ni u la saba ɲɔgɔn fɛ bɛ jate saba danfaralenw dɔrɔn de kɛ. Kɛnɛ minnu suganditaw ye kelen ye pewu, olu yeli ka nɔgɔn ni sɛbɛnw sɛbɛnnen don; Sɛbɛnw fa tulon kɔnɔ b'o kɛ digi kelen na.

steps: {cellA} ni {cellB} minnu bɛ {unit} kɔnɔ, u sugandita fila ye kelen ye pewu: {d1} ani {d2}.
U la kelen ka kan ka kɛ {d1} ye, tɔ kelen {d2}. An t'a dɔn min ye min ye, nka jate fila bɛɛ tara o kɛnɛ fila fɛ.
O la, kɛnɛ wɛrɛ si tɛ se ka {d1} walima {d2} sɔrɔ {unit} kɔnɔ. {elim} bɔ.
{unit} kɛnɛ saba bɛ u ka sugandita bɛɛ ta jate saba kelenw de la, {digits}: {cells}.
Jate saba ka kan ka o kɛnɛ saba fa cogo dɔ la. Kɛnɛ man kan ka sugandita saba bɛɛ jira; min nafa ka bon, o ye ko kɛnɛ saba si tɛ sugandita sɔrɔ min tɛ o jate saba la.
{digits} bɔ {unit} kɛnɛ tɔ bɛɛ la: {elim}.

mistakes: Kɛnɛ fila tali minnu bɛ sugandita fila sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ, nka sugandita sabanan fana b'u la. Fila jiralen kama, kɛnɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka o sugandita fila dɔrɔn de sɔrɔ, fɛn wɛrɛ tɛ.
Jatew bɔli fila kɛnɛw yɛrɛ la. Fila bɛ a ka suganditaw mara; bɔliw bɛ kɛ kulu kɛnɛ tɔw la.
K'a ɲini ko saba kɛnɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka jate saba bɛɛ jira. Kɛnɛ min bɛ jate saba la fila sɔrɔ, o ka ɲi, ni kɛnɛ si tɛ sugandita sɔrɔ min tɛ o jate saba la.
faq: Fila jiralen ye mun ye sudoku la?
Kɛnɛ fila kulu kelen kɔnɔ, u fila bɛɛ sugandita fila ye kelen ye pewu. O jate fila datugulen don o kɛnɛ fila la, o la u bɛ se ka bɔ kulu tɔ la.
Saba jiralen ye mun ye?

Kɛnɛ saba kulu kelen kɔnɔ, minnu ka suganditaw ɲɔgɔn fɛ ye jate saba dɔrɔn ye. Kɛnɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka u la fila walima saba sɔrɔ. Jate saba bɛ kɛnɛ saba fa, o la u bɛ se ka bɔ kulu kɛnɛ tɔw la.
Yala fila jiralen bɛ jate bila wa?
A yɛrɛ tɛ. A bɛ suganditaw bɔ, bɔli bɛ kelen jiralen walima kelen dogolen to tuma caman. Bare Sudoku ladilikan bɛ o kelen jira ka fɛɛrɛ tɔgɔ fɔ min y'a sababu ye.
Yala fila jiralen bɛ se ka kɛ kɛsu ni layini kɔnɔ waati kelen wa?
Ɔwɔ. Ni kɛnɛ fila bɛ layini kelen ni kɛsu kelen na, fila bɛ bɔli kɛ kulu fila bɛɛ la. Bare Sudoku b'u lajɛ kulu kelen-kelen.

hidden-pairs.name: Fila ani saba dogolenw
hidden-pairs.title: Fila ani saba dogolenw sudoku la: u sɔrɔcogo
hidden-pairs.description: Fila dogolen ye jate fila ye minnu bɛ se ka don kulu kɔnɔ kɛnɛ fila kelenw dɔrɔn na, o la o kɛnɛw sugandita tɔw bɛ bɔ. U sɔrɔcogo kalan dɔɔnin-dɔɔnin.
hidden-pairs.h1: Fila ani saba dogolenw (hidden pair, hidden triple)
hidden-pairs.summary: Fila dogolen ye jate fila ye minnu, layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ, ye suganditaw ye kɛnɛ fila kelenw dɔrɔn na, yɔrɔ wɛrɛ tɛ. O kɛnɛ fila ka kan ka o jate fila sɔrɔ, o la sugandita tɔ bɛɛ bɛ se ka bɔ u la. Saba dogolen bɛ baara kɛ ten kelen, ni jate saba datugulenw ye kɛnɛ saba la. Bɔli kɔfɛ, kɛnɛw bɛ fila walima saba jiralen jira. Bare Sudoku ladilikan bɛ bilali min bɔra o la, o tɔgɔ da ko «Fila walima saba».
when: Ni kɛnɛ minnu sugandita ka ca bɛ kulu dɔ kɔnɔ, ni kelenw banna. Fila dogolenw bɛ dogo kɛnɛ falenw kɔnɔ, o de kosɔn a ka ɲi k'u ɲini yɔrɔ yɛrɛ la fila jiralenw tɛ ye min na. Saba dogolenw man ca; Bare Sudoku b'u lajɛ, nka Gɛlɛn ɲininkali caman bɛ ɲɛnabɔ u kɔ.
spot: Baara kɛ jate kelen-kelen, kɛnɛ kelen-kelen tɛ. Kulu dɔ kɔnɔ, jate o jate dɛsɛlen don, a bɛ se ka don kɛnɛ minnu na, olu sɛbɛn. Ni jate fila, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye, ni o kɛnɛ fila ye kelenw ye, i ye fila dogolen sɔrɔ. Tulon kɔnɔ, jate butɔn digi walasa a ka suganditaw ka manamana; ni jate fila bɛ kulu dɔ kɛnɛ fila kelenw manamana, fɛn wɛrɛ tɛ a la, o ye cogoya ye.

steps: {unit} kɔnɔ, jate {d1} ni {d2} kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye, u ye kɛnɛ fila kelenw ye: {cells}.
O kɛnɛ fila ka kan ka {d1} ni {d2} sɔrɔ, o la u ka sugandita tɔw tɛ se ka kɛ.
{elim} bɔ. Sisan, kɛnɛ fila bɛ fila jiralen jira, o bɛ se ka fɛn wɛrɛw da yɛlɛ.

mistakes: Fila jate fila bɔli fila kɛnɛw la. O kɛnɛw ka sugandita tɔw de bɛ bɔ; fila jatew bɛ to.
Jate dɔ minɛli min ka kɛnɛ sabanan bɛ kulu kɔnɔ. Jate fila bɛɛ ka kan ka dan o kɛnɛ fila kelenw dɔrɔn na.
Kɛsuw dɔrɔn lajɛli. Fila dogolenw bɛ sɔrɔ layiniw ni kolɔnw fana na tuma caman.
faq: Fila dogolen ye mun ye sudoku la?
Jate fila minnu bɛ se ka don kulu dɔ kɛnɛ fila kelenw dɔrɔn na. O kɛnɛw ka kan ka o jatew ta, o la u ka sugandita tɔw bɛ bɔ.
Fila dogolen ni fila jiralen danfara ye mun ye?
Fila jiralen bɛ ye: kɛnɛ fila minnu bɛ sugandita fila kelenw dɔrɔn jira. Sugandita farankanw bɛ fila dogolen dogo kɛnɛ fila la. Ni o farankanw bɔra, fila dogolen bɛ kɛ fila jiralen ye.
Saba dogolen ye mun ye?
Jate saba minnu danna kulu dɔ kɛnɛ saba la. Jate kelen-kelen bɛɛ man kan ka bɔ kɛnɛ saba bɛɛ la; min nafa ka bon, o ye ko jate saba si ka sugandita tɛ o kɛnɛw kɔfɛ.
Yala ladilikan bɛ fila dogolenw ni fila jiralenw danfara wa?
Ayi. Bare Sudoku b'u fila bɛɛ sɔrɔ ka bilali min bɔra o la, o tɔgɔ da ko «Fila walima saba». Ɲɛ ninnu b'u danfara katuguni u sɔrɔcogo tɛ kelen ye.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing sudoku la: fɛɛrɛ bɛ baara kɛ cogo min
x-wing.description: X-Wing: jate min sugandita kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye layini fila kɔnɔ, kolɔn fila kelenw na, o bɛ bɔ o kolɔnw kɛnɛ tɔw la. Misali lakika.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing ye jate kelen cogoya ye kɛnɛ naani la, layini fila ni kolɔn fila bɛ ɲɔgɔn kunbɛn yɔrɔ minnu na. Ni jate in ka sugandita kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye layini fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ni o kɛnɛw bɛ kolɔn fila kelenw na, jate ka kan ka kɛ o kɛnɛ naani la fila la minnu tɛ layini kelen walima kolɔn kelen na. O la, a bɛ se ka bɔ o kolɔn fila kɛnɛ tɔ bɛɛ la. Ni layiniw ni kolɔnw falen-falenna, a bɛ kɛ ten kelen. O ye Dɔnnikɛla fɛɛrɛ fɔlɔ ye Bare Sudoku la.
when: Ni kelenw, sugandita datugulenw ani filaw ni sabaw banna. X-Wing ye Dɔnnikɛla cogoya ye min ka ca ni tɔw ye, a bɛ bɔ tuma caman ni jate dɔ ka sugandita damadɔ dɔrɔn tora, a ka c'a la ni o jate bilalen don siɲɛ naani fo wɔɔrɔ. A ka kan ni sɛbɛnw dafalenw ye i bɛ jate min lajɛ, o kama.
spot: Jate dɔ sugandi, ka layiniw ɲini a ka sugandita kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye minnu na. Ni o layini fila bɛ kolɔn fila kelenw sɔrɔ, o kolɔnw lajɛ ka o jate ka sugandita wɛrɛw ɲini: olu de ye bɔliw ye. O kɔfɛ, a kɛ tugun ka kolɔnw kɛ jusigilan ye. Tulon kɔnɔ, jate butɔn digi: a ka sugandita bɛɛ bɛ manamana, sɛbɛn naani manamanalenw layini fila ni kolɔn fila la, olu yeli ka nɔgɔn.

steps: Jate {d} ka sugandita kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye layini {r1} la, fila dɔrɔn fana layini {r2} la, u bɛ kolɔn fila kelenw na, {c1} ni {c2}: {cells}.
Layini {r1} b'a ka {d} bila kolɔn {c1} walima {c2} la, layini {r2} b'a ka {d} bila tɔ kelen na. Cogo o cogo, kolɔn {c1} ni kolɔn {c2} kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ {d} kelen sɔrɔ o layini fila la.
O la {d} tɛ se ka kɛ yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la kolɔn {c1} ni {c2} kɔnɔ. {d} bɔ {elim} la.

mistakes: Layini dɔ kɛli min ka sugandita kɛnɛ ye saba ye jate in kama. Jusigilan layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka fila dɔrɔn sɔrɔ, u fila bɛɛ ka kɛ kolɔn fila ɲɔgɔnnaw la.
Jate bɔli layiniw la o nɔ na k'a bɔ kolɔnw la. Ni layiniw ye jusigilan ye, bɔliw bɛ kolɔnw de la, a ɲɔgɔn fana bɛ ten.
Ka ɲinɛ cogoya falen-falenen kɔ. X-Wing min jɔlen bɛ kolɔnw kan, o bɛ bɔli kɛ layiniw la.
faq: X-Wing ye mun ye sudoku la?

Jate min ka sugandita kɛnɛ ye fila dɔrɔn ye layini fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, kolɔn fila kelenw na. Jate bɛ o kɛnɛ naani la fila minɛ minnu tɛ layini kelen walima kolɔn kelen na, o la a bɛ bɔ kolɔn fila tɔ la. Layiniw ni kolɔnw bɛ se ka falen-falen.
Mun na X-Wing bɛ baara kɛ?

Layini fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka jate bila kolɔn fila la kelen na, layini fila tɛ se ka kolɔn kelen kɛ. O la kolɔn fila kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ a ka jate sɔrɔ o layiniw de la, sugandita tɔ bɛɛ o kolɔnw kɔnɔ tɛ se ka kɛ.
Yala X-Wing ye jɛgɛ ye wa?
Ɔwɔ. X-Wing ye jɛgɛ ye min bonya ye fila ye; Swordfish ye jɛgɛ ye min bonya ye saba ye. Bare Sudoku b'u fila bɛɛ sɔrɔ.
X-Wing bɛ hakɛ jumɛn na?
Dɔnnikɛla. Ɲininkali min mago bɛ X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish walima XYZ-Wing la, o bɛ jate Dɔnnikɛla ye.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing sudoku la: fɛɛrɛ bɛ baara kɛ cogo min
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): jukɛnɛ min sugandita ye fila ye ani kaman fila minnu bɛ u la kelen sɔrɔ, olu bɛ jate bɔ kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ la min bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, min bɛ wele fana ko XY-Wing, o bɛ kɛnɛ saba kɛ minnu kelen-kelen bɛɛ sugandita ye fila ye. Jukɛnɛ sugandita ye X ni Y ye. Kaman kelen bɛ jukɛnɛ ye, X ni Z b'a la; kaman tɔ bɛ jukɛnɛ ye, Y ni Z b'a la. Jukɛnɛ mana kɛ min o min ye, kaman kelen ka kan ka kɛ Z ye, o la Z bɛ se ka bɔ kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ la min bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye. O ye Dɔnnikɛla fɛɛrɛ ye Bare Sudoku la.
when: Ni kɛnɛ caman bɛ ɲininkali la minnu sugandita ye fila dɔrɔn ye, ni jɛgɛ si tɛ sɔrɔ. Y-Wing ka ca Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw la, a bɛ sɔrɔ ni i ye sugandita fila kɛnɛw tugu: u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka kɛ jukɛnɛ walima kaman ye.
spot: Kɛnɛw sɛbɛn minnu sugandita ye fila dɔrɔn ye. U kelen-kelen bɛɛ jate jukɛnɛ ye min sugandita ye X ni Y ye, ka kɛnɛ dɔ ɲini a sigiɲɔgɔnw cɛ, X ni jate wɛrɛ Z bɛ min na, ani kɛnɛ dɔ Y ni o Z kelen bɛ min na. O fila ye kamanw ye. O kɔfɛ, kɛnɛw ɲini minnu bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye, Z bɛ minnu na. A dɔn ko kamanw man kan ka ɲɔgɔn ye.

steps: Jukɛnɛ {pivot} sugandita ye {x} ni {y} ye. A bɛ {wingA} ye, {x} ni {z} bɛ min na, ani {wingB}, {y} ni {z} bɛ min na.
Ni {pivot} ye {x} ye, {wingA} bɛ {x} bɔnɛ, a bɛ kɛ {z} ye. Ni {pivot} ye {y} ye, {wingB} bɛ kɛ {z} ye. Cogo o cogo, kaman fila la kelen ye {z} ye.
Kɛnɛ min bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye, o tɛ se ka kɛ {z} ye abada. {z} bɔ {elim} la.

mistakes: Kamanw sugandili minnu fila bɛɛ tɛ jukɛnɛ ye. Kaman kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka layini, kolɔn walima kɛsu kelen sɔrɔ ni jukɛnɛ ye.
Z bɔli kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ kaman kelen dɔrɔn ye. Kɛnɛ min bɛ bɔli sɔrɔ, o ka kan ka kaman fila bɛɛ ye.
Z bɔli jukɛnɛ la. Y-Wing la, Z tɛ jukɛnɛ na; ni a b'a la, cogoya ye XYZ-Wing ye, min sariyaw tɛ kelen ye.
faq: Y-Wing ye mun ye sudoku la?

Kɛnɛ saba minnu sugandita ye fila ye: jukɛnɛ X ni Y bɛ min na, kaman X ni Z bɛ min na ka jukɛnɛ ye, ani kaman Y ni Z bɛ min na ka jukɛnɛ ye. Kaman kelen ye Z ye tuma bɛɛ, o la Z bɛ bɔ kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye.
Yala Y-Wing ni XY-Wing ye kelen ye wa?
Ɔwɔ. Tɔgɔ fila bɛ cogoya kelen de ɲɛfɔ. Bare Sudoku b'a wele ko Y-Wing.
Mun na kaman kelen ka kan ka kɛ Z ye?
Ni jukɛnɛ ye X ye, kaman fɔlɔ bɛ X bɔnɛ, a bɛ kɛ Z ye. Ni jukɛnɛ ye Y ye, kaman filanan bɛ kɛ Z ye. Jukɛnɛ ye o fila la kelen ye, o la kaman kelen ye Z ye.
Y-Wing bɛ bɔli kɛ kɛnɛ joli la?
Tuma caman kelen walima fila: kɛnɛ minnu bɛ kaman fila bɛɛ ye, Z bɛ minnu na hali bi, olu dɔrɔn. O bɛ se ka kelen dilan.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish sudoku la: fɛɛrɛ bɛ baara kɛ cogo min
swordfish.description: Swordfish: jate min danna kolɔn saba la layini saba kɔnɔ, o bɛ bɔ o kolɔnw kɛnɛ tɔw la. Jɛgɛ min bonya ye saba ye, ɲɛfɔlen ni misali lakika ye.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish ye X-Wing ye min bɛ layini saba ni kolɔn saba kɛ. Ni jate dɔ ka sugandita kɛnɛw tɛ tɛmɛ saba kan layini saba kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, ni o kɛnɛw bɛɛ bɛ kolɔn saba kelenw na, layini saba bɛ jate ta o kolɔnw kɔnɔ, o la jate bɛ se ka bɔ kolɔn saba kɛnɛ tɔ bɛɛ la. Layiniw ni kolɔnw bɛ se ka falen-falen. Bare Sudoku bɛ Swordfish ɲini Y-Wing kɔfɛ, Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw la.
when: Ni X-Wing ni Y-Wing ma foyi sɔrɔ. Swordfish man ca ka tɛmɛ X-Wing kan, a ka kan ni jate ye min ka suganditaw jɛnsɛnnen bɛ dɔɔnin-dɔɔnin layini walima kolɔn saba kan. A ka kan ni sɛbɛnw dafalenw, bɛnnenw ye o jate kama.
spot: Jate dɔ sugandi, ka layiniw ɲini sugandita kɛnɛ fila walima saba bɛ a ye minnu na. Ni o layini saba ka suganditaw bɛɛ bɛ kolɔn saba dɔrɔn de la, o kolɔnw lajɛ ka o jate ka sugandita wɛrɛw ɲini. Layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ man kan ka sugandita sɔrɔ kolɔn kelen-kelen bɛɛ la: Swordfish bɛ se ka kɛnɛ wɔɔrɔ, wolonwula, seegin walima kɔnɔntɔn sɔrɔ. Tulon kɔnɔ, jate manamana ni a butɔn ye, ka layini saba ɲini minnu ka suganditaw bɛ kolɔn saba kan.

steps: Jate {d} ka sugandita kɛnɛw tɛ tɛmɛ saba kan layini {rows} kelen-kelen bɛɛ la, o kɛnɛw bɛɛ bɛ kolɔn {cols} la: {cells}.
Layini saba kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan k'a ka {d} bila kolɔn saba la kelen na, layini fila tɛ se ka kolɔn kelen kɛ. O la kolɔn saba bɛ u ka {d} sɔrɔ o layini saba de la.
{d} sugandita wɛrɛ o wɛrɛ kolɔn {cols} kɔnɔ, o tɛ se ka kɛ. {d} bɔ {elim} la.

mistakes: Kɛnɛ kɔnɔntɔn bɛɛ ɲinini. Swordfish min sugandita ye fila ye layini dɔw la, o fana bɛnnen don, ni layini saba bɛ kolɔn saba dɔrɔn de kɛ.
Layini dɔ farali a kan min sugandita kɛnɛ ye naani ye. Jusigilan layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka kan ka saba sɔrɔ walima min dɔgɔ ni o ye, u bɛɛ kolɔn saba kɔnɔ.
Bɔli kɛli jusigilan layiniw la. Ni layiniw ye jusigilan ye, bɔliw bɛ kolɔn saba la, jusigilan layiniw kɔfɛ.
faq: Swordfish ye mun ye sudoku la?
Jate min ka suganditaw layini saba kɔnɔ danna kolɔn saba la. Layini saba ka kan ka jate bila o kolɔn saba la, kelen-kelen, o la jate bɛ bɔ o kolɔnw kɛnɛ tɔw la.
Swordfish ni X-Wing danfara ye mun ye?
A bonya dɔrɔn: X-Wing bɛ layini fila ni kolɔn fila kɛ, Swordfish bɛ saba ni saba kɛ. Miiriya ye kelen ye.
Yala Swordfish ka kan ni kɛnɛ kɔnɔntɔn yɛrɛ ye wa?
Ayi. Layini kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka sugandita fila walima saba sɔrɔ; cogoya b'a ɲini dɔrɔn ko layini saba ɲɔgɔn fɛ kana tɛmɛ kolɔn saba kan.
Yala jɛgɛ min bonya ye naani ye, o bɛ yen wa?
Ɔwɔ, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku t'a kɛ, katuguni a ka ɲininkaliw mago t'a la abada.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing sudoku la: fɛɛrɛ bɛ baara kɛ cogo min
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: jukɛnɛ min sugandita ye saba ye ani kaman fila minnu bɛ u la kelen sɔrɔ, olu bɛ o jate bɔ kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ la min bɛ u saba bɛɛ ye. Misali.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing ye Y-Wing ye min jukɛnɛ sugandita ye saba ye. Jukɛnɛ bɛ X, Y ani Z sɔrɔ; kaman kelen bɛ jukɛnɛ ye, X ni Z b'a la, tɔ kelen bɛ jukɛnɛ ye, Y ni Z b'a la. Kɛnɛ saba la kelen ka kan ka kɛ Z ye, o la Z bɛ se ka bɔ kɛnɛ o kɛnɛ la min bɛ u saba bɛɛ ye. Katuguni jukɛnɛ yɛrɛ bɛ se ka kɛ Z ye, kɛnɛ min bɛ bɔli sɔrɔ, o ka kan ka jukɛnɛ ye ani kaman fila bɛɛ, o b'a dan kɛsu walima sira la kɛnɛw bɛ min sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ. O ye fɛɛrɛ gɛlɛnba ye Bare Sudoku bɛ min kɛ.
when: Ni fɛn tɔ bɛɛ ma se dɔrɔn. XYZ-Wing ye cogoya ye min man ca ka tɛmɛ tɔw bɛɛ kan Bare Sudoku la, a bɛ bɔ Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw dɔrɔn de la. A ɲini ni kɛnɛ min sugandita ye saba ye, o bɛ kɛsu kelen kɔnɔ ni kɛnɛ dɔ ye min sugandita ye fila ye, a ka jate fila bɛ o fila ye.
spot: A daminɛ kɛnɛw la minnu sugandita ye saba dɔrɔn ye; u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ se ka kɛ jukɛnɛ ye. A sigiɲɔgɔnw cɛ, kɛnɛ fila ɲini minnu kelen-kelen bɛɛ sugandita ye fila ye, u bɛɛ tara jukɛnɛ ka saba la, u bɛ jate kelen dɔrɔn Z sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn fɛ. O kɔfɛ, kɛnɛw ɲini minnu bɛ jukɛnɛ ni kaman fila bɛɛ ye, Z bɛ minnu na. Kɛcogo la, kaman kelen bɛ jukɛnɛ ka kɛsu kɔnɔ, tɔ kelen bɛ a ka layini walima a ka kolɔn na, bɔli kɛnɛw ye o kɛsu kɛnɛ tɔw ye minnu bɛ o layini walima kolɔn na.

steps: Jukɛnɛ {pivot} sugandita ye saba ye: {x}, {y} ani {z}. A bɛ {wingA} ye, {x} ni {z} b'a la, ani {wingB}, {y} ni {z} b'a la.
Ni {pivot} ye {z} ye, a banna. Ni a ye {x} ye, {wingA} ka kan ka kɛ {z} ye. Ni a ye {y} ye, {wingB} ka kan ka kɛ {z} ye. Cogo o cogo, kɛnɛ saba la kelen ye {z} ye.
Kɛnɛ min bɛ u saba bɛɛ ye, o tɛ se ka kɛ {z} ye. {z} bɔ {elim} la.

mistakes: Bɔli kɛli kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ kaman fila dɔrɔn ye. A tɛ i n'a fɔ Y-Wing: jukɛnɛ bɛ se ka kɛ Z ye, o la kɛnɛ ka kan ka jukɛnɛ fana ye.
Kamanw kɛli minnu suganditaw fila bɛɛ tɛ jukɛnɛ ka sugandita saba kɔnɔ.
A ɲagami ni Y-Wing ye: danfara ye sugandita sabanan ye jukɛnɛ na, a bɛ kɛnɛ minnu bɛ se ka saniya, olu yɛlɛma.
faq: XYZ-Wing ye mun ye sudoku la?
Jukɛnɛ min sugandita ye X, Y ani Z ye ani kaman fila, kelen na X ni Z, tɔ kelen na Y ni Z, u fila bɛɛ bɛ jukɛnɛ ye. Kɛnɛ saba la kelen ye Z ye, o la Z bɛ bɔ kɛnɛw la minnu bɛ u saba bɛɛ ye.
XYZ-Wing ni Y-Wing danfara ye mun ye?
Jukɛnɛ sugandita ye saba ye, a tɛ fila ye, Z bɛ u la. O bɛ jukɛnɛ kɛ yɔrɔ ye Z bɛ se ka don min na, o la kɛnɛ minnu bɛ jukɛnɛ ni kaman fila bɛɛ ye, olu dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka Z bɔnɛ.
XYZ-Wing bɛ bɔ tuma joli?
A man ca. Bare Sudoku la, Dɔnnikɛla ɲininkaliw dɔrɔn de mago bɛ se ka kɛ a la, u caman mago t'a la. Bare Sudoku b'a lajɛ laban na, X-Wing, Y-Wing ani Swordfish kɔfɛ.
Yala WXYZ-Wing bɛ yen wa?
Ɔwɔ, ni jukɛnɛ ye min sugandita ye naani ye, nka Bare Sudoku t'a kɛ. Tulon kɔnɔ ɲininkali bɛɛ bɛ se ka ban ni nin ɲɛfɔli fɛɛrɛ kɔnɔntɔn ye.

uz-Cyrl.learnText: Судокуни энди бошлаяпсизми ёки қийин бошқотирмада тўхтаб қолдингизми? Икки қўлланма қоидаларни ва маслаҳатлар фойдаланадиган барча ечиш усулларини ҳақиқий мисоллар билан тушунтиради.
